Underneath her friendly attitude, Yuzuriha's true nature is that of a complete narcissist, only focusing on her own well-being and shows little concern for others. This attitude stemmed from her past vow to her little sister to live only for the both of them. As a kunoichi, Yuzuriha uses her charms to get what she wants, but despite that she is shown to be a terrible liar after trying to make up her backstory.

~!Though selfish, Yuzuriha can show compassion to others. As Senta was dying, she consoled him and had him die in peace by making him forget about his duties as an Asaemon and gave him the last bit of freedom he had to think about what he wanted to imagine as his last memory.!~

~!Despite her beautiful appearence, with her mucus abilities she actually hides a body full of scars.!~

Yuzuriha grew up in a shinobi village living with her little sister, [Saya](https://anilist.co/character/306735/Saya), who was suffering from an incurable disease and eventually died. From then on, Yuzuriha swore to live her life for the both of them and started her career as a kunoichi. Sometime ago, Yuzuriha raided the Sagiwa Castle and defeated the retainers defending it.

personnages.surnom: Yamada Asaemon Shion (山田浅ェ門士遠)
personnages.description:
__Height:__ 178 cm
__Race:__ Human 
__Tao Attribute:__ Wood

Shion is the 4th rank Asaemon of the Yamada clan and is the one chosen to be [Akaginu](https://anilist.co/character/302523/Akaginu)'s monitor. 

Shion is a strict but kind man. He is well aware of the brutal nature of his work as an executioner, opting to spend the rest of his time helping others. Like the other Asaemon, he possesses a strong loyalty to the Yamada clan. Shion also has a witty sense of humor, often making puns and jokes regarding his eyesight, which has become a major part of his character to the people around him. Shion is shown to be fearless, showing no fear or hesitation when facing extremely strong enemies.

__Tao Attribute:__ Metal
__Occupation:__ Bandit
__Race:__ Human (Formerly), ~!Semi-Immortal Human!~

Aza Chobe also known as the Bandit King, is a well-known bandit leader in Iyo that is responsible for multiple crimes committed.

Chobe is an extremely barbaric individual who attacks anyone or anything that poses as a threat to him. He prefers to do things of his own accord and would rather resort to violence than talk things through. Chobe is also very sadistic whenever he engages in fights with his enemies, Chobe always stuck to taking on the role of the villain, and holds grudges to those that have bested him. Although he tends to act like a brute, Chobe is a rationale thinker that knows what is the best course of action in a serious situation.

~!Chobe and [Toma](https://anilist.co/character/137261/Touma) were born as sons to a retainer under the service of the daimyō of Akō Domain, Asano Takunori. However, after Asano Takunori attacked the court official Kira Yoshinaka at Edo Castle, he was sentenced to commit seppuku. As a result, their father and the rest of the retainers had their status removed and were left as ronin, leaving their family in poverty. They were eventually taken by bandits who planned on selling them but later came to live amongst them after Chobe managed to become their leader.!~

personnages.surnom: Yamada Asaemon Tenza (山田浅ェ門典坐)
personnages.description:
__Height:__ 176 cm (5'9")

Tenza is the 10th rank Asaemon in the Yamada Clan. After [the shogun](https://anilist.co/character/301606/Tokugawa-Nariyoshi) sent criminals to Kotaku to find the Elixir of Life, he was chosen as [Nurugai's](https://anilist.co/character/137262/Nurugai) assigned monitor. From youth, Tenza started off on the streets but was eventually picked up by [Shion](https://anilist.co/character/137267/Shion) and made into his apprentice in the Yamada Clan. 

Tenza is energetic and confident. He is a practitioner of bushido, taking in the lesson of continuing on forward no matter what is blocking his way. Tenza is also extremely righteous and does not let his duties as an Asaemon get in the way of doing what is right. He believes that Nurugai is innocent and does not deserve to die on the island. Although righteous he is, Tenza does not think things through, believing that without the elixir he would be able to convince his superiors to turn a blind eye. Tenza has a strong will to protect the people he cares about.

__Race:__ Human
__Age:__ Unknown
__Tao Attribute:__ Fire

Tamiya Gantetsusai formerly known as Tetsunosuke is a renown master swordsman known throughout as the Blade Dragon and Eight Provinces Unparalleled.

He considers fighting to be fun and lives to seek out and battle strong opponents that can make him feel a thrill whenever he has to draw his blade. Even when critically injured, Gantetsusai's carries a satisfied smile from the adrenaline he gets from fighting and feels as though as he is becoming stronger with each injury. However, he is not very disciplined, preferring to recklessly fight his opponents head on without thinking of a clear strategy, or listen to his allies, and hates it when others try to interfere in his enjoyment. Gantetsusai also has a perverted side as he took note and commented on [Yuzuriha](https://anilist.co/character/137270/Yuzuriha)'s physique during the selection process. Despite his perverted behavior, Gantetsusai has morals as he felt disgusted of the thought of the Dōshi using [Mei](https://anilist.co/character/148755/Mei) for sexual intercourse to complete their Tao training.

~!Gantetsusai has a massive ego and wishes to go down in history as a legendary figure. He believes that by performing extraordinary feats and people remembering his name throughout generations is the true form of immortality rather than gaining the Elixir of Life.!~

At a young age, Tetsunosuke was trained in the art of swordsmanship. After being defeated by his master, Tetsunosuke asked how he was able to despite his old age. He explains to Tetsunosuke that he has become greedy with wanting to become stronger and says that he must throw away his strength in order to see everything in what he has left. Despite this lesson, Tetsunosuke was unable to understand what his master was telling him. As he grew up, Tetsunosuke renamed himself to Tamiya Gantetsusai and went around searching for strong opponents, eventually making a name for himself as a fame swordsman.

personnages.surnom: Yamada Asaemon Fuchi (山田浅ェ門付知)
personnages.description:
__Height:__ 148 cm
__Race:__ Human
__Tao Attribute:__ Metal
__Occupation:__ Asaemon
__Affiliation:__ Yamada Clan
__Rank:__ 9th

Yamada Asaemon Fuchi is the 9th rank Asaemon in the Yamada Clan and was chosen to be [Tamiya Gantetsusai](https://anilist.co/character/137264/Gantetsusai-Tamiya)'s assigned monitor. 

Fuchi is a rational thinker that has a good sense of judgement in situations and carries a no-nonsense view when it comes to matters that he deems are unscientific, pointless, and illogical. He has great pride as a Yamada Asaemon and does not tolerate anybody speaking disgracefully about the Yamada clan. He is very close with his Asaemon comrades and gives them nicknames instead of using honourifics. Even though the Yamada clan mainly deal with testing new swords and executions, Fuchi preferrs, and has a deep passion, for studying the human anatomy to improve medical science that came with the trade. He whole-heartedly believes that anatomical research would save lives and despises those who thought so little of this study.

~!Although he was an executioner, after his experience working together with the surviving convicts, Fuchi found that both "crime" and "evil" were entirely different from one another, with Tamiya Gantetsusai as an example. From a scientific view point, Fuchi found that samurai and criminals were not so different since they are structured the same and had a will to live, which was reason enough for the survivors to band together in trying to return home.!~

~!With both him and Gantetsusai badly injured Fuchi musters up the rest of his strength to administer first aid to Gantetsusai instead of himself resulting in him dying. In his last thoughts, Fuchi warns [Shugen](https://anilist.co/character/148752/Shugen) not to underestimate the survivors since they are not willing to die easily and wishes the best of luck to both his allies and enemies.!~

personnages.surnom: Yamada Asaemon Shugen (山田浅ェ門殊現)
personnages.description:
__Race:__ Human
__Tao Attribute:__ Water
__Occupation:__ Asaemon, Assistant Instructor
__Affiliation:__ Yamada Clan
__Rank:__ 2nd

Shugen is the 2nd ranked Asaemon, as well as an Assistant Instructor, in the Yamada clan. Shugen is the leader of the second team sent to Kotaku after the [shogun](https://anilist.co/character/301606/Nariyoshi-Tokugawa) became impatient waiting for the first team to comeback. 

Shugen is very dignified and diligent in his duties as an Asaemon. Shugen cares greatly for his Yamada clansmen, having spent his years with them and being taught what they know. He greatly expressed his concern for their safety on the island and vowed to bring them back home no matter what the means were. Furthermore, Shugen has a tendency to become emotional whenever he thinks about his comrades. He's one of the only Yamada clan members who doesn't look down on women in the clan and vouches for their qualifications as executioners. He greatly despises all criminals and truly believes that they are evil no matter who they are. At a young age, Shugen could not understand the Yamada clan's way of thinking when executing criminals and believed that they should all deserve a painful death.

Shugen believes in order of all things in the world; the order in which those who abide by the law are to be protected while those who break them should be punish without mercy.

__Tao Attribute:__ Water

An islander from Kotaku. Mei is a shy and quiet girl. She is innocent and can easily be frightened when harm comes to her. Mei is especially kind and caring to the people around her that she views are her allies and can also be accepting of others when seeing their good qualities. When they first met, Mei was afraid of [Gabimaru](https://anilist.co/character/137260/Gabimaru) because of his intimating demeanor but after showing signs of respect towards her she wasn't afraid to come near him.

~!Mei is a Tensen that was formerly affiliated with [Rien](https://anilist.co/character/148754/Rien) and [Xu Fu](https://anilist.co/character/306854/Jofuku) but escaped after disagreeing with Rien's methods to unlock immortality. She then resided with [Hōko](https://anilist.co/character/305440/Houko) and soon became an ally of Gabimaru and his group in their attempt to retrieve the elixir known as Tan from Lord Tensen and escape Kotaku.!~

personnages.surnom: Yamada Asaemon Touma (山田浅ェ門桐馬)
personnages.description:
__Race:__ Human
__Tao Attribute:__ Earth
__Occupation:__ Asaemon (Unofficial)
__Affiliation:__ Yamada Clan

Toma is a relatively new member of the Yamada clan trying to rise in their ranks and is the assigned monitor of [Chobe Aza](https://anilist.co/character/137269/Chobe-Aza).

~! He turns out to be the younger brother of Chobe Aza and had a mission of infiltrating the Yamada clan to rescue him from prison. !~

Toma believes that the key to surviving in life is adapting to ones environment. Toma tends to act rather unfriendly when someone tries to communicate with him on friendly terms. He also displays a cocky attitude.

~! He is very caring and loyal to Chobe since he has been his protector since they were children and stresses out whenever harm comes to him. Because of how his father died fighting for his allies, Toma is reluctant to cooperate with anyone except for his brother. In his own eye, Toma views himself as an extension of his brother instead of an ally and stated that the bandits that followed the two were merely pawns for them to use. However, Toma soon realizes that his reliance on his brother to protect him interferes with his growth rate to look after himself. !~

~! Toma and Chobe were born as sons to a retainer under the service of the daimyō of Akō Domain, Asano Takunori. However, after Asano Takunori attacked the court official Kira Yoshinaka at Edo Castle, he was sentenced to commit seppuku. As a result, their father and the rest of the retainers had their status removed and were left as ronin, leaving their family in poverty. Their mother eventually died of an illness and their father was executed for being a part of the Akō Incident, leaving the two siblings left alone to defend for themselves. They were eventually taken by bandits who planned on selling them but later came to live amongst them after Chobe managed to become their leader. !~

__Height:__ 138 cm
__Race:__ Human
__Tao Attribute:__ Water

Nurugai is the last remaining member of the Sanka and a wrongly convicted death-row criminal. Her assigned monitor is [Tenza](https://anilist.co/character/137265/Tenza).

Nurugai looks down on samurai, viewing them as stupid. Her disdain for them stems from the fact that they were partially responsible for killing her people. Because of this incident, Nurugai feels a strong guilt for leading her village's extermination, even believed that the reason why she is on a dangerous mission is because she was receiving divine punishment for her actions and accepted death. 

Nurugai was raised with the Sanka Mountain People in a village where she had lived with her grandfather. Nurugai and her grandfather were in a friendly, familial relationship where she would learn off her grandfather's wisdom. Her village however were considered rebels against the current shogunate, refusing to submit to [Tokugawa](https://anilist.co/character/301606/Nariyoshi-Tokugawa). Because of this, samurai were sent to locate the hillside tribes they defined as Emishis. One day, Nurugai crossed paths with a party of lost men, encouraging Nurugai to offer her help by seeking rest in the security of her village. Nurugai recognized her mistake when she realised that these men were samurai under the order of Tokugawa, who began a mass killing of her village that would leave her as the sole survivor.

__Race:__ Human
__Occupation:__ House Wife
__Affiliations:__ Iwagakure

Yui is the daughter of the [Iwagakure chief](https://anilist.co/character/301607/Osa) and the wife of [Gabimaru](https://anilist.co/character/137260/Gabimaru).

Yui is very kind, caring and gentle. She truly loves Gabimaru and believes that he is not completely emotionless as people make him out to be. She accepts the fact that he kills people and is not terrified being around him. Yui is also shown to be wise as she gave Gabimaru words of wisdom on why he should relax his body while giving him a bath. She is very civilized as she taught Gabimaru basic manners when they became a couple.

Yui was born as the daughter of the Iwagakure chief. Being born a female, Yui was not trained in the ways of the shinobi and instead lived a semi-normal life within the village. 

~!At some point, during her time with her father, the chief burned her face to make sure that she gave up on her dreams of ever living a normal, peaceful life as a woman. After Gabimaru proved his worth to the chief, Yui was forced by her father to marry him. The two then came to love each other as their days went by. Wanting to give his wife a peaceful life, Gabimaru came to the village chief requesting to abandon his duties as a shinobi, resulting in him being betrayed by the village and handed over to the authorities to be executed. After hearing news of her husband's captured, Yui went into a state of depression and refused to speak to anyone or eat as she waits in hopes for Gabimaru's return.!~

personnages.surnom: Yamada Asaemon Jikka (山田浅ェ門十禾)
personnages.description:
__Height:__ 177 cm
__Race:__ Human
__Tao Attribute:__ Earth
__Occupation:__ Asaemon
__Affiliation:__ Yamada Clan
__Rank:__ 3rd

Jikka is the 3rd ranked Asaemon in the Yamada clan. After the shogun sent criminals to Kotaku to find the Elixir of Life, he was tasked with being [Hōrubō](https://anilist.co/character/302525/Hourubou)'s executioner.

Jikka is a laid-back individual who compared to his fellow clan members, especially Shugen, is less dedicated to his work as an Asaemon. He is rather dishonest and goes as far as to lie to shogun's officials. Jikka is also rude and disrespectful to others around him regardless of who they are, even towards his fellow Asaemon. Also, unlike his clan members who each show concern for one another, Jikka is the only member shown to have little to no concern over the safety of the other Asaemon. 

Jikka stated that he is an individual that prefers to enjoy life to the fullest rather than focus on status and rank. This way of thinking greatly shows in his life as an executioner as he has been reported to attend his execution assignments while intoxicated and even sold his own sword as a way to collect money for his vulgar exploits. As a result, Jikka has received a bad reputation amongst his peers in the Yamada clan. Despite being so lazy and laid-back he is a very analytical individual and is incapable of being fooled through deception.

~!He is one of the most mysterious people of the Yamada clan and also one of the strongest despite the attitude towards his duties, he is in fact so strong that he's the only person known who has come back from Kotatsu island alive and in perfect condition. Having sold his sword he now carries a simple takemitsu (bamboo sword), but even then he still manages to cut off criminal heads and kill monsters with ease.!~

Jikka believes that he and [Gabimaru](https://anilist.co/character/137260/Gabimaru) are similar in that they value life more than anything.

__Height:__ 173-185 cm
__Race:__ Tensen
__Tao Attribute:__ Wood
__Occupation:__ Partial Ruler of Kotaku
__Affiliation:__ Lord Tensen, Xu Fu

Tao Fa is a member of Lord Tensen, as well as one of the rulers of Kotaku.

Tao Fa is very cheerful and always seems to be in a good mood. Unlike the other members of Lord Tensen, Tao Fa is rather friendly towards humans, or at least ones that are willing to cooperate with Lord Tensen's plans. However, she still carries the same view of using them as tools and shows no signs of sympathy towards them. Because she specializes in Bōchū Jutsu, Tao Fa is quite vulgar and often likes to flirt with others.

Tao Fa is always being protected by [Ju Fa](https://anilist.co/character/151772/Ju-Fa) since they had been by each others side from the moment they were born, because of that [Rien](https://anilist.co/character/148754/Rien) stated that the two were special in that they are in fact two of a whole.

Tao Fa had stated that they preferred the female gender because of their liking to their appearance. As such, they also acted feminine on top of their appearance.

personnages.surnom: Yamada Asaemon Senta (山田浅ェ門仙汰)
personnages.description:
__Race:__ Human

Yamada Asaemon Senta is the 5th rank Asaemon in the Yamada Clan. After the shogun sent criminals to Kotaku to find the Elixir of Life, he was tasked with being [Yuzuriha's](https://anilist.co/character/137270/Yuzuriha) executioner.

Senta is very nervous around others and tends to frequently sweat. He usually remains in the background and goes along with whatever is happening around him but will speak up when he feels that whatever he has to say would be helpful. Senta is capable of assessing the situation and makes good judgements as to how to approach them. He dislikes his role of killing people but feels that he has no choice in the matter and chooses to abandon his dream of becoming an artist. After observing Yuzuriha, he becomes envious and enchanted by her innate freedom. Despite his nervous demeanor, Senta is fearless and stands his ground no matter who he is up against.

__Height:__ 165 cm
__Race:__ Human
__Tao Attribute:__ Unknown
__Occupation:__ Shinobi
__Affiliation:__ Iwagakure

Shija is an elite shinobi assassin from Iwagakure. After the shogun came to Iwagakure for assistance in retrieving the Elixir of Life from Kotaku, having become impatient with the first group, Shija, and a squad of Iwa ninja, was assigned to the second team to complete the mission and supposedly provide support to the first team.

~! In actuality, the Iwa ninjas' true mission is to kill [Gabimaru](https://anilist.co/character/137260/Gabimaru) and take back the alias of __Gabimaru the Hollow__. Shija is also the next chosen Iwagakure shinobi to potentially succeed the current holder of the alias. !~

While working on missions, Shija has the complete mindset of a shinobi and only speaks when it is necessary. As a shinobi, Shija views themselves as a pawn for their master and only prioritizes on the orders they have been given on a mission no matter what the situation was. To this extent, they also hold no sense of concern for their ninja allies since they too follow the same belief.

~! Shija has a long history with Gabimaru and has respect and a deep infatuation towards him, admiring his skills in ruthlessly killing his targets. Whenever they met or even have a mere thought about Gabimaru would cause Shija to break out in an excited love-struck behavior. Despite them respecting Gabimaru a lot, their love for him can be seen as being a twisted, borderline obsession. They think of themselves as Gabimaru's supporter and was driven to commit horrendously violent acts from the shadows for his sake in the past. In terms of loyalty between Iwagakure and Gabimaru, Shija has been pointed out by the latter to be an unpredictable individual that can either chose to give in to their feelings and become his ally or put the village's orders first and serve as his enemy. !~

When they were young, Shija and their brothers underwent intense ninja training, along with many other children. While they managed to endure the gruesome training, Shija was left as the only surviving sibling and one of the few children to survive the screening.

__Height:__ 173 - 185 cm
__Race:__ Tensen
__Tao Attribute:__ Fire
__Occupation:__ Partial Ruler of Kotaku
__Affiliation:__ Lord Tensen, Xu Fu

Ju Fa is a member of Lord Tensen, as well as one of the rulers of Kotaku.

Ju Fa is very short tempered and has aggressive tendencies towards anything that irritated him at the slightest, which also applied to his fellow Lord Tensen members. While its true that all members of Lord Tensen have a negative view on humans, Ju Fa is the one that truly despises them with a passion and believes that they are nothing more than "livestock". 

He is very protective of [Tao Fa](https://anilist.co/character/151778/Tao-Fa) since they had been by each others side from the moment they were born, because of that [Rien](https://anilist.co/character/148754/Rien) stated that the two were special in that they are in fact two of a whole. Despite their ability to heal themselves, Ju Fa hated when Tao Fa got hurt and was told that he cared greatly for Tao Fa as his partner.

Ju Fa found the male gender to be well-suited for him because of his moods and how he is able to easily handle situations.

personnages.surnom: Yamada Asaemon Isuzu (山田浅ェ門威鈴)
personnages.description:
__Height:__ 215 cm
__Race:__ Human
__Age:__ Unknown
__Tao Attribute:__ Water
__Occupation:__ Asaemon, Female Combat Instructor
__Rank:__ Unranked

Isuzu is an unranked Asaemon in the Yamada clan. After the shogun became impatient of the first team acquiring the Elixir of Life, Isuzu and [Kiyomaru](https://anilist.co/character/151776/Kiyomaru) were chosen to join [Shugen](https://anilist.co/character/148752/Shugen) and [Jikka](https://anilist.co/character/148756/Jikka) to be a part of the second team sent to acquire the elixir.

Isuzu is very respectful towards her allies and wishes to avoid any conflict between them. In battle, or when one of her allies steps out of line, such as Kiyomaru, Isuzu behavior changes and becomes more serious and fierce. She is also capable of self restraint, that is greatly expressed on her face, when dealing with a troublesome situation. Isuzu highly respects Shugen and follows his view of justice in believing that criminals should not be given mercy or to those that protect them as well.

~!Similar to her brother [Genji](https://anilist.co/character/302049/Genji), Isuzu follows the samurai code of honor known as bushidō. After [Gantetsusai](https://anilist.co/character/137264/Tamiya-Gantetsusai) brought [Fuchi](https://anilist.co/character/137268/Fuchi)'s dead body, Isuzu was prepared to commit seppuku for the death of her fallen Asaemon comrades on the island and hoped that her death would appeased the shogun.!~

As a child, Isuzu was sensitive about her stature and would often be referred to her as a gorilla. However, after receiving words of encouragement from her brother about gorillas being strong animals, Isuzu no longer took it as an insult and believed that gorillas embody the concept of bushidō.

__Height:__ 173 - 185 cm
__Race:__ Human; Tensen (Through her puppets)
__Tao Attribute:__ Earth
__Occupation:__ Leader of Lord Tensen, Ruler of Kotaku
__Affiliations:__ Lord Tensen

Rien is a Tensen-class Sennin serving as the true ruler of Kotaku, the creator of the Tensens, and the leader of Lord Tensen.

~!At some point during 3rd century BC, Rien was married to [Jofuku](https://anilist.co/character/306854/Jofuku) and went with him on his voyage to the East to acquire the Elixir of Life for the ruler of the Qin Dynasty. Their journey ended on an island where they decided to use the island's resources and their knowledge of Taoism to discover the secrets to gaining immortality. This resulted in many experimental creations. As part of their research, Rien used her Tao to create a clone of herself that she could remotely control. After receiving a new body, Rien used the Tao puppet to create another fabricated clone named [Mei](https://anilist.co/character/148755/Mei), who assisted both her and Jofuku, along with six fabricated newborns. These seven then came to be known as Tensens. After Jofuku's death, Rien made a commitment to revive him. With the Tensens she created, Rien formed the group known as Lord Tensen to maintain order over the island and trained the six young ones in the ways of Tao.!~

personnages.surnom: Yamada Asaemon Eizen (山田浅ェ門衛善)
personnages.description:
__Height:__ 180 cm
__Race:__ Human
__Tao Attribute:__ Unknown
__Occupation:__ Asaemon
__Affiliation:__ Yamada Clan
__Rank:__ 1st

Eizen is the 1st rank Asaemon in the Yamada clan. He joined the Shinsenkyo Island expedition and was assigned to keep watch over the criminal, [Rokurōta](https://anilist.co/character/302052/Rokurouta).

Eizen has great pride for the Yamada clan and believes that no task is impossible for them when it came to executing people, such as his assigned criminal Rokurōta. As an executioner, Eizen acts professional in his line of work as he knows that defiling the execution grounds by trying to bring pain to the condemned with his blade would defile the magistrate and he follows the Yamada clan's ideal way of ending lives by cutting his victims with no pain or emotion, a concept which he tried to impart to a young [Shugen](https://anilist.co/character/148752/Shugen). 

Eizen is also kind and caring as he promised to look after Shugen when he was young, which brought a great influence to him in the present. Like his fellow clan members, Eizen believes that women in the Yamada clan should not follow the path of a samurai and is antagonistic when [Sagiri](https://anilist.co/character/137263/Sagiri) took the shogun's mission.

~! Upon arriving in Shinsenkyo, Eizen is almost instantly crushed by Rokurōta and dies. Shugen becomes devastated after finding Eizen's corpse and took the time to lay his soul to rest despite the fact that his team was being under attack. His death went on to impact Shugen on his mission to the extent that he vowed to kill everyone on the island in order to avenge his master. !~

Eizen has a profound influence on Shugen as he is the one person the young man looks up to the most.
Death row convict recruited to find the Elixir of Life. She is a cannibal with a taste for male flesh, especially after first making them succumb to her sexual temptations.

__Height:__ 173 - 185 cm
__Race:__ Tensen
__Tao Attribute:__ Water
__Occupation:__ Partial Ruler of Kotaku
__Affiliation:__ Lord Tensen, Xu Fu

Zhu Jin is one of the rulers of Kotaku and one of the seven Lord Tensen.

Zhu Jin carries themselves with a calm and relaxed demeanor even when handling threats. Like their fellow Tensen, Zhu Jin has no sympathy for humans when it comes to killing them. Zhu Jin is also very perceptive of their opponents skills and can quickly adjust to them, causing them to become unfazed by whatever move they make. Zhu Jin can become easily irritated with troubling matters. Despite usually keeping a straight face at all times, when faced with an unbelievable crisis, Zhu Jin can break into a state of panic and fear and will take matters seriously. 

Zhu Jin follows [Gui Fa](https://anilist.co/character/170488/Gui-Fa)'s example of taking the Middle Way in terms of the two sexes. Therefore, unlike the other Tensens, Zhu Jin does not carry a preference to either being male or female and allows themselves to switch in and out of the two chi's over time.

__Race:__ Houko
__Tao Attribute:__ Metal

__Height:__ 173 - 185 cm
__Race:__ Tensen
__Tao Attribute:__ Earth
__Occupation:__ Ruler of Kotaku
__Affiliation:__ Lord Tensen

Mu Dan is a member of Lord Tensen, as well as one of the rulers of Kotaku.

Mu Dan has a cheerful, yet very sadistic attitude. He is very blunt with his words and is not afraid to tell his enemies what they want because of the confidence in his own power. Mu Dan views humans as simply research material and "toys" that he can do whatever he wants with.  He seems to get along quite well enough with the other Tensens, shown as they were all having a nice conversation. However, he shows no signs of pity for them no matter what. Mu Dan stated that he is a believer in functional beauty and preferres the male gender because there was nothing wasted in its composition.

A member of Lord Tensen and a partial ruler of Kotaku. Gui Fa maintains a complete deadpan demeanor and is known to be extremely shy around others, as they prefer to cover their face with a book at all times to avoid making eye contact.

__Race:__ Tensen
__Tao Attribute:__ Water
__Occupation:__ Partial ruler of Kotaku
__Affiliation:__ Lord Tensen, Xu Fu

Ran is a member of Lord Tensen and part ruler of Kotaku.

Ran is very loyal to [Rien](https://anilist.co/character/148754/Rien) and carries the same view of seeing the Tensens as family. Like all the members of Lord Tensen, Ran has no sympathy for humans and uses them as they see fit. He believes that it is a futile effort for the trespassers to invade the palace and try their hand at opposing the Tensens, showing signs that he views them inferior compared to his family. However, he is not above praising or admiring them if they show impressive skills. Due to specializing in Dō'in, Ran is extremely passionate about the physical work of the body and fighting styles that can only be obtained through diligent training.

~! Upon transforming into his Kishikai form, Ran expressed his physicality while attacking [Gabimaru](https://anilist.co/character/137260/Gabimaru) and [Yuzuriha](https://anilist.co/character/137270/Yuzuriha). He was also up to the challenge of facing the two in their use of ninjutsu in order to strengthen his Dō'in training. !~

~! He is bested in a fight against Gabimaru and Yuzuriha and is killed. Ran slowly dies with his last thoughts about Rien. !~

personnages.surnom: Bizen no Daidarabotchi  (備前の大巨人)
personnages.description:
__Height:__ 321 cm

One of the criminals sent to acquire the Elixir of Life for the [shogun](https://anilist.co/character/301606/Nariyoshi-Tokugawa). ~!Despite his size, he is an 8-year old child suffering from an abnormal case of gigantism.!~

personnages.surnom: Yamada Asaemon Kiyomaru (山田浅ェ門清丸)
personnages.description:
__Race:__ Human
__Age:__ Unknown
__Tao Attribute:__ Metal
__Occupation:__ Asaemon
__Affiliation:__ Yamada Clan

Kiyomaru is an unranked Asaemon in the Yamada Clan. After the shogun became impatient of the first team acquiring the Elixir of Life, Kiyomaru and [Isuzu](https://anilist.co/character/151770/Isuzu) were chosen to join [Shugen](https://anilist.co/character/148752/Shugen) and [Jikka](https://anilist.co/character/148756/Jikka) to be a part of the second team sent to acquire the elixir.

Due to his young age, Kiyomaru is very immature. While departing to Kotaku, Kiyomaru spoke rudely to one of his superiors and childishly did as he pleased, such as cutting one of the ninjas mask to prove his strength and ordered one ninja to kill themselves to prove their loyalty. Kiyomaru is also very arrogant, as he declared that he was far superior to everyone that came along on the mission and hates it when people look down on him for not having a ranking.

~! Despite being loyal to Shugen, because of the dire situation escalating in Hōrai, Kiyomaru and a few others decide to cooperate with the Vanguard Party. After discussing the plan to destroy the Banko's tandens scattered around Hōrai, Kiyomaru is paired with Isuzu to strengthen her Water Tao with his Metal Tao and goes after the tandens.  !~
Chief of Iwagakure and father of [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/151771).

personnages.surnom: Yamada Asaemon Kishou (山田浅ェ門期聖)
personnages.description:
__Height:__ 173cm
__Race:__ Human

Kishou is the 11th rank Asaemon in the Yamada Clan and was assigned to keep watch over the criminal, [Warped Keiun](https://anilist.co/character/302522/Keiun).

Kishou is an individual who is known for never losing his composure and rarely acting assertive. He is able to see the big picture in situations and finds it annoying when people question his way of handling them. Kishou has shown that he doesn't mind taking the easy way out, offering to cut down [Gabimaru](https://anilist.co/character/137260/Gabimaru) to help [Sagiri](https://anilist.co/character/137263/Sagiri) return home instead of following through with the mission. He also doesn't like to be pushed around.

personnages.surnom: Yamada Asaemon Genji (山田浅ェ門源嗣)
personnages.description: __Height:__ 205 cm

personnages.surnom: Igami no Kyooun (いがみの慶雲)
personnages.description:
__Height:__ 210 cm

Death row convict who is recruited to find the Elixir of Life. While undergoing training as a souhei (warrior monk), Keiun developed an obsession for weapons and armor and decided to take his training to the next level by slaughtering martials artists and stealing their weapons.
Aki is a girl who came across [Gabimaru](https://anilist.co/character/137260/Gabimaru) outside her village.

__Height:__ 175 cm

One of the [shogun](https://anilist.co/character/301606/Nariyoshi-Tokugawa)'s retainers.

__Height:__ 191 cm

Death row convict recruited to find the Elixir of Life. Makiya had an ambition to overthrow the shogun and went about it by forming a cult that was based off of multiple religions.

__Height:__ 180 cm

Kumokiri is a jounin-class shinobi of Iwagakure.

personnages.surnom: Yamada Asaemon Tesshin (山田浅ェ門鉄心)
personnages.description:
__Height:__ 173 cm

Tesshin was a former Asaemon of the Yamada clan and the first apprentice of [Shion](https://anilist.co/character/137267/Shion).
Kiou was a shinobi of service to Tashiro Sukezaemon who falsely claimed to have held from Iwagakure as their strongest shinobi.
A young, deaf transfer student with an amazingly positive outlook on life. Despite being a victim of continuous bullying, she always keeps a smile on her face.

__Height:__ 183 cm

The main character and narrator. Ishida bullied [Nishimiya Shouko](https://anilist.co/character/80243) in elementary school and when she transferred away, he was ostracized and bullied by his former friends. He started to ignore those around him (imagining them with a large X across their face) and was driven to the point of suicide. He changed his mind after he apologized to Nishimiya and began to spend time with her. He learned sign language specifically so he could apologize to her and is shown to be very talented in it. He feels like he hasn't been punished enough for bullying Nishimiya and often wishes he could kill his younger self. He seems resigned to the fact that he will never be able to have friends again.

A girl from [Ishida](https://anilist.co/character/80491/Ishida-Shouya) and [Nishimiya](https://anilist.co/character/80243/Nishimiya-Shouko)'s elementary school and the girl that Ishida was closest to at school. Ishida remembers her bossing him about and also being his main helper in bullying Nishimiya. After having separated from him since middle school graduation, Ueno runs into Ishida years later, herself now working in a cat café.

[Shouko](https://anilist.co/character/80243/Nishimiya-Shouko)'s younger sister who is currently a middle school student. She cut her hair short so their [mother](https://anilist.co/character/124037/Nishimiya-Yaeko) would not cut Shouko's and has kept it that way ever since; due to this, she is often mistaken for a boy, with [Ishida](https://anilist.co/character/80491/Ishida-Shouya) even thinking that she is Shouko's boyfriend at first.

A short, fat, and lonely boy who is a habitual liar. When someone tries to steal Nagatsuka's bike, Ishida offers his to be taken instead. Nagatsuka sees this act of kindness as an unbreakable act of friendship and swiftly becomes Ishida's self-proclaimed best friend and starts to idolize Ishida. He is shown to be quite obsessive and protective of Ishida and often dislikes him befriending other people. However, Nagatsuka is also supportive of Ishida and often offers advice. He has plans to become a millionaire, so is willing to hand out money to friends and is keen to become a film director—entering himself and Ishida into a film competition. It is shown both Ueno and Kawai find Nagatsuka repulsive, while Ishida is uncomfortable that Nagatsuka is so willing to take his side when he knows so little about him. Though his film proves to be a failure, this only made Nagatsuka resolved to take up film studies as his college subject.

A kind and loving single mother of Shouya and his older sister who owns a hair salon. She cares for her granddaughter Maria as well as Ishida and often lets Yuzuru stay around the house. She became disappointed upon learning that Ishida bullied Nishimiya and had to pay 1.7 million yen for all the hearing aids Ishida broke.

Hyoga is a survivor who was revived by Tsukasa Shishio. Initially, he was an elite member of the Tsukasa Empire since he was depetrified by Tsukasa.

~!He ultimately betrays Tsukasa by attempting to take over his leadership and threatens Senku into joining, only to be defeated by the duo in the decisive battle for the Kingdom of Science. When the situation calls for it, he is depetrified once again and summoned to battle - now as a begrudging ally of the Kingdom of Science with a similar but slightly mellowed goal in mind. Since his third depetrification, Hyoga's goals are unknown.!~

Hyoga has an easy going attitude towards everything. Even in situation that do not work in his favour, he still remains calm. While he claims to share the same values as Tsukasa when it comes to only reviving the young and creating a community where no one takes from others, Hyoga himself is an elitist who believes in social darwinism. He categorizes humans as either enlightened (or strong) and unenlightened (or weak). He believes that the "brainless incompetent masses" should not be allowed to live and that only those who excel should be allowed to live. While he does follow a form of social darwinism, he does not believe it is only the physically strong who should survive, as he wanted Senku to join him in his endeavors and become the strongest duo, indicating he respected Senku's intelligence and understood his capabilities. He is very manipulative and cunning, seems to be observant, and can often be cruel, merciless, and uncaring. He tends to refer to things as being done "properly" or not.

Kinrou is the elder brother of [Ginrou](https://anilist.co/character/143270/Ginrou) and the son of Tetsuken and Shirogane. Originally having served as one of the guards of Ishigami Village alongside Ginrou, he quickly joined [Senku](https://anilist.co/character/124142/Ishigami-Senkuu) as a member of the Kingdom of Science. 

Kinrou is a muscular young man of average height, with a scar on the right side of his face and a cluster of hair hanging in between his eyes. He wears a sleeveless karate gi-like uniform with a belt and a buckler with a star pattern on his back. After the Grand Bout, Kinrou begins wearing a pair of glasses to correct his nearsightedness.

Ginrou is [Kinrou](https://anilist.co/character/143271/Kinrou)'s younger brother and one of the village guards. He is shorter and scrawnier than his brother, with short blonde hair and green eyes. He usually wears a karate gi-like uniform and belt and carries his spear wherever he goes. He and his brother were two of the first villagers to join the Kingdom of Science.

~!During the adventure on Treasure Island, Ginrou manages to convince [Matsukaze](https://anilist.co/character/188816/Matsukaze) to serve him due to the resemblance Ginrou bears to his late master.!~

Ruri is [Kohaku](https://anilist.co/character/124143/Kohaku)'s elder sister and the daughter of [Kokuyo](https://anilist.co/character/150509/Kokuyo), and serves as the priestess of Ishigami Village. She is similar to Kohaku in appearance but has longer hair and a more hourglass-shaped body. She wears a black sundress and a piece of rope around her neck.

__Height:__ 180 cm (5'11")

Scientist and leader of the American Colony. Similar to Senku, Xeno is brilliant when it comes to science. He is very observant, somewhat eccentric, and has a penchant for stating the word "Elegant."

personnages.nom_natif: スタンリー・スナイダー
personnages.description: Stanley is a tall, well-built man with very feminine facial features.

__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")

Francois is [Ryuusui](https://anilist.co/character/145097/Ryuusui-Nanami)'s faithful and extremely talented butler whose services were well sought out and coveted before the Petrification. Their gender remains unknown. They are demonstrated to be a supreme chef.

__Height:__ 145 cm (4'9")

Homura acts as the right-hand man of [Hyouga](https://anilist.co/character/145062/Hyouga) in [Tsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/124144/Tsukasa-Shishiou)'s army. She was a competitive gymnast before the petrification.

__Height:__ 180 cm (5'11")

Nikki is a survivor that was revived by [Tsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/124144/Tsukasa-Shishiou), who assigned her to keep watch over [Taiju](https://anilist.co/character/124146/Taiju-Ooki) and [Yuzuriha](https://anilist.co/character/124147/Yuzuriha-Ogawa). She later defected from the Tsukasa Empire and joined the Kingdom of Science, where her unofficial role is that of disciplinarian. She has great physical strength, constantly being shown keeping people like [Magma](https://anilist.co/character/145095/Magma) and [You](https://anilist.co/character/145061/You-Uei) in line.

Nikki is a massive fan of [Lillian Weinberg](https://anilist.co/character/149274/Lillian-Weinberg). In the modern world she was having a rough time at school and listening to Lillian's songs saved her.

personnages.nom_natif: リリアン ・ ワインバーグ
personnages.description: A famous American diva and songstress whose name is known by the whole world. Her passion in adventuring lead her aboard the International Space Station (ISS) alongside Senku's father, Byuakuya Ishigami.

__Height:__ 165 cm (5'5")

Luna is a slender young woman of average height who has somewhat wild, short blonde hair with a few locks long enough to cover her left eye, similar to [Ginro](https://anilist.co/character/143270). She has a small bust but extremely wide hips and is considered to be very attractive by [Carlos](https://anilist.co/character/187009), [Max](https://anilist.co/character/187010), [Mozu](https://anilist.co/character/157298), and several others. For clothing, she wears a striped, form-fitting short backless dress and a choker with a star on it. She also has a pouch wrapped around her left thigh and a pair of thigh-high boots with heels. Her petrification scar takes the form of a star shape on her lower back.

~!Luna is one of the residents of the American colony.!~

__Height:__ 181 cm

Sai Nanami is the son of the owner of Nanami Conglomerate and the older brother of [Ryusui Nanami](https://anilist.co/character/145097/Nanami-Ryuusui). While he is a prodigy in mathematics and is said to be "a million times" better than the average person (according to Ryusui), Sai's passion lies in coding, and he claims himself to be a programmer rather than a mathematician.
Kirisame is one of the two strongest warriors in the Petrification Kingdom, the other being [Mozu](https://anilist.co/character/157298).

__Height:__ 166 cm (5'4")

Minami is a Pre-Petrification human and former reporter before the Petrification occurred. ~!Originally a member of [Tsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/124144/Shishiou-Tsukasa)'s army before Tsukasa's downfall at the hands of [Hyoga](https://anilist.co/character/145062/Hyouga)'s betrayal, she later joins and helps the Kingdom of Science.!~

personnages.nom_natif: チェルシー・チャイルド
personnages.description:
__Height:__ 148cm (4'10")

Chelsea is a happy girl who seems friendly and excited, especially after seeing people for the first time after petrification. Her straightforward and carefree attitude when talking earns her a nickname of "Chelsea the Blunt" by Gen, practically when she ask Luna directly about her weight.

__Height:__ 177 cm (5'10")

You is a pre-petrification human and former policeman who is revived by [Tsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/124144/Tsukasa-Shishiou). He faked his death after [Chrome](https://anilist.co/character/124145/Chrome)'s escape to avoid the blame, then eventually joins the Kingdom of Science after the stone wars are over. As penance, he worked with [Yuzuriha](https://anilist.co/character/124147/Yuzuriha-Ogawa) to rebuild the statues that were destroyed by Tsukasa. He is constantly butting heads with [Magma](https://anilist.co/character/145095/Magma) due to each other's naivety of their respective worlds.

__Age:__ Unknown
__Heigh:__ 182cm (6'0")

Mozu is one of the two strongest warriors in the Petrification Kingdom, with the other being Kirisame. He is the secondary antagonist of the Treasure Island Arc.

Mozu is a cocky and easygoing man who enjoys the company of beautiful women, and strong people. He giddily looks forward to the harem selection every year, hoping for cute girls to appear. Despite this, he possesses a sharp instinct and is cunning, and it is hinted that he knows a lot more than he lets on. In battle, he lives for the thrill, as seen when he fought against Hyoga who he found to be a worthy adversary.

(**Source** Dr. Stone Wiki)

Matsukaze is a warrior from the Petrification Kingdom. He currently acts as a body guard to Ginro, who resembles his late master.
~!Born a few centuries prior to the present, he was petrified in an event in which countless Petrification Weapons fell from the sky. He was later revived by the Kingdom of Science!~
(Source: Dr. Stone Wiki)
Magma is a villager from the Ishigami village. Magma is known for being the strongest of all the Villagers in terms of strength.

personnages.nom_natif: シャミール・ヴォルコフ
personnages.description:
__Height:__ 180 cm

Shamil was a Russian Cosmonaut residing on the International Space Station (ISS) when the Petrification on Earth's surface occurred. He returned to Earth's surface along with the rest of the ISS crew, helping to establish Ishigami Village. After returning to Earth, Shamil married fellow ISS astronaut [Connie Lee](https://anilist.co/character/150510/Connie-Lee) and had several children together. His personality was the opposite of [Byakuya](https://anilist.co/character/149275/Byakuya-Ishigami)'s, being a stoic, serious, pragmatic man of few words.

__Initial Age (mental):__ 6
__Initial Age (physical):__ 12
__Height__: 139 cm (4'7")


Mirai is the beloved little sister of [Tsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/124144/Tsukasa-Shishiou). Mirai was clinically brain dead prior to the Petrification, the doctors saying she'd never wake up. Tsukasa refused to give up on her and took on his MMA matches to keep paying the medical bills that kept her on life support. ~!She was depetrified by [Senku](https://anilist.co/character/124142/Senkuu-Ishigami) as part of the deal to end the war between the Kingdom of Science and the Tsukasa Empire.!~

Amaryllis is considered the most beautiful girl in the Petrification Kingdom.

~!She later joins Senku in his quest to defeat the Minister Ibara and the harem.!~

__Initial Age:__ 21 
__Height:__ 168 cm (5'6")

Joel is a watchmaker that was found in North America. He was revived to take apart the Petrification Weapon and see what makes it tick.
NASA personnel who was one of the astronauts on the International Space Station at the time when the people of Earth were petrified.

__Height:__ 163 cm

Russian cosmonaut and doctor who was on board the International Space Station (ISS) alongside her husband [Yakov Nikitin](https://anilist.co/character/150512/Yakov-Nikitin). While in space, she witnessed the petrification of all human life on Earth's surface.
Villager from Ishigami Village. She is one of the three Sparkly Sisters along with her siblings Sapphire and Ruby. Her parents are Alabaster and Dia.

__Height:__ 179 cm (5'10")

Soyuz is a member of Ishigami Village. 

~!Soyuz is not from Ishigami Village. He was born on Treasure Island and was discovered on the shores of Ishigami Village as a baby. It is later discovered that he is the long-lost son of the leader of the Petrification Kingdom.!~

Father of [Kohaku](https://anilist.co/character/124143/Kohaku) and [Ruri](https://anilist.co/character/143272/Ruri). He was the village chief of Ishigami Village at the time of [Senku](https://anilist.co/character/124142/Senkuu-Ishigami)'s reawakening. ~!Kokuyo at first refuses to accept Senku as the new village chief, even though Senku won the Grand Bout. After witnessing Senku's antibiotic cure Ruri he officially crowns Senku the new leader of Ishigami Village. Despite not being the chief anymore, he serves as something of a co-leader of Ishigami Village, focusing on more practical concerns like food gathering, while Senku focuses on scientific advancement.!~

__Height:__ 216 cm (7'1)

Kaiman is a human born in the Hole with an immunity towards magic. He has made it explicitly clear that "Kaiman" was not his actual name, but was given to him by [Nikaido](https://anilist.co/character/16057) after he began suffering from amnesia. His lizard head being the result of a Magic User's curse, his main goal is to seek out the one who cursed him in order to change himself back. Because he can't remember who cursed him, due to his amnesia, he instead resorts to clamping his mouth around the head of every magic user he comes across, letting them see the "little man" in the back of his head before pulling them back out so he can ask them all the same question: "What did the guy inside my head say?"

Throughout most of the series, Kaiman, true to his moniker, takes on the appearance of a lizard-like entity. Though his body is consistently human with a tall and muscular build, his face and head have changed dramatically due to the effects of a Magic User. He most closely resembles a Caiman lizard, (though some think he looks more like an Iguana) his hair being replaced by long, very sharp spikes. It appears that despite having his head chopped off, he can regenerate it in a few days time. He sports small crosses over his eyes and wears gas masks most of the time, though he refrains from wearing them later on in the series.

Kaiman usually takes on the personality of someone arrogant and lazy, but deep inside he's rather caring and cares a lot for his best friend, Nikaido. Rude, stubborn and prone to resolve anything with violence, there's a few things in Kaiman's mind and heart, wishing to have his normal head back, eat gyoza and having more money (in that specific order); only caring about subjects related to those three things and showing no regard or concern about anything else. He sees Magic Users as scum, killing them in the spot after interrogating them and showing no remorse for that, he hates them and he even would start a mass slaughter in the middle of their realm to find the one responsible for his head. He has constant nightmares about his creation and death, causing Kaiman to wake up tired, worried, scared and trying to forget them, even if sometimes they have a connection to his past. He has shown to be easily distractible as during both his jobs he finds himself easly distracted by things.

~!Kaiman does eventually get his human face back, along with his lost memories, but the truth about his identity was more than he bargained for. It turns out he was originally a human boy from Hole named Ai Coleman. Ai put himself through surgeries to become an artificial magic user, and his self has since fragmented into several quasi-independent personalities attached to multiple heads, including Aikawa and Kai.  Kaiman actually wore one of Kai's heads for most of his time in Hole, as indicated by the crosses he had around his eyes. He switched to Aikawa's crossless head when he experienced a flashback at the Zagan school of magic. Kaiman was still wearing Aikawa's head during his fight with En when Ebisu's reptilian magic was dispelled, which is why he reverted to the Aikawa personality and not Kai at that time.!~

__Height:__ 169 cm (5'6½)

Nikaido is a companion to [Kaiman](https://anilist.co/character/9192), who both hunt Magic Users. She is the owner of a restaurant called the Hungry Bug in the Hole. There she serves primarily gyozas with a few slices of shiso, which Kaiman adores. Nikaido's gyozas are constantly declared as the best in the Hole.

~!As it progresses, it is revealed that Nikaido is also a magic user, and has some ties in the Magic Users' World. When she trains with the ex-devil, [Kawajiri](https://anilist.co/character/40955), she discoveres that her magic is related to Time and that it can only be used a limited amount of times before eventually becoming completely unusable.!~

Nikaido has long blond hair, blue eyes, an athletic body build, and a curvy figure (shown mostly after her Devil training). At the beginning of the series, her clothes consisted of dark baggy pants and a black jacket with Chinese design. About midway in the series, she wears a green overalls with combat boots and leather gloves. She has an easy going and friendly attitude, though keeps many of her worries and anxieties to herself. She is confident in her physical abilities and isn't easily frightened.

__Height:__ 209 cm (6'10")

Noi is an elite Magic-User, and the partner and long-time friend of [Shin](https://anilist.co/character/16058). She works with him as a cleaner for [En](https://anilist.co/character/16060), who is her older cousin.

Noi has pink-white hair and red eyes. She is the fourth tallest character in the series and is very muscular. As a result, other characters are often unsure of her sex at first, until she opens her mouth or takes off her mask. Beneath the mask, she is a beautiful woman with long hair that often looks slightly disheveled. Her ears are pierced multiple times, with five piercings on each ear. Usually, Noi wears a zip-up tracksuit with her name on it in several places, gloves, and sneakers, though she also has other outfits for formal occasions. She wears a blue gimp mask with an exposed "skeletal" mouth, looking similar to a cenobite from the Hellraiser movies. The mask appears to have been patched with duct tape on top, similarly to the tracksuit, that seems to have duct tape around both the forearms including wrists and the calves.

Noi is very confident and carefree. So carefree, in fact, that as Shin mentions, later on, she has stopped trying to avoid attacks because she can easily heal herself. Noi enjoys fighting and often competes with her dear senpai to see who can kill the most. Her bold personality can get her into trouble because she doesn't bother to carefully observe her surroundings. The person she shows the greatest affection and respect towards is Shin. She has a large appetite.

Noi's power is healing, which is one of the rarest magic types. Her power is often used in the manga to heal [Ebisu](https://anilist.co/character/16063) or the people that En turns into mushrooms. Thanks to her ability, Noi can heal herself quickly and without physically releasing the smoke. This makes her especially resilient to physical attacks and virtually unkillable.

__Height:__ 196 cm (6'5)

Shin is an elite Magic-User, a cleaner for [En](https://anilist.co/character/16060/En), and the partner and long-time friend of [Noi](https://anilist.co/character/16059/Noi). His magic allows him to cut people up without killing them.

Shin is a tall man of muscular build, with short blonde hair, blue eyes, and pale skin. He is often seen in a formal suit while wearing a heart shaped mask backwards. He uses glasses when he isn't wearing his mask. He has stitches running along his arms and hands from his surgery to gain magic powers. He usually uses a hammer to fight, which is his primary weapon of choice besides his magic. Shin has a young looking face without any facial hair, but with a noticeable forehead, which wasn't very obvious at the beginning of the manga, though it became more prominent with the progress in art style. He also had spiky hair, but especially in later chapters his hair is closer to a more realistic or at least shorter hairstyle. As a teenager, Shin used to wear his then very long hair styled in a ponytail. At that time of his life he didn't yet wear glasses, so it can be assumed that with time, Shin's eyesight has gotten progressively worse since then.

Despite his job as En's cleaner, Shin has a very easy-going personality and is rather approachable by all within the En family. He cares deeply for his partner, Noi, and the two share a close bond as a result. Though Shin is seen to be rather modest around Noi, since he is often embarrassed by her displays of affection, he does return it on occasion. He does not kill without reason, though it doesn't seem to detract from his enjoyment of the brutal nature of his job, as he is commonly seen grinning during challenging fights. Between himself and his partner, Shin acts as the more observant of the two, and usually remains calm and collected in order to counteract Noi's impulsiveness. He always eats fast and sleeps with one eye open, this is an old habit from his past life in Hole, which he developed after almost being lynched by people who found out he had Magic User blood in his veins.

Shin's magic allows him to slice up anything. He can use this ability to slice up living beings without worrying about the victim bleeding out and dying from organ failure, although their flesh will still rot. If he were to die, any current victim of his magic would immediately suffer the consequences of their wounds. Shin is also capable of projecting his smoke to stop incoming gunfire. His Smoke halting and shattering bullets on impact. Since he was born unable to actually utilize his magic at will, Shin cut off his hands and arms in a self-inflicted surgical procedure in order to find the smoke veins.

Ebisu is a young, androgynous and sullen looking woman who first appears in chapter three, donning a skull shaped mask. She is walking through the Hole, unable to summon a door back to the Magic Users' world due to the barrier between worlds currently in effect. She runs in to [Caiman](https://anilist.co/character/9192/Kaiman) and [Nikaido](https://anilist.co/character/16057/Nikaido), who advance on her in their common fashion. Caiman cuts off Ebisu's fingers to prevent her from using magic, and bites down on her head after removing her mask. Before he can withdraw to ask her his "question", a frantic [Fujita](https://anilist.co/character/16062/Fujita) appears from a door behind her and forcefully pulls her out of his clamped down jaws, in to the door. This sudden and jerky movement causes trauma to her face and head, but they both get to safety.   After this incident, Ebisu is shown to be haunted by nightmares - and has become somewhat insane. At [En](https://anilist.co/character/16060/En)'s residence, she is restrained until [Noi](https://anilist.co/character/16059/Noi) can properly heal and restore her fingers and face. Past that point, it is evident her head trauma caused some (supposedly temporary,) brain damage as seen in her suddenly eccentric behavior. She is commonly seen with Fujita in the manga panels, possibly leading to believe that they are 'partners' now.   Her smoke is not seen directly, but records state she is skilled in Reptile transformation. However between panels it shows her having attacked someone with a surplus of power after being fed Black Powder by someone who appeared to have met her before.

__Height:__ 183 cm (6'0")

Boss of the En family and is an elite Magic User. He is cousins with Noi and Kikurage's partner. He's also good friends with Chidaruma, who is the most powerful Devil. En controls most of if not all business within the Magic-User realm and is regarded as one of the strongest Magic Users in the world. He's shown to be a man who has a large expansive group of lackeys, and is currently Noi and Shin's boss.

Typically seen in loosely worn formal attire and wears his long, red hair spiked upwards. He has a large forehead and menacing eyes further defined by his lack of eyebrows. His mask consists solely of a mouthpiece resembling something between a gas mask and the mouth of a skull. Beneath the mask, he is revealed to have a thin mustache with a goatee. En is cool and confident in everything he does. He often enjoys quietly drinking tea or tending to his exotic garden of mushrooms. En is very full of himself and his capabilities. The very thought of someone laying a finger on him in a fight, the world's most powerful magic user, can cause him to lose control of his emotions and go berserk, turning everything and everyone caught in the crossfire into mushrooms. Despite being a pretty big narcissist, he has shown that he truly does care about the members of his family. He is especially fond of Kikurage, often worrying about her safety and well being above everyone else. Regardless of what others think or wish, En's desires come first and he'll do anything to get his way, even if that means killing, kidnapping or forcing them to do as he says, forgoing a more diplomatic approach.

En possesses a powerful transformative type ability that allows the smoke he can exhale from his mouth or fingers to turn whatever it touches into mushrooms. Despite the somewhat silly nature of his magic, by his own admission, most don’t understand the truly terrifying degree to which he has mastered his ability. The various applications of En’s power appear only to be limited by his creativity.

Fujita is a magic user residing in the Magic user’s domain, working for a company headed by En: a powerful magic user. Fujita isn’t a very good magic user at all, himself-- the only times he manages to produce any magical smoke at all are times when he or someone he cares about are in a bit of a bind. For example, when in the Hole (the domain of non-users,) he and a friend of his are stopped by Caiman, a nonuser who is mysteriously unaffected by magic due to his mutations. His friend is killed by Caiman, and in a scurry to get away with his own life he uses his smoke to open a door between the realms-- something that takes a fair bit of skill to do, as remarked by several characters later on.    Wanting to avenge his comrade, Fujita sets out to return to Hole heavily armed but is stopped by a messenger of En, who passes on the message that he’s been assigned to find the user who transformed Caiman into a saurian. A bit of research reveals a reptilian transformation specialist-- Ebisu. Fujita recalls passing her while in the Hole with his friend-- and so, goes to find her before Caiman can kill her, too. Fujita’s timing is just right, and so he manages to save Ebisu just as she’s stuck in the jaws of Caiman, her fingers broken clean off after she attempts to use her smoke on him. Unfortunately, her life comes at the price of her sanity and her face-- En assigns one of the higher-ups, Noi, to heal Ebisu’s face and fingers. Although physically in one piece once again, Ebisu is still traumatized by the incident, her personality reverted back to that of a small child and memory obliterated.    Noi and Shin are sent to exterminate Caiman-- Fujita tagging along partially because he wants revenge, partially to watch after Ebisu, of whose memory everyone is waiting on to return.

Risu couldn't produce any magic smoke. Believing himself to be one of the many magically-impaired members of sorcerer society, he joined the CrossEyes organization to make a living. ~!Risu later discovered that he actually possessed a very rare magical ability - the power of Curse. Overjoyed, he told his best friend Aikawa the good news. Little did he know that Aikawa was actually the unwilling alter-ego of the CrossEyes Boss.  As soon as the Boss learned of this ability, he murdered Risu and attempted to claim his Curse power, but it would not be so easy. Risu's Curse power activated upon death, releasing an avenging specter that proved too much for even the CrossEyes Boss to handle. Years later, Risu was resurrected and fused with his Curse specter. His Curse power will not let him rest until the one who killed him is dead.!~

~!Aikawa is one of Ai's several alter-egos. He's an easy going guy who loves good food and always stands up for his friends. However, because he shares a body with the psychopathic Kai, another one of Ai's alter-egos, anyone Aikawa gets close to tends to meet an untimely death. This is because anything Aikawa overhears Kai learns too. Even Aikawa's best friend, Risu, fell victim to Kai after he told Aikawa of his newly-discovered magical abilities. Aikawa hates Kai and tries to sabotage him any way he can, even attempting to kill himself to take Kai down with him. Alas, their body isn't that easy to destroy.!~

Kai is the Boss of the CrossEyes organization, whose symbol and namesake comes from the cross marks around Kai's eyes. Kai's only two interests are food and power. He is a ruthless killer who targets powerful sorcerers and butchers them to appropriate their magical abilities. But he has his own ability, as well: an aura which has the same effect as Hole's rain, crippling any sorcerers in its range. Though Kai's murderous exploits started as relatively low-key, they later escalated to genocidal proportions, amassing mountains of corpses to fuel his scientific experiments.

~!He is one of Ai's several alter-egos which share the same body.!~

__Height:__ 155 cm (5'0)

A doctor from the Hole who in the past helped [Shin](https://anilist.co/character/16058/Shin) get to Magic Users world. He has a laboratory where he researches magic users and their magic. He is actually 64 years old and keeps his young appearance thanks to magic smoke he produced.

~!He is married to the Devil and Magic User [Haru](https://anilist.co/character/40984/Haru).!~

He's a cockroach, 2 years old, 268 cm tall. Became huge in size because of the rainwater where he lived in.
Pretty much there for comedic effect, as well as part of Dr. Vaux's baseball team. His catch phrase is, "Shocking!".

Dokuga is one of five generals of the Crosseyes Gang, who serve directly under the Boss. Dokuga's magic is poisonous saliva, which isolates him even among his friends, and restrains him from expressing emotions such as anger or laughter, since any stray spittle is extremely dangerous. This makes Dokuga calm, intelligent, and focused. He cares a lot about his comrades, and is fanatically loyal to the Crosseyes Boss, whom he admires for giving meaning to his life in a world that rejected him. He is willing to do anything the Boss asks of him, perhaps because this is the only form of affection he can safely express. Dokuga is surprisingly strong for his size, and is a very mobile fighter highly skilled in the use of knives.

Kikurage (named after the Judas' Ear mushroom) is a devil animal who [En](https://anilist.co/character/16060/En) adopted into his Family because she has the very rare magic of resurrection. As long as a sorcerer's devil tumor is intact, Kikurage can bring them back to life. Kikurage has developed a close bond with another member of the En Family, [Ebisu](https://anilist.co/character/16063/Ebisu).
Chidaruma is leader of the Devils. He is friends with En and is very interested in Ai's tinkering with magical science.
~!Doctor Kasukabe's wife, she was a magic user before turning into a devil.!~

Chota is an elite Magic-User, one of the "big brass" of The En Family, and the most avid fanatic of En. He is completely obsessed with En and ever-hopeful of being his partner. 

(Source: Dorohedoro Wiki)

A magic user who used to take care of Nikaido as a child and her friend Yakumo. He was a devil named Asu. ~!Chidaruma, the strongest and naturally born devil, turned Kawajiri into a magic user again, because he hid information about Nikaido from other devils.!~

He is The Gyoza Fairy, currently residing in this restaurant called "Hungry Bug". His body is made of raw gyoza, he is as large as a beer can, but he is invisible to humans. His job is to make gyoza taste delicious. He does things like cooling the beer with pure willpower or putting in some chili oil for those who forgot to. However! He has no mercy for wretches who make light of gyoza!

Natsuki joined the CrossEyes because she believed they were working to make the world a better place for sorcerers who didn't have useful magic. For a long time she thought she had no magical abilities, but she later found out that she has powerful defensive magic which could repel any attack. She wanted to stay with the CrossEyes and be the Boss' bodyguard, but the Boss had other plans for her.
Thirteen is an ordinary human from Hole. He is friends with Bauks and has a crush on Nikaido.

Turkey is a member of the En Family. Her magic allows them to cook up living (though mute) copies of people from pictures or memories. The copies are drawn to the location of the originals, living or dead.

Ai Coleman used to be a quiet and withdrawn boy from Hole. He was raised by his grandfather, and was neglected by him. But Ai was a very intelligent kid, and the absence of stimulation in his life left him quite bored and depressed. He spent his time reading books. Or at least one about sorcerers written by Dr. Kasukabe. Ai hated living in Hole, and he hated that sorcerers came there to experiment on humans, but he was also fascinated by them. And so, Ai decided he'd find a way to become a magic user.

Though Dr. Kasukabe tried to dissuade him, claiming it was impossible for a human to become a sorcerer, Ai was more clever. He figured out a way to incorporate powers from sorcerers by undergoing dangerous surgeries and experimenting on himself. Using these methods, Ai amassed a vast amount of power and left a trail of carnage in his wake. He surpassed the strongest sorcerers and set his sights even higher - to become like the Devils who rule over the sorcerers, and perhaps to surpass them too.

~!For most of the story Ai lived in a dimensional distortion inside "Kaiman," which was a kind of microcosm of Hole. He appeared as a boy who was missing the top half of his body and spoke with gurgling "splosh" noises coming from his exposed entrails. Ai very rarely left this dimensional distortion because his outer body was a zombie after having died and been revived on Living Dead Day. Instead, he exerted his influence from within by managing the multiple heads and spare body parts of his other personalities.!~

Vaux, more commonly known to everyone in Hole as "Doc", owns a hospital that treats Magic user victims. His job is morbid and gorey and he doesn't always manage to save his patients, but without him, many more residents of Hole would die.
Tanba is the company president of a meat pie shop (also called "Tanba") in the magic user world. Fukuyama and Kirion are his employees, and Kaiman worked for him for a time.

Tetsujo is one of the five CrossEyes Officers. He lost his right eye defending Dokuga, another CrossEyes Officer, back when they were both kids. Despite this, Tetsujo is an excellent swordsman. He is very insightful and resourceful when he needs to be, though his hot temper sometimes gets him into trouble.
Member of En's family, an assassin. His magic ability is becoming invisible whenever he wants.

A girl that together with Fukuyama works in Tanba's restaurant in the magic user world. She is immune to the effects of Hole's rain which cripple other sorcerers, which suggests she is either a human from Hole or a human/sorcerer hybrid.
Ton is one of the five Cross Eyes Officers. He is a talented knife thrower and loves to eat. His name means "Pig."

Hole has a long ragged sheet like head with black whorled bleeding eyes and multiple thin horns that circles it's head. Hole wears a big jacket with large pockets all over his chest to his legs. Hole also has thorn like horns poking out of it's arms along with some longs sharp claws running from his mitten like hands.

Hole is very tall (about twice the size of the average devil) at 4 meters tall and the things it can do with it's body is unknown. For example its mouth can only be visible when it's about to consume somebody and flow little people from it's eyes and mouth that drag it's enemies into it's mouth.

His debut appearance color scheme consisted in a uniform pallet of grey, later it was changed to a more remarked color difference, with a black overall clothes and his arms and mask white.
Fukuyama works at Tanba's pie shop. His magical abilities allow him to turn anything and anyone into meat pies.
Saji is one of the five Cross Eyes Officers. He is younger than he looks, and wishes his face wasn't so old for his age.
Ushishimada is one of the five Cross Eyes Officers. He is short and stocky, but very strong, and could bend iron bars. He has the word "cow" in his name.

Asuka is a former Tanba restaurant's employee and has an unrequited love for her boss. She wears a bat-shaped mask that covers her entire face, leaving only her mouth and eyes exposed, her hair is black and spiky and she wears clothes with cleavage and mice hanging from them. Her troubled personality prevents her from advancing in her relationship with Tanba, however, she has always tried to conquer him using her magic.

**Height:** 191 cm

Syueron is a human from Hole and he was the former owner of the shop that became the Hungry Bug. At his shop, Syueron sold tea and desserts that were very popular with magic users and thus he became a target of the Magic-User haters of Hole.
One of the new members of the cross-eyes, who joined in the gang to find the black powder.

Kirie Goshima, a schoolgirl in the town of Kurouzucho, becomes concerned with her boyfriend Shuichi Saito’s father who has become obsessed with collecting and staring at spiral patterns to the ignorance of all else. After Shuichi’s father kills himself inside a washing machine, his cremated remains hang over the town in a giant cloud. The obsessive behaviour starts to spread to Kirie’s father and others, while all around the town people start bodily mutating into spiral creatures.
Shuichi is Kirie's boyfriend. He is the only one who feels and understands the fact that the town is cursed by the spiral.
Azami Kurotami is a high school student from Midoriyama-Shi who goes to the same school as Kirie in Kurôzu-Cho.
A seventh grader who was in same school as [Kirie Goshima](https://anilist.co/character/6540/Kirie-Goshima) who loved to jump out and surprise people. He also had a crush on her.
A news reporter from Toyo TV.
Shuichi's father. One day he stopped going to work to study "the art of the spiral", creating an abnormal obsession with that shape.
One of Kirie's classmates. Only comes to school when it's raining.

One of Kirie Goshima's school friends.
~! After Kirie's hair was affected by the spiral in 'Medusa', Kyoko becomes obsessively jealous from all the attention Kirie was getting, leading to Kyoko to spiral her own hair. !~
Kirie's pregnant cousin.
Kazunori Nishiki's lover.
Kirie's childhood classmate. Had fallen in love with Yoriko Endo.

Kirie's younger brother.

~!Later on, he turns into a snail!~
The father of Kirie Goshima and Mitsuo Goshima who is a potter situated next to Dragonfly Pond.
Shuichi's mom. After her husband developed an obsession with spirals, she developed an uncontrollable fear for that shape.

Develops a crush on Azami Kurotani because he is drawn in her scar in "The Scar".
~! Later in the same chapter, he is interested in Azami's growing spiral, touches it and is consumed by it. !~
Kirie's classmate.
Neighbors with the Goshima's when they moved into the row house. Had an infatuation to Kirie.
A doctor that delivers (and un-delivers) babies.

Kirie and Shuichi's school teacher.
~! Afflicted with the same snail transformation as Katayama and Tsumura !~
The mother of Kirie and Mitsuo Goshima and the wife of Yasuo Goshima.

Kirie's classmate and bully to Katayama.
~! Although he is later afflicted with same snail transformation as Katayama and mates with him. !~
An astronomer and a close friend of Mr. Yokota.

She is the girl that [Yuuta](https://anilist.co/character/270546/Itou-Yuuta) meets on the hospital roof where he was about to commit suicide.

She likes movies and chooses to exploit her passion to help Yuuta create a movie himself.
A boy tasked to film his mother's disease battle.
She is suffering from an unspecified terminal illness and asks her son to record her final months.

She is friends with Yuuta and Eri. After Dead Mother Explosion is aired at the school festival, she criticizes the ending but expresses understanding about the rest, as her own mother had passed a year before.
A nurse who is close to Yuuta's mother and presumably treats her. Yuuta mispronounces her name as "Taguchi".

Frieren is the protagonist of _Sousou no Frieren_ and [Fern](https://anilist.co/character/183965)'s master. She was the Mage of the Hero Party and traveled alongside Hero [Himmel](https://anilist.co/character/184311/Himmel), Warrior [Eisen](https://anilist.co/character/184312/Eisen), and Priest [Heiter](https://anilist.co/character/184310/Heiter) in a 10-year journey to defeat the Demon King. 

She was a magic prodigy at a young age, with an impressive quantity of mana, which caught the interest of [Flamme](https://anilist.co/character/219733/Flamme), a human wizard who taught her everything there is to know about magic and mana control until she passed away. Frieren persists in collecting magic knowledge no matter how trivial it may be.

Fern is the young mage apprentice of [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren) and accompanies her as a member of her party.
