She is an orphaned war refugee originally from the Southern Lands, later adopted by  [Heiter](https://anilist.co/character/184310/Heiter) and placed under Frieren's care.

Stark is a warrior who fights alongside [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren) and [Fern](https://anilist.co/character/183965/Fern). After his village was attacked by demons, he fled and became [Eisen](https://anilist.co/character/184312/Eisen)'s apprentice. At Eisen's instruction, he joined Frieren's party as their vanguard.

Hero and Leader of the party that defeated the Demon King, and a self-proclaimed handsome narcissist. He cares about his friends and can't help but help those in need. He had a great influence on [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren), with whom he had adventures for 10 years.

Übel is a third-class mage. Was disqualified in an earlier examination due to killing a first-class wizard. Specializes in magic that allows her to copy the spells of people she can empathize with. Relies mostly on her intuition and is not bound by logical reasoning. ~!Becomes a first-class mage after the examination.!~
Dwarf warrior who was a part of the Hero's party, later became a mentor to [Stark](https://anilist.co/character/184313/Stark).
A priest who is a part of the Hero's party. He later took care of [Fern](https://anilist.co/character/183965/Fern) until [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren) arrived.
She lived a millennium before the story and was [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren)'s teacher.

Sein is a Priest from a small village in the Alt Woods. After [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren) spotted his talent, he joined her group for a period of time with the goal of reuniting with his childhood friend Gorilla.

An elven mage who is said to possess knowledge about nearly every magic that exists. She was Flamme's master. She founded the Continental Magic Association around 20 years before Himmel's death. First-class mages get the privilege of meeting her and can ask for any magic they desire.

Denken is an imperial mage of the second-class. In his youth he belonged to an army but became an imperial mage after winning a power struggle. Often calm and calculating, however he still has a fire burning within despite his old age. He saw [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren) as his motivation to become a mage. ~!Becomes a first-class mage after the examination.!~
A mage that can use restraint and mental manipulation magic. Good at detecting mana and can use simple recovery magic.
First-class mage that is proctoring the Second Exam of the First Class Mage Examination. She is a solemn person who rarely speaks.

Second-class mage and the leader of the eighth party during the first stage of the First Class Mage Exam. He is the captain of the Northern Magic Corps and is thus a very experienced mage. Specializes in magic that restrains the opponent when their body is in full-view.

Macht is a demon and a member of the Seven Sages of Destruction that directly serve the Demon King.

He wishes to understand human emotions and find a solution for humans and demons to coexist.
He strives for this goal by utilizing inhumane methods.

personnages.surnom: Dantoudai no Aura (断頭台のアウラ)
personnages.description:
Aura is one of the Seven Sages of Destruction directly serving the Demon King. 

~!She later was killed by [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren) after being commanded to kill herself using her own Auserlese.!~
Lawine is a third-class mage in the Second Party of the First Class Mage Examinations. She specializes in manipulating ice.
Second-class mage in the Fourth Party of the First Class Mage Examination. He specializes in illusion magic.

Kanne is a third-class mage who graduated from the Academy of Magic. She is childhood friends and classmates with [Lawine](https://anilist.co/character/293727), and the two entered the first-class mage exam together. In the first stage of the exam, she was paired with Lawine and [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754).
A third-class mage. Specializes in magic that makes her move at high speed. Treats [Denken](https://anilist.co/character/246058/Denken) as her grandfather.
He is an elf that Frieren's group meets in a cabin in the mountains. He's a monk and believed to be the last elf alive until meeting Frieren.

Linie is a Demon working under [Aura](https://anilist.co/character/219110/Aura). Under Aura's instruction, she was sent to assist [Lügner](https://anilist.co/character/316985/Lgner) alongside [Draht](https://anilist.co/character/316987/Draht) to perform negotiations with [Graf Granat](https://anilist.co/character/318147/Granat-Hakushaku).
First-class mage who was a proctor for the first examination.
The Hero of the South is a Hero who fought on the front lines against the demons for mankind before Himmel met Frieren. He was said to be mankind's strongest.
Stark's older brother, referred to as the strongest warrior in the village.
Lügner was a demon who served [Aura the Guillotine](https://anilist.co/character/219110/Aura).
Elderly Dwarf warrior and a long-time friend of Frieren. He resides in a village in the Klar Region.

Solitär is a demon who conducts research on living creatures, including humans, and an acquaintance of Macht, sharing an interest in humankind. Beneath her nonchalant attitude, however, lies an extremely dangerous demon, comparable to the members of the Seven Sages of Destruction.

"If you ever encounter a nameless Great Demon, flee without hesitation. Every single Great Demon that possesses vast mana, without exception, has lived for eons. However, if there is still no such record of them amongst mankind, there is a strong possibility that everyone who encountered them was massacred." -Frieren
Second-class mage in the Eighth Party, alongside Wirbel and Scharf, in the First Class Mage Exam. Fern feels that she is the strongest within both the Fourth and Eighth parties.

personnages.surnom: Fuhai no Ken Rou (腐敗の賢老)
personnages.description: A feared and powerful demon who served the Demon King.
Second-class mage who participates in the First Class Mage Exam at the same time as Frieren and Fern. He owns a magical store in Äußerst where he specializes in repairing broken staves.
Edel is a second-class mage in the Seventeenth Party, alongside Blei and Dunst, of the First Class Mage Exam. She specializes in Hypnosis Magic.
Ruler of Graf Granat's Domain, a fortified city in the Northern Lands constantly at war with Aura.

The current chief of the Village of the Sword. Her position was inherited. She is young for the position and postures to try to make up for her lack of height, but when faced with danger or matters regarding the Hero's Blade, she is collected and calm.
Scharf is a third-class mage and member of the eighth party along with Wirbel and Ehre for the First Class Mage Examination.

An old friend of Denken. First Class Mage and Serie's apprentice. Rarely acts directly, preferring stealth.
~!Helped in the extraction and transfer of information necessary for the liberation of Denken's hometown.!~
Revolte, also known as Divine Revolte, is a demon general. Revolte wields four swords made of magic.
Glück is the feudal lord of the Fortified City of Weise.
Nobleman presiding over the Vorig Fortified City and the current head of the Orden family, one of the Three Great Knightly Houses of the Northern Lands.
Participant in the examination for the title of mage first class. Slightly distracted girl. Likes to read books and learn new spells.

Miyagi is a store clerk at a special store. She's the observer of [Kusunoki](https://anilist.co/character/132152/Kusunoki).

~!In the end, Miyagi sells her remaining lifespan so she and Kusunoki can have 3 days of life left. This releases her of her observer duty, making her visible to everyone.!~
He is a twenty-something man with nothing much left and he can barely pay for his rent or food.
She is [Kusunoki](https://anilist.co/character/132152/Kusunoki)'s only childhood friend.

personnages.nom_natif: フォスフォフィライト
personnages.description:
**Hardness**: 3.5 ~!(legs: 7; head: 5)!~

The main protagonist and the youngest gem when the story began. They're weak, brittle - not suited for battle - and their clumsiness makes them difficult to maintain any roles, even though they've always wanted to be useful. Phos' initial job was to make a natural history encyclopedia which they progressed very little on. They promised to help [Cinnabar](https://anilist.co/character/123384/Cinnabar) find a job suited for them as well.

Phos is a young, overconfident, clumsy, and naive gem, who is the only one capable of getting away with talking back to [Kongou](https://anilist.co/character/123394/Kongou). Many gems describe them as lazy and useless due to their fragility and incompetence, although Phos does display a drive to help Sensei and the others, often held back by their low hardness. There is an underlying way of how Phos acts and speaks about themselves that hints at them taking the “useless” and “lazy” comments to heart, and impacting their self-esteem. These facts indicate that Phos may have something of an inferiority complex. They settle with what they can do and constantly state that they will try better next time. Phos displays a change of personality over the course of the series, mainly due to maturing, trauma, and outside influences. This is mainly due to the fact that the gems are not equipped to deal with trauma.

Phosphophyllite wears a standard winter uniform and black shoes without socks, occasionally accompanied by long black gloves. Phos has mint-green features known by the gems and the Admirabilis as the Lunarians' favorite color. Their hair is short, originally just beneath the ears, but cut shorter in later chapters to imitate [Antarcticite](https://anilist.co/character/124307/Antarcticite)'s hairstyle.

**Hardness**: 2

The only gem who goes on night patrol. Due to their body producing Mercury (which is harmful to gems and living things), they are isolated and insecure. They hate fighting and hate to be seen.

According to [Rutile](https://anilist.co/character/123399/Rutile), Cinnabar has an extraordinary amount of talent and combat ability, but is too much to handle due to their uncontrollable poison. Cinnabar's silver poison gathers faint light at night, which keeps them awake and aware while night patrolling. According to [Kongou](https://anilist.co/character/123394/Kongou), the night patrol is something Cinnabar came up with themselves. They used to spend their time during the day in Hollow Cape, waiting for the Lunarians to take them since they thought they may at least be of use to them. They are knowledgeable about things other gems don't know about.

[Phosphophyllite](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite) was recommended by the gems to see Cinnabar for the encyclopedia. After accidentally hearing their secret and wish, Phos promises to help Cinnabar find a job more suited to them than night patrol, saying, "a fun job only you can do." When encountering Phos each time, Cinnabar seems doubtful of their words, but they are the only gem they regularly speak to. Although they try not to show it, they have a tiny sliver of hope that Phos will be able to fulfill their promise.

Cinnabar is able to pull out an abundant amount of mercury. They're able to manipulate it in the air, from a distance, and around them. They seem to not be in full control over it and sometimes release it without wanting to.

**Hardness**: 10

One of the gems who mainly does patrol duty. They're partners with [Bort](https://anilist.co/character/123389/Bort). Despite Diamond's high offensive power, their toughness is second-rate and easily broken. The other gems consider them lovely and a top fashion model.

Diamond is friendly, kind, and gentle. They appear to be relatively calm during battle, even when their situation isn't good. However, they are actually insecure and frustrated with their current body which, though being the hardest, shatters easily. They dislike being compared to Bort, although they admire their younger sibling a lot. They are perceptive regarding gems' inner feelings and relationships, though [Cinnabar](https://anilist.co/character/123384/Cinnabar) accuses them of seeing everything as some kind of romance. Despite Diamond's more gentle nature, they're very stubborn and tend to fight until they shatter. From Bort's point of view, Diamond is extremely reckless.

~!Diamond is one of the gems who accompanies [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite) to the moon. They tell Phos that they "want to go somewhere without Bort".!~

__Hardness:__ 3

Antarcticite is the gem assigned to winter duty while the others hibernate. Due to their crystal composition, Antarc "sleeps" in liquid form when it is above room-temperatures, and re-crystallizes when the temperature drops. The colder the temperature, the harder they become.

Antarc is a perfectionist who acts like a soldier, marching and speaking with extreme formality. They are used to working alone, as all the other gems hibernate during the winter. Despite their usual cold attitude, Antarc has a soft side, and they love [Kongou](https://anilist.co/character/123394/Kongou) more than anything, often breaking their usual icy demeanor around him. They do not like to openly show this softer side though, becoming extremely embarrassed when [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite) sees them like that.

__Hardness:__ 9

One of the elder gems who mainly does patrol duty, but is currently inactive. Padparadscha was born with an incomplete torso, which affects their consciousness. They're partners with [Rutile](https://anilist.co/character/123399/Rutile), who also maintains their health.

Padpa is easygoing, but knows a lot more than what they let on. They want the other gems to stop worrying about them, and would like to sleep in order not to burden anyone.

__Hardness:__ 10

One of the gems who mainly does patrol duty. They're partners with [Diamond](https://anilist.co/character/123390/Diamond). Bort is a diamond-class gem whose hardness and toughness are top level. They are a calm yet ruthless warrior who excel at battles and are obsessed with combat. The other gems call them a "battle maniac".

Bort is an efficient and analytic fighter, often pointing out the flaws in the other gems' tactics in a blunt and straightforward manner. This causes them to be seen as cold and scary to the others, but also to be respected, looked up to, and seen as reliable. Despite their harsh personality, they do have a softer side.

__Hardness:__ 5

A gem that was taken to the moon before the beginning of the story, leaving only their head behind on Earth. Lapis was in charge of the library, a position now taken up by their former partner [Ghost Quartz](https://anilist.co/character/128723/Ghost-Quartz).

Lapis was clever, confident, and charming, with keen observation and great deductive thinking skills. [Euclase](https://anilist.co/character/123391/Euclase) remarks that although Lapis was extremely smart and pleasant to talk to, they would rather use their skills to satisfy their own intellectual curiosity rather than for the benefit of others. This meant they could be quite manipulative at times. [Cairngorm](https://anilist.co/character/124600/Cairngorm) describes Lapis as "surprisingly deceiving" and excellent at keeping secrets.

~!After [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite) loses their head in a battle against the Lunarians, Cairngorm asks [Kongou](https://anilist.co/character/123394/Kongou) for permission to use Lapis's head as a substitute. He agrees, and their head is attached to Phos's body. This new head influences their personality; most notably, Phos inherits Lapis's deductive and strategic abilities, and becomes more attentive to details. Lapis’s personality also adds a more secretive and manipulative nature to Phos.

Not long after the head is first attached, Lapis appears in Phos's dream, explaining that they left a "message" in their inclusions just in case another gem used their head. They tell Phos that they also wanted to understand the Lunarians, but they were distracted by trying to rationalize the Lunarians' illogical actions during a battle, resulting in them being shot by arrows and taken to the moon.!~

**Hardness:** Unknown

Kongou is the teacher of the lustrous. He has a vast amount of knowledge and has the power to drive away the Lunarians with a single attack.

Normally, Kongou is quiet and stoic. When he speaks, he is straightforward and concise. He only rarely displays emotions, but this is rumored to be because he is deliberately hiding them and that his face would be very easy to read otherwise. On the rare occasions where he shows humor, he is still as deadpan as ever. Kongou cares for the Gems considerably and blames himself when they are injured or taken away by the Lunarians.

~!He is actually a prayer machine built by [Dr. Ayumu](https://anilist.co/character/285150/Ayumu), who Kongou sees as his mother.!~

**Hardness**: 6

A gem who works as a doctor. They repair cracked or broken gems and handle the management of herbs, pastes, powders, and other medical remedies. They are partners with the unstable [Padparadscha](https://anilist.co/character/124485/Padparadscha), whose body is actively being maintained. Besides repairs, Rutile is responsible for carrying out regular physical checkups and applying powder and saltwater resin to the gems' bodies.

Rutile is a workaholic takes their job very seriously. They are known to stay up all night if needed to put a gem back together. As a result, they are often tired and will take naps during the day. They are also a bit eccentric and sarcastic, and to take great pride in their job and research. They don't take well to having their medical authority questioned. Even so, they become easily embarrassed when pestered about things like love.

They are very close to Padparadscha. Hundreds of thousands of failed operations to fix them have not made them lose hope. They believe they cannot be called a doctor if they cannot solve Padparadscha's condition. They are extremely dedicated, bordering on obsessed with this task.

~!Rutile's mental state is broken after [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite) takes Padparadscha to the moon without telling anyone. They have become more impulsive and feral in nature, and have abandoned their job as a doctor.!~

personnages.nom_natif: イエローダイヤモンド
personnages.description:
__Hardness:__ 10

The oldest gem, who mostly does patrol duty. They're partners with [Zircon](https://anilist.co/character/123401/Zircon). Yellow Diamond is cheerful yet mature, and feels responsible for all of their siblings.

Throughout their life, Yellow has had several partners—[Green Diamond](https://anilist.co/character/393651/Green-Diamond), [Ruby](https://anilist.co/character/393652/Ruby), [Sapphire](https://anilist.co/character/393650/Sapphire), and [Pink Topaz](https://anilist.co/character/393648/Pink-Topaz)—but they were all taken to the moon. Yellow struggles with low self-esteem and possible self-loathing for constantly letting their partners be taken by the Lunarians, and also questions why they bother fighting anymore.

~!They are one of the gems who accompanies [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite) to the moon.!~

~!During their time on the moon, Yellow gradually becomes more and more mentally unstable, and eventually even begins to suffer from delusions, thinking of themselves as a Lunarian and becoming distressed whenever they realize they're really a gem.!~

__Hardness:__ 7

Cairngorm is the inner crystal of [Ghost Quartz](https://anilist.co/character/128723/Ghost-Quartz), who has a multilayered structure. "Cairngorm", the name given to them by [Kongou-sensei](https://anilist.co/character/123394/Kongou), is a variety of smoky quartz.

~!In a battle with the Lunarians, the outer layer of Ghost Quartz is stripped off and taken to the moon, leaving the inner Cairngorm behind. Afterwards, they take up Ghost's duties in their stead.

Ghost Quartz described Cairngorm as "rude, violent, and selfish", and said they would only listen to their old partner, [Lapis Lazuli](https://anilist.co/character/130062/Lapis-Lazuli). But although Cairngorm was initially infuriated with [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite) for "letting" Ghost get taken, they begin to act much kinder, and even become quite protective of them. The two gems become partners and are both assigned to winter duty.!~

~!However, Phos and Cairngorm are never able to go on winter duty together, because Phos gets attacked and their head gets taken to the moon. Afterwards, Cairngorm pleads with [Kongou-sensei](https://anilist.co/character/123394/Kongou) to use Lapis Lazuli's head to repair them. In fact, they are so desperate to repair Phos that they even offer up their own head as an option. During Phos's 102 year rest, Cairngorm tackles winter duty alone, and frequently visits the comatose Phos.!~

~!Later in the manga, Cairngorm reluctantly goes to the moon with Phos. Not long after, [Prince Aechmea](https://anilist.co/character/133785/Aechmea) questions Cairngorm's extreme dedication to Phos and, upon examining the gem closely, discovers that their eyes still contain traces of Ghost Quartz which are affecting Cairngorm's behavior. After removing those traces, Cairngorm's behavior changes drastically: they remove their powder, begin dressing in feminine clothing, no longer seem to feel attachment towards Phos or Lapis Lazuli, and most notably, become extremely close with Aechmea. They have a very lovey-dovey relationship with eachother and soon get married, making Cairngorm the "princess" of the Lunarians.!~

__Hardness:__ 7

A gem in charge of the library and convalescent center, though they sometimes do patrol duty as well. Ghost Quartz has a body made of more than one crystal, meaning they have a second gem inside of them: a dark-colored crystal later named [Cairngorm](https://anilist.co/character/124600/Cairngorm), who has their own personality and is capable of communicating with Ghost. Their weapon of choice is a sickle.

Ghost Quartz is quiet, calm, and insecure about themselves. They seem to be rather isolated from the other gems. They used to be partnered with [Lapis Lazuli](https://anilist.co/character/130062/Lapis-Lazuli), who was the one in charge of the library until they were taken to the moon by the Lunarians, leaving only their head behind; Ghost was placed in charge of the library afterwards. They speak of Lapis in high regards. Although Ghost describes their inner crystal, Cairngorm, as "violent and brash", they both equally respected and followed Lapis.

~!Ghost temporarily teamed up with [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite), but during their first battle, the outer Ghost Quartz was chipped off of the underlying Cairngorm by the Lunarians and was taken to the moon, leaving only Cairngorm behind. In Ghost's final moments, it's given a clearer picture of Ghost's attitude towards Cairngorm, calling them rude, violent, selfish, and annoying. However, Ghost then entrusts Cairngorm to protect Phos after they're gone.!~

__Hardness:__ 8.5

A gem who works as an expert on the Lunarians. They are studious and passionate about this work, being referred to as a "Lunarian research maniac" by the other gems. They even draw original Lunarian designs sometimes. However, despite being a Lunarian researcher, Alexandrite is forbidden from looking at or engaging with them. This is because they have a condition where, when they look at Lunarians, they have a chance of turning into "Red Alex". In this mode, their color changes from blue to red, and they go berserk, becoming obsessed with just cutting down anything in their way until they eventually pass out.

Alex originally started researching Lunarians for two reasons: one, to overcome their condition, and two, in order to retain the "fresh feeling of hatred" they have for the Lunarians as a result of their former partner, [Chrysoberyl](https://anilist.co/character/393647/Chrysoberyl), being taken by them.

When referred to with honorifics, Alexandrite hates being called Alex-san, preferring the cuter Alex-chan. This is changed to Alexi and Lexi in the official English translation.

~!They are one of the gems who accompanies [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite) to the moon.!~
~! Aechmea is the leader of the Lunarians. !~

__Hardness:__ 7.5

A kindly and knowledgeable elder gem who does patrol duty, secretary work, strategy planning, and other odd jobs. They seem to be partners with [Jade](https://anilist.co/character/123393/Jade). Euclase is kind, intellectual, and extremely perceptive. They're also good at math, and can recite any gem's age to the day on command. They have a strong sense of responsibility and often worry over the others.

__Hardness:__ 7

A very serious gem who mainly works as [Sensei](https://anilist.co/character/123394/Kongou)'s spokesperson. They seem to be partners with [Euclase](https://anilist.co/character/123391/Euclase). Jade is responsible, hardworking, and takes things too seriously.

__Hardness:__ 7

A gem who mainly does patrol duty. They are partners with their identical twin, [Amethyst 33](https://anilist.co/character/209228).

The twins work in tandem for most things, often talking at the same time or finishing each other's sentences. No one really cares which is which anymore, including themselves. Because twin gems won't break by touching each other, the Amethysts have a habit of clanging their heads together, much to the chagrin of the other gems.

~!Later, Eighty-Four switches their hairstyle to deceive [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite) in order to go to the moon in Thirty-Three's place. On the moon, Eighty-Four has become their own individual and serves as an assistant scientist there. They seem to be highly interested in more of the psychological aspects in the science field.!~
Ruler of the Admirabilis.

__Hardness:__ 5

A gem in charge of weapon production. Energetic and bubbly, Obsidian is very dedicated to their job and will make others weapons without hesitation if requested to.

__Hardness:__ 7.5

A passionate and dedicated gem in charge of clothing. Red Beryl a workaholic who lives for their job as the fashion stylist and tailor for the other gems. Their style is very frilly, cute, and feminine, and they have a different hairstyle every day.

Red Beryl used to be partnered with Aquamarine, who was taken to the moon before the beginning of the story.

__Hardness:__ 6.5

A gem who mainly does patrol duty. They're partners with [Neptunite](https://anilist.co/character/123396/Neptunite). Benitoite is a sensible, earnest, and somewhat timid gem who has a hard time saying "no." They're insecure about their lack of individuality.

~!Benito is one of the gems who accompanies [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite) to the moon. They reveal that the reason they wanted to go is to become special, as they see themselves as too ordinary and plain.!~
Brother to [Ventricosus](https://anilist.co/character/124216/Ventricosus), ruler of the Admirabilis.

__Hardness:__ 7.5

One of the gems who mainly does patrol duty. They're partners with [Yellow Diamond](https://anilist.co/character/123400/Yellow-Diamond), and they're the second youngest after [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite).

Zircon is very hardworking, diligent, and responsible, but is also anxious, always worrying over something.

~!Pebble is a new type of rock-based lifeform that was born some time after [Phosphophyllite](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite) prayed the Lunarians away into nothingness. Since meeting Phos, the two have become kindred spirits.!~

__Hardness:__ 7.5

A gem who mainly does patrol duty. They're partners with [Goshenite](https://anilist.co/character/123392). Morganite is overconfident, reckless, and loves to tease [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite).

~!Both Morganite and Goshenite are taken to the moon shortly after Phos loses their head and begins their 102-year rest.!~

__Hardness:__ 7.5

A gem who mainly does patrol duty. They're partners with [Morganite](https://anilist.co/character/123395/Morganite). Goshenite is gentle, kind to everyone, and always has a worried expression.

~!Both Goshenite and Morganite are taken to the moon shortly after [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite) loses their head and begins their 102-year rest.!~

personnages.nom_natif: ウォーターメロントルマリン
personnages.description:
__Hardness:__ 7.5

A gem who mainly does patrol duty. They're partners with [Hemimorphite](https://anilist.co/character/123994). Watermelon is energetic, bubbly, and always has their head in the clouds.

Watermelon is also able to produce an electrical charge, which they are capable of using as an attack. It appears effective against Lunarians, and doesn't seem to effect nearby Gems.

__Hardness:__ 7

A gem who mainly does patrol duty. They are partners with their identical twin, [Amethyst 84](https://anilist.co/character/123387/Amethyst-84).

The twins work in tandem for most things, often talking at the same time or finishing each other's sentences. No one really cares which is which anymore, including themselves. Because twin gems won't break by touching each other, the Amethysts have a habit of clanging their heads together, much to the chagrin of the other gems.

~!Later, Thirty-Three expresses to [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite) that they want to go to the moon with them to practice independence from their twin. Unknown to them, however, Eighty-Four overheard and later switched their hairstyle to deceive Phos, and went to the moon in Thirty-Three's place.

Amethyst 33 has recently learned to cope with their twin leaving, and believes after 200 years that they are alright. They think 84 is doing alright as well, and still feels connected to them.!~

__Hardness:__ 5.5

A reserved, quiet gem who mainly does patrol duty. They're partners with [Benitoite](https://anilist.co/character/123388/Benitoite).

Neptunite has a sharp tongue and believes that people should face the truth head-on, regardless of how it makes them feel. Other gems comment that Nepti is very difficult to read in terms of both their mood and combat movements. [New Morganite](https://anilist.co/character/209245/Morganite) remarks that "not knowing what Nepti is saying is part of their charm".
~!Dr. Ayumu was the human who created [Kongou](https://anilist.co/character/123394/Kongou) and his [older brother](https://anilist.co/character/393580). Both machines see her as their mother.!~

__Hardness:__ 5

A sweet, calm, and dedicated elder gem in charge of industrial arts and design. They're partners with [Peridot](https://anilist.co/character/123997).

Sphene used to be partnered with [Topaz](https://anilist.co/character/393646/Topaz) about a thousand years before the beginning of the story. Topaz was taken to the moon in the same battle as Peridot's old partner, [Blue Zoisite](https://anilist.co/character/393645/Blue-Zoisite), which is the reason that Sphene and Peridot eventually decided to partner with each other.

__Hardness:__ 6.5

One of the elder gems. They're in charge of paper production and are partners with [Sphene](https://anilist.co/character/123996/Sphene).

Peridot is mature, laid-back, and a little obsessed with making paper. [Hemimorphite](https://anilist.co/character/123994/Hemimorphite) describes them as "smart and imperturbable". Peridot used to be partnered with [Blue Zoisite](https://anilist.co/character/393645/Blue-Zoisite) about a thousand years before the beginning of the story. Zoisite was taken to the moon in the same battle as Sphene's old partner, [Topaz](https://anilist.co/character/393646/Topaz), which is the reason that Peridot and Sphene eventually decided to partner with each other.

__Hardness:__ 5

A gem who mainly does patrol duty. They're partners with [Watermelon Tourmaline](https://anilist.co/character/123995/Watermelon-Tourmaline).
~!A Lunarian with a soft personality. Although somewhat unintelligent and clumsy, Cicada is friendly, upbeat, and cares a lot about Phos and the other gems.!~

__Hardness:__ 7.5

The youngest gem, who mainly does patrol duty with their partner [Morganite](https://anilist.co/character/209245). Goshe is energetic, outgoing, and carefree. They're always reassuring Morga that no one thinks badly of them, and they go out of their way to prove it. They hold [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite) in high regard due to how powerful they are.

~!They were born shortly after the original [Morganite](https://anilist.co/character/123395/Morganite) and [Goshenite](https://anilist.co/character/123392/Goshenite) were taken to the moon during Phos's 102 year rest.!~

~!They're one of the gems who accompanies Phos to the moon.!~

~!The possible lead scientist of the Lunarians, known as the "tech supervisor" to [Aechmea](https://anilist.co/character/133785/Aechmea). Barbata has a great love for the culinary arts, and is one of the best cooks on the moon. They generally seem to be a relaxed individual that prefers to go at their own pace. Barbata is incredibly smart and observant, as well as empathetic and friendly.!~

~!A highly advanced machine with artificial intelligence that was created by [Dr. Ayumu](https://anilist.co/character/285150/Ayumu). They are considered [Kongou](https://anilist.co/character/123394/Kongou)'s older brother, and both machines see Ayumu as their mother.

Once discarded by humans for purposely miscalculating a meteorite and letting it hit Earth, they now take the shape of ice floes. They stole [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite)'s arms at the Lunarians' behest. They harbor a deep resentment towards humanity (other than Ayumu), but are otherwise carefree and easygoing. They love sushi cream chips.!~

~!According to their own story, the reason they let the meteorite hit Earth was to get revenge on Ayumu's supervisor, who was taking credit for all her work, including the creation of Kongou's older brother; so they called the supervisor to the place where the meteorite would hit. Dr. Ayumu seemingly understood and forgave them, and before they could be destroyed, she switched them out with a decoy and sent them into the ocean to escape.!~

__Hardness:__ 7.5

The second youngest gem, who mainly does patrol duty with their partner [Goshenite](https://anilist.co/character/209248/Goshenite). Morga is shy and timid, choosing to let Goshe respond in their stead. They fear that no one likes them.

~!They were born shortly after the original [Morganite](https://anilist.co/character/123395/Morganite) and [Goshenite](https://anilist.co/character/123392/Goshenite) were taken to the moon during [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite)'s 102 year rest.!~

A special type of Lunarian that starts out as a giant, towering humanoid with six arms, but when attacked, it divides up into smaller and smaller forms; it eventually splits into 108 adorable, fluffy creatures resembling small dogs. When its parts are gathered back together, it goes back to its original appearance.

Shiro acts very much like a dog in all of its forms, and mysteriously, it seems affectionate and obedient towards [Kongou](https://anilist.co/character/123394/Kongou).

~!It is later revealed that Shiro is the soul of a dog that Kongou and [Dr. Ayumu](https://anilist.co/character/285150/Ayumu) once cared for together.!~
The ruler of the Admirabilis race five generations after [Ventricosus](https://anilist.co/character/124216/Ventricosus).

Qifrey is a witch and [Coco's](https://anilist.co/character/129840/Coco) teacher. He runs an atelier and currently has four disciples.

He is a caring teacher who patiently teaches his students magic. This is especially true for Coco, who has no special abilities as a witch at first but he continues to encourage her until she can draw magic skillfully. He is protective of all his disciples, as seen from how he protects them from being taken by Esheath from the Magic Security Council. However, Qifrey is overly obsessed with his goal to locate the Brimmed Hats, with his gentle attitude oftentimes replaced by a buried hatred he has always hidden. It appears he had a personal agenda against the Brimmed Hats, as well.

~!The reason Qifrey has a grudge towards the Brimmed Hats is that they are responsible for taking away his memories and right eye as a child. He was later locked in a coffin, buried under a tree, and left there to die as it slowly filled with water. Thankfully, people from the Magic Security Council and Sage Beldarut found him and rescued him from his miserable condition, which later on he would become the pupil of Sage Beldarut. Qifrey also went to the Tower of Books in order to find an answer on how to solve the problem of his missing memories and right eye, but for that, he must use forbidden magic, and as such his issue remains unsolved.!~

She is a young girl who becomes an apprentice witch under the witch [Qifrey](https://anilist.co/character/129841/) after her initial accidental use of forbidden magic turned her mother to crystal. She hopes to search the Tower of Books for the book containing the magic, in order to reverse its effects on her mother.

She is quite a dork for magic, with a child-like (even for her age) widen eyed look whenever she sees things that are common for every other witch. The very magic that inspired her was simple magic made by Qifrey's watcher that caused glowstone path to light up.

personnages.nom_natif: アガット・アークロム
personnages.description:
Agott is a witch in training and [Qifrey's](https://anilist.co/character/129841/) student. She belongs to the famous Arkrome house, who have served as librarians at the Tower of Books for generations.

She has a tendency to focus on how much more she still needs to accomplish, leading her to express dissatisfaction with her current progress. Agott suffers from self-esteem issues over being considered merely average and she takes that out on others who she doesn't think either deserves magic or have the talent to do so, which is usually [Coco](https://anilist.co/character/129840/Coco).

Richeh is a young witch in training and a disciple of [Qifrey](https://anilist.co/character/129841/Qifrey). She wants to keep her magic essentially "pure" and unchanged and resents having to do what others tell her to do. 

Richeh specializes in crystal magic, particularly in creating transparent crystal ribbons. She also excels at drawing small, intricate glyphs, and has been shown to be adept at connecting these together to form magical portal holes. She has a seemingly emotionless and childish personality. She avoids showing much emotion, though others can still notice emotions on her. She is particularly prone to showing that she's angry at people.

He is a witch and serves as the Watchful Eye for [Qifrey's](https://anilist.co/character/129841/Qifrey) atelier. He has a gruff way of speaking but his magic is often described as "warm". He has created a lot of magical items, such as the Glowstone Path, the Snugstone and the Searneedle Wand. His specialty is fire-based magic.

He is very caring to the apprentices and gives them things that might be helpful, as well as rushing to Qifrey's aid, but every time someone points out he's acting very nicely, he tries to brush it off as something anyone would do or to his work as watchful eye.

Tetia is a young witch in training at [Qifrey's](https://anilist.co/character/129841/) Atelier. She loves clouds and dreams of creating the perfect cloud magic.

She's perpetually energetic and has a habit of thanking people for thanking her. Tetia is an extremely upbeat, loving girl that tries to help everyone she knows and keep the mood high. She is also the one who often gets everyone grounded and keeps the mood up by being loving to her friends.

A member of a species called the brushbuddy. A small creature with fur resembling a paintbrush. It possesses a natural instinct to gather wherever it catches the scent of Magic Ink.

Friendly and affectionate, it has grown quite attached to [Coco](https://anilist.co/character/129840/Coco) and the members of the Atelier.
He is a young boy with dark skin, dark eyes, and long dark hair. He is occasionally drawn with sharp and noticeable canines. After an incident that left his legs unusable, he also uses a sealchair.

Nolnoa's young assistant in the shop. He suffers from argentosis, a rare sight condition which makes him effectively colorblind and thus initially unable to use magic because certain effects rely on inks differentiated by their color. He becomes a dear friend to [Coco](https://anilist.co/character/129840/Coco), who helps him by teaching him magic with which to circumvent his disability.

He is a nervous apprentice witch studying under Kukrow.

Euini is a very anxious witch who worries about his own abilities and is very aware of his own faults; he confesses that he is most comfortable practicing magic when there isn't an audience watching him. Euini tends to think lowly of himself and that causes him to under-perform in any given situation.
Member of the Knight Moralis.
One of the Three Wise, he is responsible for overseeing the education of new witches. He was also Qifrey's professor.

Iguin is the Brimmed Hat Witch who sold a book of forbidden magic to [Coco](https://anilist.co/character/129840/Coco). Their motivation is somewhat unknown, but it has something to do with Coco. They appear to be incredibly powerful, possessing magic that is beyond the scope of normal witches. Iguin also has incredible agility, being able to jump while casting magic. They rarely appear except to interfere with Coco from the sidelines.
Alaira is a senior witch who lives at the Witch Auditorium. She is friends with [Qifrey](https://anilist.co/character/129841/).

A member of the Knights Moralis and the leader of a squad of five.

A strict and serious individual, he is pretty stern and does not care about trivial things such as his birthday. Work is his top priority, he is dedicated to his job of enforcing the law and has no interest for his appearance or personal care. He shows himself to be ruthless, ignoring the pleas of others and does not hesitate to take action as a Knight.

Ininia is an apprentice witch currently serving under a mysterious witch named Restis.

She is very lawful to her master, Lord Restis. Ininia talks in third person and is very aloof, barely showing any emotion. She also has a very simple view on friendship, viewing those as friends as ones that will be spared from her more harmful magic.
Dagda is a traveling minstrel. He appears alongside the boy Coustas who is like a son to him.

[Richeh's](https://anilist.co/character/129838/) older brother and an apprentice witch.

Riliphin is a reserved and quiet young man. He has a strong aversion to areas with a large number of people, and prefers quiet places.
Jujy is an apprentice learning under the witch [Hieheart](https://anilist.co/character/331281/Hieheart).
Member of the Knights Moralis. He works directly under Easthies.
Nolnoa is an old witch who runs a magic shop called The Starry Sword with his grandson Tartah in the town of Kalhn.
Atwert is a Pointed Hat Witch that is introduced as Galga's lover.

personnages.nom_natif: ディンレルディ・エズレスト
personnages.description: The king of Ezrest and ruler of the Six Monarchs of Zozah Peninsula, and the father of Eolio Ezrest, Ezrest's prince.
Hieheart is a witch and [Jujy's](https://anilist.co/character/331278/Jujy) professor.
Sinocia is an Unknowing doctor working at the Healing Spire.
Galga is a member of the Knights Moralis.
Sasaran, also known as the "Empty Cloak Witch" and the "very embodiment of forbidden magic" is a mysterious member of the Brimmed Cap Group.
[Coco](https://anilist.co/character/129840/Coco)'s mother is a middle-aged woman who owns her own tailoring shop. She raised Coco by herself after her husband died.
Vinanna is one of the Three Wise. She is the "Wise in Principles", and is responsible for adjudicating transgressions of magic law.
Ermile is one of the unknowings working as a doctor within the Healing Spire together with Sinocia and the other doctors employed there.
Eolio is the son of Deanreldea Ezrest, thus making him the prince of the Zozah Peninsula.
Restys is a Brimmed Cap Witch currently tutoring Ininia and Custas.
Laglah is one of the Three Wise, succeding the previous Wise of Friendship, Engendill.

Princess Mia is a noble princess of the Cladd Territory. She is a member of the Cladd Family, and daughter of Lord Cladd, as well as the fiance of her unnamed future groom, who is a member of the Norwill Clan.
Ekoh is a member of the Knights Moralis and the younger twin brother of Etlan.
Etlan is a member of the Knights Moralis and the older twin brother of Ekoh.

personnages.nom_natif: ロロガ・ローウェントン
personnages.description: Loroga is a young apprentice witch at the Great Hall.
He is the disparaging teacher of Euini.
Lord Cladd is a noble lord of the Cladd Territory and a member of the Cladd Family, and father of Princess Mia.
Engendale is a former member of the Three Wise.

personnages.nom_natif: エドワード・エルリック
personnages.description:
__Birthplace:__ Resembool, Amestris
__Height:__ 1,65m
__Family:__ [Alphonse Elric](https://anilist.co/character/12/Alphonse-Elric) (brother), [Van Hohenheim](https://anilist.co/character/9792/Van-Hohenheim) (father), [Trisha Elric](https://anilist.co/character/10085/Trisha-Elric) (mother, deceased)
__Affiliations:__ State Military, [Pinako Rockbell](https://anilist.co/character/65/Pinako-Rockbell), [Izumi Curtis (teacher)](https://anilist.co/character/67/Izumi-Curtis), [Roy Mustang (Commander)](https://anilist.co/character/68/Roy-Mustang)
__Occupation:__ State Alchemist

Edward "Fullmetal Alchemist" Elric is a young alchemical prodigy. He is the youngest State Alchemist ever to be recognized by the Amestris State Military, having received the title at the age of 12. Ed's primary motivation throughout the series is to return his younger brother, Alphonse, to his original body, which was lost in a failed human transmutation. Edward, despite his occasional bouts of immaturity, is a selfless boy who gains a reputation as a "hero of the people" throughout his youth. Notably, he doesn't seem concerned about returning his own arm and leg, instead focusing entirely on Al's suffering.

Edward is small for his age, standing at only 149 cm (4'11"), however his body is that of an experienced martial artist, with noticeable muscles and a wealth of agility. Although he lacks both his right arm and left leg, Ed's ability to fight is not impaired, and is in fact improved, as he will often use alchemy to cause his metal arm to partly transform into a blade or shield. His heavy automail limbs are considered by him to be the very best in Amestris. They were made by his childhood friend, Winry Rockbell, and she is constantly working on them. He is able to think quickly, even in desperate situations, though can still be frightened into paralysis. These qualities, combined with his alchemical powers and physical strength, make him a formidable fighter.

personnages.nom_natif: アルフォンス・エルリック
personnages.description:
__Birthplace:__ Resembool
__Family:__ [Edward Elric](https://anilist.co/character/11) (brother), [Trisha Elric](https://anilist.co/character/10085) (mother, deceased)
__Occupation:__ Alchemist

Alphonse Elric is a human child who lost his body during a forbidden alchemical transmutation to bring his deceased mother back to life, and had his soul transmuted into a suit of armor by his brother, Edward Elric. 

Al's blood seal lies just below the base of the neck at the back of the suit, on the inside. It is drawn with Ed's blood. According to Edward, he needs to be careful whenever he reconstructs Alphonse's body because he must keep the blood seal intact during the transmutation. If the blood seal is removed, Al's soul will be lost.

Roy Mustang is a state alchemist and officer in the Amestrian state military. A hero of the Ishval Civil War and [Edward Elric’s](https://anilist.co/character/11/Edward-Elric) superior officer, Mustang is a remarkably capable commander who plans to become the next Führer of Amestris.

On the surface, Mustang is presented as a shallow, self-absorbed, and incorrigible womanizer who is infamous among many of his colleagues and subordinates alike for the selfish and narcissistic aura he gives off. Easily as arrogant as Edward Elric, Mustang is one to act ostentatiously and appears to act mostly out of self-interest rather than any sort of philanthropy. He comes off to most as a sort of cocky layabout, shirking most of his duties and delegating his paperwork to subordinates while sitting idly at his desk with an amused smile on his face as he procrastinates, but is quick to take action when it appears that there is glory and military notoriety to be gained. Mustang is expertly manipulative and prone to think several steps ahead of those around him, giving him a remarkable talent for making subordinates act exactly as he wishes despite appearing not to have had a hand in their decisions - all traits which make the fact that he has managed to attain the lofty rank of colonel at such a young age a matter of public gossip.

At the core, Mustang is a remarkably devoted commander whose primary focus and personal duty is to his friends and subordinates. Though he hides it well behind a veil of cynicism and self-importance, Mustang is a man who cares deeply about the people who trust and support him and goes to great lengths to ensure their safety and well-being, even at the risk of his own. As a man with considerable power, Mustang considers himself a protector to those without and acts accordingly, earning the staunch loyalty of his most trusted compatriots.

personnages.nom_natif: ウィンリィ・ロックベル
personnages.description:
__Birthplace:__ Resembool
__Occupation:__ Automail Mechanic 
__Family:__ [Pinako Rockbell](https://anilist.co/character/65/Rockbell-Pinako) (grandmother), Urey Rockbell (father, deceased), Sara Rockbell (mother, deceased)
__Affiliations:__ Rockbell Automail  Atelier Garfiel

A childhood friend of the central characters, the Elric brothers, she is often seen in their company throughout the series. She is evidently [Edward](https://anilist.co/character/11/Elric-Edward)'s love interest. Specializing in mechanical repair, specifically with automail, Winry services Edward's arm and leg whenever it is in need of repair or replacement.

Riza Hawkeye is Roy Mustang's most trusted subordinate. She carries out many of the tasks he is too lazy to do, acts as his personal assistant, and protects him from danger. She also doubles as his voice of reason, keeping cool in heated situations and scolding him when he allows his emotions to get in the way. Riza and Roy seem to share a close relationship in both adaptations of Fullmetal Alchemist; in the anime she identifies him as her most precious person, whereas in the manga she loses her resolve to live when believing he has been killed. Riza specializes in firearms, particularly sniper rifles, and can hit nearly any target with lethal accuracy. She adopts a dog, called Black Hayate in both the anime and the manga, which she raises with stern discipline; when Hayate goes to the bathroom inside, she shoots at the wall behind him to reinforce that doing so is bad.

__Occupation:__ Prince
__Goal:__ To find the secret of immortality and become Xingese Emperor

Ling Yao is a Xingese character exclusive to the manga and the 2009 anime series. Due to his father, the Emperor's, declining health, Ling left his country to find the Philosopher's Stone to stabilize Xing, as well as grant him the key to immortality. Although he is the 12th son of the Emperor, Ling hopes the Philosopher's Stone will help him rise in the order of succession and achieve the throne thereby securing his clan's welfare. Though he is often laid back and hungry, he's very noble and will do whatever it takes to help his clan. He is also a skilled fighter and has had many incidents involving assassination attempts at his life. He has formed a strong rivalry with [Ed](https://anilist.co/character/11/Elric-Edward), by doing things such as use Ed's money to annoy him.   ~!After the 1st Greed is punished by Father, he gives Ling the secret to immortality by transforming him into the succeeding Greed. Ed tries to help, but Ling denies his help as it is the only way to help his clan in the land of Xing. Even while his body is taken over by Greed his mind and soul are kept intact and can come to the surface. Since Greed understands his strong points their relationship is on some kind of symbiotic level.!~

(Source: Fullmetal Alchemist wiki)

Greed is a greedy Homunculus, nicknamed the "Ultimate Shield". He is able to rearrange the carbon in his body to make his skin as hard as diamond, thus making himself almost impossible to injure. As his name implies he is a very avaricious character, who likes living in luxury, surrounded by powerful minions and beautiful women. Despite his generally greedy nature, he’s shown to honestly care for his subordinates. He also has a habit of flipping people off in the manga.    

 __In the 2003 anime series:__  Greed is the second oldest of the Homunculi created by Dante. However, due to his avarice, Greed rebelled and was eventually captured and imprisoned in lab 5. He was imprisoned for 130 years until an explosion broke his seal. He then freed the caged chimera at Lab 5 in exchange for helping him get his revenge on the other homunculi and their master.    

 __In the manga and 2009 anime series:__  He is the third Homunculus created by Father. Greed apparently abandoned the other Homunculi over 100 years before the start of the series and claims to be around two centuries old. He first appears hiding in the Devil's Nest in Dublith, with his gang of chimeras all of whom he apparently rescued from military experimentation.      ~!After Greed is punished by Father, he later returns as Father removes his son's Philosopher's Stone core from his own body and inserts it directly into the body of Ling Yao to create a second Human-based Homunculus. This second Greed maintains all the same personality and powers as the first (his Ouroboros tattoo is even in the same spot), but appears to have none of his previous memories, not recognizing Envy, Gluttony, or the Elric Brothers. As such, he becomes a faithful servant of his Father, as the first Greed was presumed to have been initially, and refers to all actions prior to his rebirth as having been done by "the other Greed".    After killing a past comrade and follower of his, memories from Greed's previous life returned, including his time in the Devil's Nest and the feelings he had for his followers. Remembering this, along with how Bradley killed most of his followers, leads Greed to betray Father once again. He also stops referring to his "previous self" as "the other Greed" upon regaining his memories.  !~

__Nationality:__ Amestrian
__Occupation:__ Intelligence Agent

Maes Hughes is an Amestrian State Military officer stationed in the Investigations Office in Central City and Colonel Roy Mustang's best friend, as well as the closest supporter of Mustang's secret bid for the position of Führer. A devoted family man and exemplary soldier, Hughes is generally well-liked by the other characters.     ~!He is killed by Envy upon his discovery of Father's plans, and is posthumously promoted to Brigadier General!~

Scar is a disturbed loner. His right arm does not belong to him, but his brother. His brother was obsessed with finding the Philosopher's Stone and tattooed his whole body.

During the Ishval civil war...  ~!an alchemist, [Solf J. Kimblee](https://anilist.co/character/6590/Kimblee-J-Solf), killed his brother, blew off Scar's arm, and gave him the "X" scar on his forehead. Scar's brother then transmuted his own arm onto Scar's shoulder, giving the maimed warrior priest the powers of alchemic deconstruction that he then uses in his quest for vengeance.!~ Scar seeks his revenge against the state alchemists, all of whom he blames for the destruction of Ishval. His wrath does not extend, however, to non-state alchemists, which is why he does not seek to kill [Alphonse Elric](https://anilist.co/character/12/Elric-Alphonse) during their frequent confrontations.

personnages.nom_natif: オリヴィエ・ミラ・アームストロング
personnages.description:
__Species:__ Human
__Occupation:__ Military Officer, Briggs General
__Weapon:__ A family heirloom sword
__Known relatives:__ Philip Gargantos Armstrong (father), Alex Louis Armstrong (younger brother), Catherine Elle Armstrong (youngest sister), Amue Armstrong (younger sister), Strongine Armstrong (younger sister)

Major General Olivier Mira Armstrong is Alex Louis Armstrong's older sister. She is in charge of Briggs, the northern military border. She scoffs at the concept of "equivalent exchange" and believes "survival of the fittest" is the only law in life. Her subordinates are loyal, but if it ensured the survival of Briggs (or for the sake of the greater good), they are instructed to leave her to die if ever the need arose, and she wouldn't hold it against them.    One of her closest subordinates is Major Miles, a soldier whose grandfather was Ishvalan; he is of many bloods due to several inter-racial unions, beginning with his grandparents. It is possible that he is also part Xingese, but his Ishvalan blood is the most prominent.     Being the General of Briggs, Olivier has full command of the Fortress. She is also very skilled with her family heirloom sword which she uses unhesitatingly. She also seems to have some proficiency with tanks and artillery.

personnages.nom_natif: アレックス・ルイ・アームストロング
personnages.description:
__Birthplace:__ Amestris
__Occupation:__ State Alchemist

Major Alex Louis Armstrong, the Strong Arm Alchemist, was born into an elite family of alchemists and has mastered his family's techniques. Members of his family have, in the past, filled the highest military and political positions in the state. He acquired his alchemy titles for his skill of using arm strength in his alchemy. All though he may look intimidating, he is really friendly and (overly)affectionate, and often stays behind or risks his life for the safety of others. He also has a tendency to show off techniques passed down to him to his enemies, and make them feel somewhat awkward during a battle.

__Occupation:__ Instigator for Father
__Ability:__ Shapeshifting
__Goal:__ Cause discord among humans

Envy is a homunculus who has the ability to shapeshift. They use this power to assume the form of any person and even copy their voice. They usually serve as a spy, but their abilities are also extremely useful for assassinations. Envy may not be as smart as some of the other homunculi, but they are by no means an idiot. In fact, they can be just as good a puppet master as Lust, but this is overshadowed by their cockiness and bad temper. This temper can easily be set off by insulting their large and delicate ego, causing them to make mistakes.  

__In the 2003 anime series:__ As the oldest Homunculus, Envy claimed that they had forgotten what they originally looked like. Envy also greatly hates all humans and followed Dante mostly for the opportunity of killing as many people as they could. This is what drove Envy in all that they did and unlike other Homunculi, Envy does not care about the Philosopher's Stone, nor about becoming human. ~!Towards the very end of the series it is revealed that Envy was created four hundred years ago by Hohenheim in an attempt to resurrect the son he and Dante had, who later died from mercury poisoning when he was eighteen years old. Envy held a great hatred toward Hohenheim for never being acknowledged as his son and for abandoning them and Dante.!~  

__In the manga and 2009 anime series:__ Envy was the fourth Homunculus created by Father. Though often referred to as a 'he' Envy is apparently genderless and can take almost any form it chooses. Referred to by Lust as the most cruel or sadistic of the Homunculi, Envy shows the most open disdain of humans and relishes in any opportunity to hurt, humiliate, or insult them. They are also quite vain and short tempered and dislikes anyone insulting their appearance. ~!Beneath this cruel exterior, however, Envy is secretly envious of humans' inner strength and the mutually beneficial friendships that they share, since most of the Homunculi show little real concern or emotional support for each other.!~  

(Source: Fullmetal Alchemist Wikia)

personnages.nom_natif: ヴァン・ホーエンハイム
personnages.description:
__Age:__ ~!451!~

He is the father of the protagonists, Edward and Alphonse Elric. He is a brilliant and well-known alchemist. He left Ed, Al, and their mother Trisha when Al was a baby and Ed was very young. Years later, Ed still holds a grudge against him for abandoning his mother, which he believes contributed to her death.    (Source: Wikipedia)  In the Fullmetal Alchemist manga he is refered to as "Van Hohenheim," not Hohenheim Elric. As Edward Elric points out in book 14 of the Fullmetal Alchemist manga, "Elric is my mother's name!" He (in the original 2003 anime)...  ~!  Has been alive for centuries. He worked in a lab, which took advantage of 'witch trials' as human bait, to create the first philosopher's stone. He succeeded, but it cost him his life. Dante, (his lover at the moment) attached his soul (much like Al to armor) to the nearest man in the room, reviving Hohenheim. They continued this practice for many years, until Hohenheim fell in love and married Trisha Elric. After they sired Edward and Alphonse, he left for fear Dante would use them against him, and also because he felt ashamed of his past. Like Dante, his flesh is wearing away, so he must wear cologne to mask the scent. He can transmute without circles, because when he died, he saw past the gate, as did Dante. !~  He (in the manga and 2009 series) is...  ~! a human Philosopher's Stone. Homunculus (Father) was a test subject at a lab in which Hohenheim worked (in fact, Father was the one who named Hohenheim). The king of Xerxes demanded the secret of immortality from the homunculus, and he obliged. a country wide transmutation is formed, and everything is working as planned. However, at the last minute, Father lies about where the center of the circle is, and engulfs both himself and Hohenheim into the gate. Hohenheim wakes to see everybody in his country dead. He meets Homunculus, who tells him everything, how he has now gained half of the powers of the stone. Homunculus did this out of gratitude. after these events, Hohenheim travels to Xing, and founds the art of Alkahestry.!~

personnages.nom_natif: キング・ブラッドレイ
personnages.description:
King Bradley is the Führer of the Amestris state military and has all state alchemist under his direct command. King Bradley almost always maintains a kind and calm demeanor even when issuing orders to engage in battle. This trait often confuses his subordinates, and [Roy Mustang](https://anilist.co/character/68/Mustang-Roy) admits that he "can't figure the guy out." King Bradley has a son, [Selim](https://anilist.co/character/10982/Bradley-Selim), and an unnamed wife.

In both iterations of Bradley, he is shown to be highly skilled with a saber. He can move and attack with incredible speed and dismember with ease.

__Nationality:__ Amestrian

Izumi Curtis, born Izumi Harnet, the teacher of [Ed](https://anilist.co/character/11/Elric-Edward) and [Alphonse Elric](https://anilist.co/character/12/Elric-Alphonse), agreed to train the brothers to hone their alchemical abilities after their mother died. She expands their training with a regimen of philosophy, martial arts, and living off the land. Her methods are derived from her own alchemy training: in the manga and second anime, she was forced to survive in the northern region surrounding Briggs Fortress for a month (although it turns out she succeeded by stealing supplies from the northern fortress), whereas in the first anime she was taught by [Dante](https://anilist.co/character/18880/Dante).

She thinks of the Elrics as her own sons, and although she severs her student-teacher ties with them after learning of their attempts with human transmutation (and similarly Ed's joining the State Military), she continues to do all she can to help them. She can be quite violent when punishing or sparring with the Elric brothers, so they tend to be deathly afraid of her.

Her claim of "I'm a housewife!" while confronting [Greed](https://anilist.co/character/351/Greed) was a favorite scene of Arakawa's to draw.

Izumi and her husband [Sig Curtis](https://anilist.co/character/10972/Curtis-Sig) were expecting a child years before the start of the series; however, their son was stillborn. Izumi tried and failed to revive the child through human transmutation (an act that created [Wrath](https://anilist.co/character/6917/Wrath) in the first anime). The failed attempt took some of her internal organs, resulting in infertility, and causing her to periodically cough up blood. Izumi gained the ability to use alchemy without a transmutation circle after seeing the "truth."  In the manga, Izumi attracts the attention of the State Military for surviving the failed human transmutation. As she and her husband travel around Amestris in order to avoid the military, they eventually meet Ed and Al's father Hohenheim. He rearranges her insides to ease the blood flow, and persuades her to help collaborate in bringing down the State Military.

Lan Fan is one of two bodyguards of [Ling Yao](https://anilist.co/character/3293/Yao-Ling) and the granddaughter of Ling's other bodyguard, [Fu](https://anilist.co/character/23461/Foo). She is very quiet and cares deeply for Ling. As a result, she is constantly thinking of his safety and often forgets her own. Lan Fan is a very skilled fighter and is able to sense the presence of a soul (referred to as chi); thus she can quickly identify Homunculi like [Envy](https://anilist.co/character/651/Envy) that have more than one soul in their Philosopher's Stones (meaning she can easily see through Envy's disguises). Although we are never told her age Ling refers to her as a "girl" so we can assume that she and Ling are around the same age.

~!After being heavily injured by the Führer himself, Lan Fan sacrifices her arm to help Ling and herself escape. Later, She leaves with Fu to have an automail arm made for her. Lan Fan comes back six months later with an automail left arm. The automail is equipped with retractable blade starting from her elbow and ending around her shoulder. She uses it in a fight against Gluttony and in the siege of Central.!~

Lust is a Homunculus, nicknamed the "Ultimate Spear", and one of the first antagonists in the Fullmetal Alchemist series. She is the first Homunculus to appear in the series and plays a significant role in the plot of both the manga and 2003 anime series. Lust is also usually partnered with Gluttony to whom she appears to have a particular almost motherly closeness. Her Ouroboros mark is located on her collarbone, just above her breasts.     

__In the 2003 anime series;__ She is largely the same as her manga counterpart, highly intelligent, manipulative, devoted to her own ideals, however she begins to crave becoming a human as the series progresses. Her main purpose amongst the Homunculi is gathering information and traveling abroad, manipulating alchemists into creating Philosopher's Stones. Gaining true humanity is the focal point of her ambition, arguably much more so than the rest of the Homunculi.     

~!Lust was created by Scar's brother, when he attempted to use alchemy to bring his lover back from the dead. After he was cast out from Ishbalan society as a heretic, [Envy](https://anilist.co/character/651/Envy) visited the wretched creature and fed it red stones, giving her human shape, and her new name. She was not the first Homunculus to bear the name of Lust, and is the third youngest Homunculus.!~

__In the manga and 2009 anime series;__ Lust is the only female Homunculus and the second to be created by [Father](https://anilist.co/character/15542/Flask-no-Homunculus). Due to her high intelligence and devotion to Father's plan, Lust appears to have a great deal of free reign and authority within the organization, seeming to have a position second only to Pride and on par with Wrath. Lust also has a great disdain for humans, thinking them frail, predictable and generally stupid. Moreover, she appears to take pleasure in using and throwing them away. Lust is the first to introduce the idea of Homunculi as superhuman, the next wave of evolution of humanity, and takes pride in her nature.

personnages.nom_natif: ゾルフ・J・キンブリー
personnages.description:
Solf J. Kimblee is an ex-war criminal and a veteran of the Ishbal War. His alchemy title refers to his use of sulfur in the human body to create explosive fluids, turning people into living bombs.  

His personality seems almost split in two; at times he can be polite, if curt, straightforward, rational, and "civilized." However, in battle he displays an uncanny and foreboding demeanor in favor of destruction and damnation. Kimblee's powers appear to be much the same as those in the Anime, except that he can transmute and detonate from a distance as well, using the ground as a connecting force, causing huge explosions (though probably it is because his force is imbued with Philosopher's Stone).

The seventeenth princess of Xing (the lowest ranked house), who like Ling Yao, travels west searching for the Philosopher's Stone so she can become the empress and secure the future of her family.  She travels along with her pet mini-panda, Xiao Mei. Adept at Xing's style of alchemy, called Alchahastry, she use throwing knives to arrange transmutation circles in order to manipulate targets at long range.  A ardent fan of Edward Elric because of the way he helps people with alchemy, her image of him is quickly shattered when she sees him in person. Not knowing the history of the conflict between Scar and Edward, Mei helps Scar escape from the Emestrian military when the tide of battle turns against him, and begins traveling with him afterwards.  Though she becomes disillusioned with Edward soon after meeting him, she quickly becomes enamored with Alphonse instead.  ~! Upon concluding the series, she is seen in a picture (the same in which we see a married Ed and Winry) with Al, so it's assumed that they married. !~

Second Lieutenant Jean Havoc likes to smoke, and is almost always pictured with a cigarette in his mouth. He is a fair shot with a gun, and one of Roy Mustang's loyal followers; he gives Edward a stern talking-to when Ed bad-mouths Mustang for only caring about promotions. Havoc is a strict man of duty, a very by-the-book soldier, even if he doesn't always agree with the orders.

~!He becomes paralysed from the legs down due to a wound given to him by Lust.!~

Shao May is May Chang's pet panda and traveling companion. Abandoned as a cub due to her abnormally small size, Shao May was cared for by May as if she were family and, therefore, has a particularly strong bond with the little girl. The two are constantly together and, as a bit of comic relief, Shao May frequently mimics May's actions whether it be in expression, practicing alkahestry or performing martial arts, taking whatever pose her master takes and moving in synchronized union with her.     -Wikia

personnages.nom_natif: バリー・ザ・チョッパー
personnages.description:
A butcher who uses the disguise of a female so he can abduct women.   

Barry is a wanted serial killer and later an experiment in 5th laboratory.

Truth is the most commonly used name for the mysterious and ethereal being that sits before The Gate and addresses alchemists who have stepped into God's domain through the use of alchemy. It appears as a pure white, nearly formless being almost indistinguishable from the rest of the endless white expanse which surrounds the Gate but for a shadowy outline which causes Truth to reflect the shape of the person it is talking to, thereby supporting its claim to be another shade of that very person. When Edward and Alphonse Elric each appeared before the Gate, Truth took on the shape of a young boy and when Izumi Curtis appeared, Truth's shape reflected that of a young woman, appeared as a vigorous man to Roy Mustang, and a white version of Father's flask form.    Truth initially introduces itself as the being some people call God, the World or the Universe, at first seeming welcoming and jovial to its guests before calling attention to their hubris and opening the Gate, which forces them inside. At this point, Truth often smiles with an eerily wide and insane grin that is similar to that of the Homunculus Gluttony and Father.   When the alchemist in question returns from his or her sojourn through the Gate, Truth informs them of the necessary toll for accessing the Universe's knowledge and collects it, usually in the form of a body part which disintegrates off the alchemist and reappears on Truth's form. In this way Truth is responsible for the taking of Edward's left leg and right arm, some of Izumi's internal organs, Roy's eyesight, and Alphonse's entire body.   It would appear that Truth's goal is to discourage humans from treading in God's domain, as it calls Edward a fool when the young boy returns and sacrifices his arm to recover his brother's soul.    Source: Fullmetal Alchemist Wikipedia

Second Lieutenant Maria Ross is put in charge of taking care of the Elric brothers during their stay in Central. She and her partner Brosh were assigned the task of guarding the Elrics due to Scar's return in Central and his previous attempt on Ed and Al's lives. Almost immediately, she takes on the role of a parental figure. She tries to give guidance to the brothers whenever she can. She took a liking to Ed and Al, and risked her life to calm Ed down when he was absorbing the red stone material inside laboratory 5. Both she and her partner Denny Brosh work under Major Alex Louis Armstrong.     Source: Wikipedia

personnages.nom_natif: セリム・ブラッドレイ
personnages.description:
Selim Bradley is the son of Führer King Bradley.

__In the manga and 2009 anime series;__ Selim is the Führer's sprightly son. He frequently asks his father to tell him stories from the battlefront and interesting anecdotes from his everyday events. Selim professes a desire to become a State Alchemist so as to be more useful to the Führer and is a self-professed fan of Edward Elric.

One of the higher ranking soldiers at Briggs' Fortress under Olivier Mira Armstrong. As he is partly Ishvalian, Armstrong was ordered to imprison him during the Ishvalian war, but she refused to do such a thing only because of his ethnicity.  Miles is very loyal to Armstrong, and wants to stay in the military to change their perspective on Ishvalians.

__Occupation:__ Surgeon, Automail Technician

Grandmother of Winry, and old resident of Risembool. Also, a parent like figure to both Edward and Alphonse, after they lost their mother. It is shown that Pinako was Hohenheim's drinking buddy, and that she was the one to introduce Hohenheim with his future wife, Trisha.

Sheska is a bookworm to the letter.    Her house is full with piles of books. One could say 'no one can possibly live here'.    She was a librarian at the First Branch of the Central City library. But when she was at the Central City library she forgot she was supposed to be working, and read books instead. And as one could expect; she got fired.    But when the Central City library burnt down she was the key to the books that got lost in the fire. Because Sheska is gifted with the talent to remember and reproduce anything she has ever read with word-for-word accuracy. And therefore, she got hired by the military again.    When looking at the fact that Sheska has collectors mania, and forgets anything around her when she reads a book and last but certainly not least her extra ordinary talent to reproduce books she read times ago, one could conclude she has savant autism.

During the course of FMA's story, "Father" commands the other Homunculi and orchestrates the various conflicts like the Ishvalian war, plotting something involving a transmutation circle encircling the entirety of Amestris.   ~!Most likely the very first Homunculus, "Father" met Hohenheim in the ancient country of Xerxes, where Hohenheim served as a servant in a laboratory. The Homunculus taught Hohenheim to read and perform alchemy, and was eventually brought before the king of Xerxes to give him immortality. After utilizing the life force of all of Xerxes' populace, Homunculus crafted himself a body akin to that of Hohenheim, and rendered them both immortal.!~

__Nationality:__ Amestrian

Nina's father is [Shou Tucker](https://anilist.co/character/3696/), the Sowing Life Alchemist.  

~! When her father became desperate in forming another talking chimera he transmuted her and [her dog](https://anilist.co/character/404360/) into a chimera that was able to speak the human language.  Shortly after, she is killed by Scar to put her out of her misery. Later on in the first anime, with the philosopher's stone, the disfigured Chimeric Shou Tucker is able to resurrect his fallen daughter into the form of a chimera homunculus, an artificial human being. However, she never speaks and little is known about what happens after that.!~

Gluttony is the second homunculus to appear in the series, typically being in the company of Lust. He is a large, simple-minded homunculus whose thoughts rarely stray far from eating. He has powerful jaws, acidic saliva, and can and will eat almost anything. He particularly likes eating people, and the only way he can find enjoyment in a battle is if he believes he can eat his opponent afterwards. A running gag in the manga and anime is asking Lust (or any other Homunculi) if he can eat someone. He apparently prefers girls (as in to eat) and also seems to share a bond with his partner Lust.     There is no significant information pertaining to his role in the 2003 anime series.     __In the manga and 2009 anime series;__  Gluttony is the sixth Homunculus created by Father...   ~!and the failed product of Father's attempts to create a Gate of Truth. When activating this gate, Gluttony's stomach opens up, revealing a large eye at its center. His ribs spread out to act as a border for the gate, and then double as large extendable teeth. With these teeth Gluttony can consume everything in his eye's field of vision in an instant, which is then transported to a realm within himself. Artifacts from centuries before the start of the series can be found there, indicating Gluttony's age. Gluttony and his philosopher's stone was eaten by Pride when they're battling with Edward Elric, Lan Fan, Ling Yao, Fu,and the chimeras.!~    (Taken in part from Wikia)

The husband of Izumi Curtis, an enormous muscular man who works as a butcher in the town of Dublith.
