Her life seems to largely revolve around doing whatever she deems fun at any given time, ranging from working as a hostess at Chupa♡Cabra's to aiding the DWMA's plans - however, she's also very sensitive to others' feelings, often comforting those in need out of kindness. 
She's also shown to enjoy long baths and exhibitionism, being very proud of her human form's body and often looking for opportunities to make others feel embarrassed. 

Her magic abilities are themed around pumpkins, and she also keeps a hat monster named Zwan (ズワン) as her familiar. Due to being a cat, she has nine lives, which is how she managed to survive her initial defeat at the hands of Soul and Maka. Additionally, her charms seem to transcend gender-altering magic, with her male form being able to seduce a succubus within the Book of Eibon.

The grim reaper himself. He is by far the most powerful character in the series. He is a bit of a joker but when the time comes, he's all business. His number is 42-42-564 (shini-shini-koroshi), which literally means die-die-kill in Japanese. He has a special move called a “Direct Noggin Shinigami Chop” (which is normally shown when the Shinigami shows his hand, which is a large, flat, four-fingered hand appearing from his robe). This is both a joke and a real move. He constantly has to put up with Death Scythe’s antics when it comes to Maka or her progress. He seems to take on a more playful attitude when talking with his son, Death the Kid (he says he likes his son's three white stripes). Shinigami's soul wavelength is so large that it entirely covers Death city.

The legendary sword used by heroes and kings. It has a great power that is unmatched by any other weapon. It turns out that anyone can use Excalibur. However, no one can put up with its personality (it has a bigger ego than Black Star). The only reason that those who use it are called heroes is that they can put up with its annoying habits, such as a list of one-thousand things he demands to be completed, such as daily five-hour reading sessions. Excalibur was first introduced when Kid and Black Star found a book about him and thus sought him out, only to discover that the book had in fact been written by Excalibur himself. They quickly ditched him due to his personality. His other form is completely the opposite given his elegant weapon form, looking like a cartoon-ish gentlemen with an outrageous mustache and no pants. On the other hand, his legendary powers have been proven by a fellow Shibusen student who found completing the appointed tasks easy. Excalibur can grant great power, light speed and teleportation, and the wielder can easily defeat three of Shibusen's strongest combined. In the end, Excalibur was put back again because the student could not put up with his annoying sneeze. His existence throughout the story is purely comical, with the exception of the fact of how he informed Kid, the Thompsons, Buttataki, and Blair about the story of Eibon, backed by Shinigami.   (From Wikipedia)

personnages.nom_natif: パトリシア・トンプソン
personnages.description:
A Demon Weapon and the younger sister of [Elizabeth Thompson](https://anilist.co/character/8445/Elizabeth-Thompson).

Known as one of the "Demon Twin Guns", both her and her sister were known as the "Brooklyn Devils" and were petty thugs until being found by their current Meister, [Death the Kid](https://anilist.co/character/8455). Overtime, she reformed from her thieving and ruffian ways along with Liz and became Kid's weapon, later becoming DWMA students within the E.A.T Class.

personnages.nom_natif: エリザベス・トンプソン
personnages.description: A demon weapon and the older sister of [Patricia Thompson](https://anilist.co/character/8444/Patricia-Thompson). Formerly a thuggish ruffian alongside her sister raised in the streets of New York, both her own and sister's life turn for the better when they encountered their future meister, Death the Kid. Eventually becoming Kid's weapon partner alongside her sister, she became a student of Death Weapon Meister Academy enrolled in the E.A.T Class.

personnages.nom_natif: メデューサ・ゴーゴン
personnages.description:
One of the major antagonists of the series, Medusa is a powerful witch and the middle sibling among the three Gorgon Sisters.

She is the mother of Crona, who is also the crown jewel in her master plan: the destruction of the current world order to get the planet back on track. Lacking empathy for others, along with possessing a twisted sense of love for those who are like her in personality, Medusa views everyone as a potential specimen to experiment on or as a tool to suit her purpose.

personnages.nom_natif: スピリット=アルバーン
personnages.description: He is the Shinigami’s current weapon and Maka’s father. He is very protective of Maka and is ready to jump to her aid any time she’s in trouble (he is always stopped by the Shinigami). His wife is Maka’s mother but they are divorced now due to his constant flirting with other women. Even though he visits clubs, he is still insanely loyal to his ex-wife and daughter. He usually runs yelling about much he loves Maka and her mother (he calls Maka’s mother Mama). He is extremely sad that his daughter hates him but he still tries to be a good father by looking out for her in his own silly way. He used to be Dr. Franken’s partner before partnering up with "Mama" who later became his wife (which obviously lead to the divorce); he still suffers nightmares about Dr. Franken trying to dissect him and still has memories from college when he and Stein were roommates. His old name was Spirit.

Mifune, known by the epithet "God of the Sword", is an infamous samurai and bodyguard who acts as a guardian to the little witch, [Angela Leon](https://anilist.co/character/13712/Leon-Angela). He is later blackmailed into the service of Arachnophobia by its head, [Arachne Gorgon](https://anilist.co/character/16228/Gorgon-Arachne). He becomes involved in a somewhat one-sided rivalry with [Black Star](https://anilist.co/character/8464/BlackStar) after the latter encounters him on a mission.

The Death Scythe in charge of Europe. Dressed in a priestly garb and earphones, Justin is devout in his services to the Shinigami. Justin is the youngest in the DWMA's history to become a Death Scythe at the age of thirteen, all without the aid of a partner. His weapon form, the guillotine, fits his title of "executioner". Justin has the ability to read lips but due to his constant use of earphones and the fact that the Shinigami wears a mask, he cannot understand the Shinigami. He tends to pray and give thanks to God for everything, and also tends to speak loudly due to his constant use of headphones. He travels by means of a dune buggy with a coffin on wheels connected to it. In the manga, he is colored with blonde hair and his hairstyle is a tonsure cut, usually worn by monks from European temples.

The first-generation Kishin and one of the Great Old Ones whose affinity to madness resides in fear. He formerly served as one of the Warlords of the Eight Reaper Legions, being its most powerful member until he betrayed the group and became a Kishin, killing innocents to gain power through their souls and even consuming his own demon weapon partner, as well as two other Great Old Ones. After his betrayal he was sealed away by [Death](https://anilist.co/character/8457/Shinigami), and remained sealed until his revival by [Medusa](https://anilist.co/character/11924)'s Faction.

__Manga:__

~!He is later revealed to be Death's eldest son and the older brother of [Death the Kid](https://anilist.co/character/8455/Death-the-Kid), specifically created as a fragment containing all of Death's fear in order for Death to become the God of Absolute Order.!~

~!After Asura's battle with [Maka](https://anilist.co/character/8439/Maka-Albarn), [Black Star](https://anilist.co/character/8464/BlackStar) and Death the Kid, [Crona](https://anilist.co/character/11919/Crona) seals both Asura and themselves inside the moon to keep his madness locked away from the world. Asura gleefully asserts that this method will not last, and that one day he will return to terrorize the world again.!~

Eruka Frog is a frog-themed witch who serves under Medusa Gorgon. Like many other witches, Eruka craves destruction and enjoys the fact that she was born a Witch. However, she is extremely cowardly, preferring to flee rather than fight, and never hesitates begging for mercy when cowed. She can also be considered clingy to her partner, Free, even becoming needy and docile. Despite her malicious intent, Eruka has an earnest disposition with other Witches, including Mizune, with whom she is close friends with. She can be demeaning to those whom she considers inferior, though.         Magic:            Transform: Eruka transforms into a frog. She can still talk in this form.          Egg Bombs: Tadpole-like black balls with frog faces that can hop towards their target before detonating.          Arithmetic Magic (Magic Calculation): Used as a 'place maker' for high level spells so they are more precise.    (wikipedia)

A popular EAT-Class Meister partnered with twin weapons, Fire and Thunder. He is considered one of the top three student fighters in the DWMA, and is good friends with [Ox](https://anilist.co/character/14062/Ox-Ford) and [Kim](https://anilist.co/character/14063/Kim-Diehl). Rather hot blooded and direct, with a fiery soul and enough compassion to put his own life on the line for his friends.

The Death Scythe formerly in charge of Oceania. However, after the resurrection of [Asura](https://anilist.co/character/15840/Asura), her duties were reassigned to [Azusa](https://anilist.co/character/15770/Yumi-Azusa).

She is currently partnered with [Stein](https://anilist.co/character/8446/Franken-Stein) and is an instructor at the DWMA. Tends to feel glum about her lack of success in marriage, but is a kind and genuine woman. Stein was her old crush when they were students at the DWMA, but she still seems to hold feelings towards him in some capacity.

__Anime:__

~!After Stein is overwhelmed by madness and [Medusa](https://anilist.co/character/11924/Medusa-Gorgon) manipulates him into joining her side, Marie goes to save him alongside [Crona](https://anilist.co/character/11919/Crona), using her healing wavelength to bring him back to his senses.!~

__Manga:__

~!Marie's former betrothed, [Joe Buttataki](https://anilist.co/character/16944/Joe-Buttataki), is murdered during an internal investigation of the DWMA. Stein is framed for the murder due to his onset of madness at the time, orchestrated by Medusa, but Marie sets out with him to find the real killer, who is later revealed to be [Justin Law](https://anilist.co/character/14019/Justin-Law), a death scythe and a traitor to the DWMA.!~

~!In the final chapter, it is revealed that Marie and Stein are officially in a relationship, with Marie also being pregnant with his child.!~

Arachne Gorgon was the head of Arachnophobia who conspired to replace Death Weapon Meister Academy's position as a world power using madness with her in charge. She was also the eldest of the Gorgon Sisters, a former associate of both Death and Eibon of some sort, and considered the darkest blemish in the history of the Witch Order.

Ragnarok, also known as the Demon Sword, is the weapon partner of Crona. Born a normal demon weapon, it was melted by Medusa in a vat of Black Blood while in its weapon form and mixed into Crona's blood.

A Werewolf and the last of the Immortal Clan, imprisoned by the Witch Order for stealing Witch Queen Maba's left eye. After being freed by Eruka Frog on Medusa Gorgon's orders, he renames himself in honor of his freedom and joins her group, acting as one of her operatives.

Replaces Medusa as the school's interim doctor. She is Sid's partner, and looks like a mummy due to the fact she is covered in bandages (although she is seen without the bandages). She becomes a combat knife in weapon form. Her last name is a pun on how the word 'knives' is pronounced.

A three-star meister partner to Mira Naigus, instructor of Death Weapon Meister Academy, and a high-ranking member of the DWMA Central Intelligence Agency. Though killed in action by Shaula Gorgon—youngest of the three Gorgon sisters—he is later resurrected as a zombie by Franken Stein.
A 14-year-old Weapon from Japan, who still has to learn how to transform properly. She can transform into a halberd. She went to DWMA (Death Weapon Meister Academy) to become a hero.

Giriko is an enchanter and demon weapon allied with the witch [Arachne Gorgon](https://anilist.co/character/16228/Arachne-Gorgon), and serves as one of Arachnophobia's most powerful members.

Manga:

~!After the destruction of Arachnophobia, he allies with [Noah](https://anilist.co/character/16232/Noah) and becomes part of his group in an effort to avenge [Arachne](https://anilist.co/character/16228/Arachne-Gorgon)'s demise.!~

~!Within the Book of Eibon he badly injures both [Maka](https://anilist.co/character/8439/Maka-Albarn) and [Soul](https://anilist.co/character/8456/Soul-Eater-Evans) as revenge for their killing of [Arachne](https://anilist.co/character/16228/Arachne-Gorgon), deciding to kill [Maka](https://anilist.co/character/8439/Maka-Albarn) by strangling her before his new body undergoes soul rejection, causing his soul to explode due to the vessel being unable to contain his centuries of bloodlust.!~

The partner and meister of [Jacqueline](https://anilist.co/character/14067/Jacqueline-O-Lantern-Dupre) and one of the top students in the EAT Class. She is the object of [Ox](https://anilist.co/character/14062/Ox-Ford)'s affections but she constantly turns him down. 

~!She is later revealed to be a witch that fled from her homeland due to the discrimination she faced as a witch that did not fall victim to the destructive pull of magic, opting to hide her identity to become a meister at the DWMA.!~

Although she is a witch, her magical power is weak due to her youth; consequently, she relies on Mifune to protect her as a bodyguard.

She is a chameleon witch capable of using invisibility magic, though the spell is still imperfect, leaving parts of her body visible.

The Death Scythe in charge of East Asia. She comes off as being bookish and analytical, she is very respectful to all, she was the one that talked Marie out of marrying a toilet using wordplay. She was the student council president when Stein and the other Death Scythes were students, she was the person that scolded Spirit for his endless flirting and Stein's urge to dissect everything, she was said to have been a small, yet talkative child. She still treats the others as little kids like a teacher would (clapping to get their attention and telling them to line up and walk in a single file line) much to the embarrassment of the others. In recent chapters it is shown that she takes the form of a crossbow, able to fire high pressure spirit shots up to 10 km accurately. She is also suggested to have a genius IQ, and is an extremely competent information gatherer and tactician, easily finding one of Arachnephobia's labs.

Called "Little Demon" by Soul Eater, he is a strange demonic imp that appeared before Soul inside his heart after his first encounter with Ragnarök. He told Soul "to be strong... follow me..." when soul decides to follow the imp states; "There will be insanity and ecstasy of joy." He may represent the power of the black blood and the insanity deep inside everyone's heart.

Mizune is the surname of a large family of witches who all look alike and whose animal theme are mice. They speak by saying, "chi" (sound of a mouse squeak). One witch from this family is initially introduced as a friend of Eruka's. Like Eruka, she does not like the fact that Medusa has so much freedom and that she brings Chrona to the witch meetings. Mizune and Eruka try to kill her for endangering all witches while she is staying at Shibusen. Mizune is killed by Medusa when Medusa set off her snake bombs that she had implanted in Mizune's body. Five members of the family join Medusa after Eruka tells them that their family member that Medusa killed was actually killed by a Shibusen student. The five family members can merge into a single being capable of actual speech.     The form is of a good-looking young woman with short pink hair with a hat, long skirt, and a shirt showing her stomach and a good portion of her breasts; this exposed portion is most likely where the deceased Mizune covered.    (ref: [Wiki](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Soul_Eater_characters#Mizune))

Tezca wears both the pants and jacket to a black suit, with a white polo shirt. Nothing of his facial features are known because of the large bear mask that he wears upon his head, completely covering all aspects of his face. It was also due to this element in his appearance that he was given the nickname Mysterious Bear when he first appeared.  Tezca is the Death Scythe in charge of South America.

He is the father of Black Star and the leader of the infamous Star Clan.  Much like Black Star, he was very bent towards being the best and winning every battle.  In the past, White Star was put into a very similar situation as Black Star in his battle with Mifune.  They were both asked by Mifune about which path (path of a Warrior or path of a Demon) they'd rather take.  White Star did not answer, but Mifune was easily able to tell that White Star already took the path of a Demon.  Black Star simply said he'd make his own path.  White Star was slain in battle by Mifune.

personnages.nom_natif: ジャクリーン・オー・ランタン・デュプレ
personnages.description:
An honor student in the E.A.T Class and demon weapon partner of Kim Diehl.

~!Originally a part of Kilik's team, she is later promoted to a two-star weapon and is enlisted in Spartoi after Arachnophobia's defeat.!~

A top-class elite meister at Death Weapon Meister Academy, partner of Harvar D. Éclair, and a part of Kilik's team. Considered one of the top students in terms of grades within the DWMA, second only to [Maka Albarn](https://anilist.co/character/8439/Maka-Albarn).

~!Formerly one of the top one-star students, he later is promoted to a two-star status and is a member of the elite team, Spartoi.!~

During his one episode appearance, Hiro was a loser at Shibusen that couldn't do anything right, and was constantly picked on or used by other students. One day, Hiro learned of Excalibur, and seeked out to be his partner. During his time with Excalibur, he was able to defeat Black Star, Death the Kid, and Kilik at the same time, by simply saying the name of an attack, which was followed by an explosion. Hiro was also able to complete all 1,000 of Excalibur's tasks, but the one thing he could not stand was his incessant sneezing. He later dropped Excalibur and took up weight lifting.

Referred to as "Mole Hunter" Joe Buttataki, Joe makes his first appearance at the end of chapter thirty-seven of the manga when he is called to Shibusen to investigate the possibility of a spy. His name when literally translated is "kick the shit out of," a phrase he says at the end of chapter thirty-seven in the manga. He is able to detect the snake placed in Marie's body. He is the ex-boyfriend of Marie Mjolnir. Joe had apparently kept his distance from her, fearing that his "soul perception" may grow so powerful that he could see through her. Joe stated to Marie that he regretted his decision and asked her out for dinner. He considers his ability unpleasant since it only allows him to work a job where he can only mistrust his allies. Joe is the first technician to be able to pierce a witch's technique to appear human and his power is growing even now.    -Wiki

Otama Jackson is a gigantic black tadpole with googly eyes, a long tail and a wide red-lipped mouth bearing a set of sharp teeth. He is a very loyal and hard-working familiar, always doing his best to serve Eruka, even if it means putting himself in harm's way.  His main function is to act as a mount for Eruka, using his large size and capability to fly to aid his master in whatever way possible. However, Otama Jackson has very low stamina, and cannot fight at all, making him easily exhausted and extremely vulnerable to attack.    Unlike other Witches with their familiars the two seem to share a close friendship with each other despite Eruka's apparent dominant role in the relationship, with even the normally docile Eruka reprimanding Free after he only slightly injures Jackson. Jackson in turn is extremely loyal to Eruka, going so far as to help pass her the needle of Black Blood that is supposed to reawaken Asura before Black Star can get at it, resulting in the tadpole getting beaten up by Black Star. Eruka laments over this, and decides to fulfill the mission solely for Jackson's sake.

personnages.nom_natif: ポット・オブ・サンダー
personnages.description: Pot of Thunder, or simply Thunder, is one of Kilik's two weapon partners and takes the form of a pot, although in weapon form it's shape is actually that of a glove.     Fire and Thunder are young small twins, befitting their young age in comparison to other characters within the series. Both have a dark skin complexion and facial features consisting of blue eyes, rosy cheeks and mid-length blonde hair framing their faces. Their main differences are; Thunder is female and wears a yellow cap.    Despite being powerful weapons, they are still kids and as such, are distracted and quarrel a lot.

Chisa Kotegawa is Iori's cousin and a first-year mechanical engineering student at Izu University. Chisa appears to more level-headed and serious compared to other characters. She has a clear dislike for rowdy behavior and can be quite hostile, especially when it is directed towards her (especially with Iori). She rarely takes part in drinking or crazy antics and is usually seen sitting off the side as an observer. She loves diving and looking at diving equipment. Chisa is one of three female students in her class idolized by her male classmates due to her major's lack of females.

~!It is later revealed that she and Iori are not related by blood since Iori's father is adopted by her maternal grandparent.!~

Iori Kitahara is a first year Mechanical Engineering student at Izu University. Despite no initial interest, Iori comes to love diving and spending time with the members of the club, whom he becomes friends with and cares about despite their rambunctious behavior and endless crazy schemes.

A first-year Mechanical Engineering student at Izu University. He is [Iori](https://anilist.co/character/123182/Kitahara-Iori)'s best friend and a diehard otaku, perceived to be a lolicon by his acquaintances. He happens to be particularly obsessed with the little sister character trope (hence his obsession with [Shiori Kitahara](https://anilist.co/character/125928/Kitahara-Shiori)). While many are repulsed by his otaku lifestyle, he is indifferent to how he is perceived by others.

Aina is a first year at Oumi Women's University. She joins Grand Blue Diving Club after getting to know Iori and Kouhei. She is a really shy girl and hates having to expose her skin. She soon becomes good friends with Chisa.

~!She used to wear strong makeups to appear attractive not realizing her very makeup was a turn-off for men. She was part of the Tinkerbell Tennis Club but she was always looked down upon and made fun of by her seniors. Iori and Kouhei came to her rescue when she had it enough during the Miss Izu Contest as she resorted to getting drunk and broke down in tears in front of them.!~

~!Iori's words after saving Aina from the depth of despair during the Miss Izu Contest moved her so much so that suddenly her heart skipped a beat for him. She soon finds herself having feelings for Iori but she has been keeping her feelings to herself and she is yet to tell Iori how she feels about him. Iori is also the reason why she approached Azusa to let her join Grand Blue Diving Club.!~

She is a student at Oumi Women's University and the coworker of Iori Kitahara and Naomi Otoya. She has a crush on Otoya Naomi.
~!She was cheered up by Iori after Naomi rejected her confession. Soon after that, she has developed romantic feelings for Iori, of which he is unaware. She lip-locked him in front of Chisa and Aina during their second trip to Okinawa islands.!~

Azusa Hamaoka is a third-year at Oumi University and is a part of the intercollegiate diving club with Izu University. Known for her very outgoing and exhibitionist personality, she displays particular friendship/comradeship to Iori.

Iori's Elder Cousin. When Iori comes to Grand Blue he doesn't recognise her at first since she had become very beautiful and gets attracted to her only to find out later that she has become a siscon who smells her younger sister Chisa's after worn clothes and takes her photo all the time.
He is a third year Mechanical Engineering student at Izu University.
He is a third year Mechanical Engineering student at Izu University.
She is a third year middle school student and the younger sister of Iori Kitahara.
Otoya Naomi is a high school student who loves diving. He is the captain of the diving club at his school and the coworker of Iori and Sakurako.
He works as an associate professor at Izu University.

He is a first year Mechanical Engineering student at Izu University. He is a chubby young man with short hair parted in the middle. He mostly seen wearing a plain t-shirt under a sweatshirt and sweatpants. He is really bent on the idea that he needs a girlfriend and he is a complete virgin
Famous voice actor and idol who is worshipped by Kouhei. Her real name is Maya.
One of Iori's classmates at Izu University. Unlike most of the others, Yuu is in a relationship with his childhood friend Rie, which his friends immediately attempt to sabotage once they find out.
She is a first year student at Oumi Women's University and Yuu Mitarai's childhood friend.
He is a first year Mechanical Engineering student at Izu University. Nojima is a tall and self-proclaimed handsome young man.

Aina's freshmen friend and a first year student at Oumi Women's University.
~!Kanako is actually the younger sister of Idol Singer Kaya Mizuki.!~
German lecturer at Izu University.
Aina's freshmen friend and a first year student at Oumi Women's University.
Bar Master is the manager of the bar where [Ryuujirou Kotobuki](https://anilist.co/character/127067/Ryuujirou-Kotobuki) works part-time as a bartender.

She is a German woman who's come to Japan for 90 days. She's a big fan of the mobile game Blue Spring.
~!Blue Spring is an 18+ game which she wants to recreate in real life, replacing the in-game characters with Chisa and Shiori.!~
Aina's freshmen friend and a first year student at Oumi Women's University. She admits that whenever someone is innocent and pure, she feels the need to corrupt them.
One of Iori's classmates at Izu University. A muscular man who is jealous of Iori supposedly getting Chisa's affection.

The owner of the diving shop Grand Blue and Iori's uncle. Toshio seems to have a jovial personality and is quite laid back, as he doesn't seem to mind all the havoc that the club members wreck when drinking and partying.

The Captain of the Tennis Club "Tinkerbell" and a beautiful young man who is attracted to Azusa. Kudou is an arrogant womanizer that would do almost anything to achieve his goal. He tends to mistreat those whom he considers lowly.

She is Chisa and Nanaka's mother and the manager of Dophin diving pad at Palau, where Chisa, Iori, Kouhei and Aina work part-time during summer break. Sayaka is a serious and straightforward person, who doesn't talk beyond what is necessary and acts cold towards Chisa.
~!She is deaf in her left ear, because of constantly ear pressure during diving, and never told Chisa because she knows how much she loves diving.!~
An idol and voice actress. Engaged to Yuichi Ikegoshi.
He is [Iori's](https://anilist.co/character/123182/Iori-Kitahara) father and [Chisa's](https://anilist.co/character/123181/Chisa-Kotegawa) uncle.

Yuichi Ikegoshi is a male Idol part of the SIPS (Boy Band) who was first introduced in Chapter 52 on Palau as part of the TV Crew where he is one of the hosts for the TV show.
Yuichi and Kouhei Imamura look-a-like, so when Yuichi got injured, Kouhei replaced him as the TV-host by offering him an autograph of Yurika Muranaka.

__Species__: Demigod

Brunhilde is the eldest of the 13 Valkyrie Sisters and the main protagonist of the series.

She is the one who chose humanity's finest and strongest warriors in Ragnarok to stand up against the strongest gods in combat and slay them in an attempt to save Humanity.

__Species:__ Demigod

Göll is the youngest of the 13 Valkyrie Sisters and the deuteragonist of the series. During the Ragnarok matches, she is usually seen with Brunhilde anxiously watching each match.

She's usually anxious and worried about many things to the point that it gets on Brunhilde's and Hrist's nerves. Whenever humanity's warriors die, she cries and mourns each of her sisters as they die with them.
As an apprentice valkyrie, she doesn't seem all that interested in saving humanity compared to worrying about her sisters.

Adam was a very calm, collected, and carefree individual; speaking to Zeus in a very casual manner, much to the chagrin of the other gods present.
We later find out that Adam holds no grudge against heaven, despite the fact the Serpent assaulted Eve and then framed her when he was elsewhere, resulting in humanity's banishment from Eden. However, at the same time, he did not hesitate to kill the Serpent the moment he attacked them.

Adam loved Eve, so much so that he abandoned the paradise of Eden without a second thought when his wife was banished.

Adam displayed selflessness to the highest degree, pushing himself past his limits in his fight against a god to give humanity a bit of hope. Adam's love for his children was strong enough that, even in a battle for his life, he only thought of protecting humanity from anyone who'd try and do them harm. 

~!He was Humanity's representative in the second round of Ragnarok.!~

__Species:__ God, Human (formerly)
~!__Affiliation:__ Humanity!~

Buddha has an easygoing attitude and does not seem to take anything seriously. His confidence is great enough for him to challenge [Zeus](https://anilist.co/character/140640/Zeus) to his face by claiming that the only one who can push him around in "all of heaven and Earth" is himself. Buddha also appears to have a sweet tooth as he was seen eating lollipops when walking and eating chocolates while relaxing.

Buddha also seems to display respect for other people by offering them foods he's currently eating, like when he didn't allow Zeus to steal one of his sweets, but offered his popcorn to [Brunhilde](https://anilist.co/character/140636/Brunhilde).

~!The human's representative for round 6!~

personnages.nom_natif: ジャック・ザ・リッパー
personnages.description:
__Species:__ Human
__Affiliation:__ Humanity 

Jack the Ripper, or Jack, is an infamous serial killer hailing from late 19th century Britain.

Normally, Jack has the disposition of a typical British Gentlemen, accentuated by his sophisticated diction and actions. However, Jack is a true sadist and monster at heart, being considered by most to be a person shrouded in malice and evil, murdering people as he considers the fear they feel before death to be absolutely beautiful. ~!Jack the Ripper is Humanity's representative in the fourth round of Ragnarok.!~

Qin Shi Huang was the founder of the Qin Dynasty and the first emperor to unify China. His real name is Ying Zheng. Qin Shi Huang, also known as Shi Huang Di, literally means "First Emperor of Qin". He is widely regarded as the greatest Chinese emperor of all time despite sometimes being viewed as a tyrant.
Kojiro Sasaki's a famous swordsman from Japan, known as "History's Greatest Loser". ~!Kojiro Sasaki is Humanity's representative in the third round of Ragnarok.!~
The God of destruction and one of the principal deities of Hinduism.

personnages.surnom: The God Most Trusted by the Gods
personnages.description:
__Species:__ God
__Affiliation:__ Gods

He is the current God of the Underworld also known as Helheim.

Poseidon is a prominent deity in the Greek Pantheon as the God of the Seas.

~!Poseidon is the Gods' representative in the third round of Ragnarok.!~

__Species__: God
__Affiliation:__ Gods

Beelzebub is a prominent deity in the Philistine Pantheon and Abrahamic Pantheon. He is also the Lord of the Flies.
~!Beelzebub is the God's representative in the 8th round of Ragnarok.!~

Heracles is a prominent deity in the Greek Pantheon. He is also one of the few divine beings, along with [Buddha](https://anilist.co/character/175945/Buddha) and the Valkyries, who are not in favor of ending Humanity.

~!Heracles is the Gods' representative in the fourth round of Ragnarok.!~

__Species:__ God
__Affiliation:__ Gods

Similar to Lü Bu, Thor is a battle maniac and takes great interest in fighting; especially with strong and/or worthy opponents. Furthermore, he only shows happiness and joy in combat, displaying his finest smile in the first round of Ragnarok. Thor is also a man of few words, not speaking unless absolutely necessary or when in combat. He often does not show this and has a more stoic and aloof expression on his face most of the time, making him seem unapproachable to others.

~!Thor is the Gods' representative in the first round of Ragnarok.!~

Nikola Tesla is a scientist just like his real-life counterpart. He doesn't believe in things like magic or gods, claiming they are just laws of Physics.

~!He is the 8th fighter for Humanity in the Ragnarok Tournament, and his volund is with the 9th Valkyrie sister, [Gondoul](https://anilist.co/character/386569/Gondul).!~
Messenger of the gods.

The Gods' representative in the eleventh round of Ragnarok.
He is a prominent deity in the Norse Pantheon, known as the God of Mischief.
Lü Bu, the Flying General was the strongest warrior of The Three Kingdoms. ~!Humanity's vanguard and representative in the first round of Ragnarok.!~

__Species:__ Human
__Affiliation:__ Humanity

Raiden Tameemon, born Tarōkochi Seki, is Humanity's representative in the fifth round of Ragnarok.

Göll described Raiden as the "incarnation of desire", being shown as a perverted and lustful man when around beautiful women. Despite this, he claims that he's always completely serious about any statement he makes.

Growing up as child, Raiden was viewed a monster by many other kids and became depressed, his mother would encourage him to use his strength for the good of the weak and always hugged him with love. From that day, Raiden took his mother's words to heart and used his strength to help the villagers around him. When the "Great Tenmei Famine" began, Raiden became saddened by the death and suffering occuring all over his village and so decided to become a sumo wrestler to raise money for his hometown.

It is said that Raiden has the strongest muscles in human history and was considered to be the best of all time.
Captain of the first unit of the Shinsengumi. ~!Souji Okita is Humanity's representative in the tenth round of Ragnarok.!~
Aphrodite is the Greek goddess of beauty.

__Species:__ God
__Affiliation:__ Gods

Zeus is a prominent deity and the Supreme God in the Greek Pantheon. He is also the chairman of the Gods' Council and often referred to as the "God Father of Cosmos"

When addressing his fellow gods, Zeus is extremely calm and authoritative while possessing a very formal and wise disposition. Like most gods, Zeus holds his own kind to a superior and extremely high standard, always expecting them to win no matter the odds, and seething with anger when they lose to humans. Zeus is also an eccentric individual, having random exaggerated emotional outbursts, breaking into a dance at the start of the second round of Ragnarok in front of everyone present, even being called the most shameful god by Hermes.

However, after several rounds of Ragnarok passed, Zeus became more humble, even acknowledging Humanity's strength. He is also extremely faithful and confident in those of the Greek Pantheon.

~!Zeus is the Gods' representative in the second round of Ragnarok.!~
Simo Häyhä, nicknamed "The White Death", is a Finnish sniper. He is believed to have killed over 500 men during the 1939–40 Winter War. He's set to fight in a future match of Ragnarok.

~!Affiliation: Gods!~

The God of Misfortune.

~!He is also the fusion of the Seven Lucky Gods, being their original form before splitting up in the past.!~

~!The Gods' representative for round 6, taking the place of Bishamonten.!~

__Species__: Demigod

Hrist is the second of the 13 Valkyrie sisters. ~!She forms a Völundr with [Kojirou Sasaki](https://anilist.co/character/140646/Kojirou-Sasaki) during the third round of Ragnarok.!~

Apollo is a prominent deity within the Greek Pantheon. He is known as the "Sun God" and is a part of the Twelve Gods of Olympus. 

~!Apollo is the Gods' representative in the ninth round of Ragnarok.!~
Supreme god of Nordic.

__Species:__ Demigod

Hlökk is the eleventh of the 13 Valkyrie sisters. ~!She forms a Völundr with [Jack the Ripper](https://anilist.co/character/159840/Jack-the-Ripper) during the fourth round of Ragnarok.!~
Eve is the wife of Adam, who was falsely accused by The Serpent of eating the apple from the Tree of Knowledge.
Chun Yan was the caretaker and bodyguard of [Qin Shi Huang](https://anilist.co/character/203633/Shihuang-Qin).
Prudr is the third of the Valkyrie sisters.~!She forms a Völundr with [Raiden Tameemon](https://anilist.co/character/168999/Raiden-Tameemon) during Ragnarok.!~
The watchman of the apocalypse.

personnages.nom_natif: ミシェル・ノストラダムス
personnages.description: Michel Nostradamus is a prophet, physician, fortune teller, and one of the Einherjar set to fight in a future match of Ragnarok. He is regarded as the prophet of the century and is also described as the “most obnoxious man in all of history”. After his death, due to the prophecy of the “Great King of Terror”, he came to be feared by the underworld as a “Major Threat to the Netherworld".
Rudra is the Hindu god of storms and the dear friend of Shiva, who is participating in the fifth round of Ragnarök.

Jesus is the Son of God and one of Buddha's supporters. He is one of the Four Sages alongside Buddha, Socrates and Confucius.

He is the central figure of Christianity, the world's largest religion.

For the most part, Jesus remains calm and stoic, not showing much reaction except under extreme moments.

__Species__: Demigod

Reginleif is the seventh of the 13 Valkyrie sisters. ~!She forms a Völundr with [Adam](https://anilist.co/character/140637/Adam) during the second round of Ragnarok.!~

Yuriko is a friend of Miku's. She is Yuzuru's wife.

Engine is from the Abyss and the man that saved [Rudo](https://anilist.co/character/266433/Rudo) when he fell out of the sky. He has a very bright and fun personality, but very little energy and seemingly is chill and laid-back. Despite his incredible abilities, he refers to himself as "your average janitor."

__Height:__ 163 cm
__Jinki:__ "3R"

Rudo is the foster son of [Regto](https://anilist.co/character/266437/Regto). 

He was originally from the slums of the Sphere, but ended up sentenced to the Abyss after being falsely accused of murder. Due to being physically abused and abandoned by his real parents, Rudo is emotionally closed off and introverted and has permanent painful scars on his hands; having to keep them covered up by bandages and a pair of gloves Regto gifted to him to help sooth the excruciating pain.

__Height:__ 155 cm
__Jinki:__ "The Ripper"

She’s a former hitman and currently a member of the Akuta faction of the Cleaners. She has an unusual fighting style where she wields her large scissors with her feet. Normally cheerful and playful, she becomes strikingly pragmatic in battle.

__Height:__ 178 cm 
__Jinki:__ "Lovely Assistaff"

He’s a former Hell Guard trainee and is currently a member of the Akuta faction of the Cleaners.

__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")

Amo is a teenage girl who lives in the Forbidden Zone Penta. She is able to breath in the Abyss and has seen someone who can go up to Heaven. Whilst appearing sweet and almost childlike, she is easily made emotional and will lash out at others if provoked.

Amo's vital instrument is a pair of watchmen series boots, which when worn together, can produce a 'smell'. Using her jinki, she's able to manipulate the smell and give all who breath it in hallucinations of people they treasure and thus turning them on their allies.

Jabber is a Giver and is a member of the Vandals, a criminal group of givers. He is known to be an unhinged psychopath and has a violent obsession with battle; always being eager to enter a fight with a wide grin and only acknowledging those that are strong enough to compete with him. He is also a masochist, being labeled as a "super masochist" by [Rudo](https://anilist.co/character/266433/Rudo), and finds excitement and ecstasy through pain.

__Height:__ 180 cm
__Jinki:__ "Tokushin"

He is a member of the Cleaners' Team Eager. His vital instrument is a distaff and he has a calm demeanor and sharp observing eye.

__Affiliation:__ Cleaners
__Height:__ 175 cm + 8 cm Heels
__Jinki:__ "Eyes"

Semiu is very confident and professional, preferring to get on with things as quickly as possible. She is dedicated to her job, being at the janitors desk and picking up calls as soon as dawn strikes. She says to [Rudo](https://anilist.co/character/266433/Rudo) that his stability using a jinki is high, so he needs to train it.

Semiu's jinki is unique in the sense it is not used as a weapon to take down Aberrant Beasts, but rather as a tool to assess a Givers potential. Semiu is able to see the unseen, and how far one can go, which sometimes leads to shocking discoveries.

__Affiliation:__ Cleaners
__Height:__ 175 cm

Follo is a young man. He is in the support Cleaners group due to him lacking a jinki of his own, but is cultivating a 'treasured item' of his own to become a giver. 

Follo owns an hammer which he uses for combat in battle, and is potentially the jinki he's cultivating.

__Affiliation:__ Cleaners
__Height:__ 193 cm

Griss is one of the Cleaners who work as a supporter type due to lacking a jinki of his own. Griss has incredible strength. His grip especially stands out, with a simple handshake causing [Rudo](https://anilist.co/character/266433/Rudo) pain. With just one hand he is able to crush the armour of an Aberrant Beast, which is known to be tough. He is also able to throw said beasts incredible distances.

__Height:__ 153 cm
__Affiliation:__ Canvas Town
__Occupation:__ Spellcaster

Remlin is a small, young kid who was chosen by [Gob](https://anilist.co/character/298956/Gob) to be the heir of his Vital Instrument, a jinki passed down from generation to generation within Canvas Town. 

They are a cheerful and celebratory kid, and despite having moments of extreme vulnerability is able to bounce back quickly and return to being joyful. Remlin, given for their age, is very childish, as they get excited easily and is very loud. They can typically been seen rushing to things, which sometimes leads to them crashing into people. Remlin is a natural Giver, and was immediately able to use the succession jinki's power upon receiving it. Using their jinki, Remlin is able to create charms for many purposes, such as protection of individuals or huge light shows.

__Height:__ 130 cm
__Jinki:__ "Centralian"

Dear Santa is a Cleaner, being a member of 'Team Child'. His vital instrument is the pacifier he usually keeps in his mouth, and he gets sleepy late at night.

personnages.description:
__Affiliation:__ Cleaners

Eishia is a rather small young woman with blonde hair and pink eyes. She is incredibly shy, not being one to take credit for things she's done. She is usually seen with her head down and hands together, preferring to just not speak at all. Aesha also shows great kindness, being willing to heal all with her gifts.

It is not known what it is, but using her jinki, Eishia is given incredible healing abilities, being able to raise someone from near death to full health in a matter of hours.

__Affiliation:__ Cleaners (Boss)

Alha is the boss of the Cleaners. He is strong, reliable and trustworthy, with strong characters like [Engine](https://anilist.co/character/266438/Enjin) even acknowledging his leadership. He also is charismatic and has the peoples best intentions at heart, welcoming [Rudo](https://anilist.co/character/266433/Rudo) immediately into the Cleaners because of his faith in his companions.

personnages.description:
__Height:__ 200 cm

Bundus is an antagonist in Gachiakuta. He is a Giver and a former rookie member of the Vandals organization.

After showing promise when fighting the janitors, [Zodyl](https://anilist.co/character/306966/Typhon-Zodyl) promoted him to the Vandal’s Organization’s front line known as the Star team.

personnages.description:
__Affiliation:__ Vandals
__Height:__ 152 cm
__Jinki:__ "Manhole"

Cthoni is a rather short, androgynous girl. She is constantly emotionless, often showing little to no expression. She is very quiet and doesn't speak up, which gives her the effect of being unnoticed and being able to sneak up on people. She is realistic in battles, as while [Jabber](https://anilist.co/character/298953/Wonger-Jabber) yearns to continue an unbeatable fight, she knowns it's right to retreat. Cthoni is incredibly strong, being able to pick up Jabber who is many times her size with ease.

Using her jinki, which is a sewer manhole, Cthoni is able to teleport from one place to another quickly and quietly without notice. The manhole is able to fit one person at a time and can vanish when covered again.

__Affiliation:__ Cleaners
__Height:__ 167 cm

Tomme is a young woman. She is in the support Cleaners group due to her lacking a jinki of his own. She is a compassionate woman, immedietly showing concern for members of the mission trapped in the basement upon [Engine](https://anilist.co/character/266438/Enjin)'s arrival. She is shown visibly emotional when Engine calms her nerves about them. Later when they find out [Rudo](https://anilist.co/character/266433/Rudo) was deeply upset due to mistaking [Griss](https://anilist.co/character/298958/Rubion-Gris) for being dead, she comforts him.

Being a supporter, Tomme is tought to have a good amount of strength used to fight Aberrant Beasts.
She is a member of the Raiders front line.

personnages.description: Noerde Hew Amozo is an antagonist in Gachiakuta and member of the Vandals.

__Jinki__: "Lunavis"

She is a famous entertainer on the Ground. She also performed as the opening act for the Doll Festival.

Bro Santa is a Cleaner, and is the leader of 'Team Child'. He cares greatly for [Dear](https://anilist.co/character/306959/Dia-Santa) and watches over him, even though they are not related by blood. His vital instrument is his bandana.
She is a member of the Hell Guard training camp.

She’s a member of the Hell Guard as the captain of company one “Red Horns.”

~!Like the rest of her family Kyouka managed to earn the rank of Hell Guard but due to an unknown reason never sat on the golden throne.!~
Mildretta is a former member of the warrior tribe Sileia and currently works as a Supporter at the Cleaners' South Branch.

__Affiliation:__ Cleaners
__Jinki:__ "Thirst Quencher"

Delmon is a loud and passionate man, always shouting at the top of his lungs. In his past, Delmon worked as a farmer. He knew a woman whos dream it was to see a flower bloom, even in the dead Abyss. Delmon worked tirelessly, eventually cultivating his jinki, out of his desire to make said plants 'grow big'. He eventually did produce a flower and showed it to the woman, who was joyous to see one. Delmon made it his goal to fill the house with flowers. One day, Delmon's farm was attacked by Vandals, leaving a deep mental scar.

Delmon's jinki is a water hose. This grew from his desire to make plants 'grow big'. Much like real water hose's, Delmon's jinki has several different nozzles, which can change the power of the jinki.

A girl who lives in the slums in the Sphere. [Rudo](https://anilist.co/character/266433/Rudo) likes her because of the way she seems to care and worry about him.

(Source: Official Site)

__Affiliation:__ Canvas Town

Gob is a generational Giver who could create protection charms using his marker Jinki. At some point in his life, he would inherit the generational marker jinki. Using this, he would begin to create charms using it's abilities. He created a charm around Canvas Town which prevented those with bad intentions from entering.

~!He died from contamination in the Abyss. His corpse was found, and taken to a morgue. The doctors discovered the cause to be contamination exposure. The mayor and the janitors would mourn his lose, as his jinki and legacy was passed onto the next jinki bearer.!~

Alice Stilza is a famous doctor that took part in the treatment for body contamination since the very beginning, but while she was researching contaminated material for the treatment, she took one in without realizing it, causing her voice and her appearence to be weird.

Stilza is very old, with no hair left on her head. The skin on her face is sagging to the point her skull bones are poking out. She is missing several teeth and has a large nose and ear piecing's.

Mymo is a well known news reporter on the Ground.
~!During the Doll Festival arc, Mymo was the MC and announcer for multiple events. After the events concluded, he used the Chokers made by the Choker maker to control the attendees of the Doll Festival and unveil himself as the ruler of the world.
__Jinki:__ "Elenhos"!~
She serves under Mymo the Ruler.
A member of the cleaners who uses their giver ability to shield Cleaner HQ from uninvited intruders
A member of the raiders with a shovel vital instrument.
The twin brother of Epalte Adderoy. He is a Janitor from Danger.

Clare is the series' protagonist. In the beginning of the series she is number 47 of the organization's 78th generation, making her the lowest ranked claymore. She also holds the distinction of becoming the first individual to willingly become a claymore.  Her goal is revenge against the awakened being [Priscilla](https://anilist.co/character/2624/Priscilla).

She saves [Raki](https://anilist.co/character/2208/Raki) from a youma and takes him under her care because he reminds her of herself when she was younger.

Clare bears a striking physical resemblance to [Ikuno](https://anilist.co/character/8568/Ikuno-Shirataki) from Angel Densetsu, Norihiro Yagi's previous manga.

__Name:__ Miria
__Alias:__ Phantom Miria
__Rank Number:__ No.6 of 78th Generation
__Type:__ Offensive
__Special attack:__ Phantom Mirage

Miria is Claymore No. 6 of the 78th generation. Her great speed leaves after-images of herself in battle, confusing the opponent, thus earning herself the nickname, "Phantom Miria." She is also skilled at teamwork and tactics. Miria has long, pale blonde hair, styled in a razor-shag cut. She has silver eyes. After the Northern Campaign, she sometimes ties it in a ponytail. Miria has superior leadership qualities. But contrary to Organization aims, Miria takes personally the deaths of those under her command. She will go to great lengths to keep them alive, including disobeying the Organization's rules and orders. She can plan strategy under difficult conditions. Since [Hilda](https://anilist.co/character/10149/Hilda)'s death, Miria lost all trust in the Organization and seeks its destruction.

Number 22 in Clare's generation, Helen's specialty is attacking her enemies with her stretching arms, giving her a surprisingly long range of attack, as well as the ability to constrict the enemy. Hot tempered and aggressive, Helen mocked Clare because of her rank when she joined the hunting party, but she eventually grew to respect her later on.

__Race:__ Human
__Hometown:__ Doga (Lautrec)  
__Occupation:__ Swordman  
__Afiliations:__ Claymore (Ally) ∕ Seven Ghost (Ally) 
__Generation:__ [Clare](https://anilist.co/character/2188/Clare) ~ [Clarice](https://anilist.co/character/3336/Clarice) 
__Know relatives:__ [Zaki](https://anilist.co/character/35614/Zaki) (brother), Clare, ~![Priscilla](https://anilist.co/character/2624/Priscilla), [Isley](https://anilist.co/character/3339/Isley)!~

Living in his peaceful village like any ordinary boy, Raki's life is changed forever when most of his family is killed by a Yoma. When the "Claymore" Clare arrives in Raki's town to kill the Yoma, it turns out the Yoma camouflaged itself as Raki's older brother after killing the other family members. After killing the Yoma and saving Raki, Clare leaves the town. However, the superstitious villagers throws Raki out, fearing that he might turn into a Yoma himself after being so close to one. Raki follows Clare, and is eventually allowed to accompany her as her cook.  But the true hardships has not yet begun for Clare and Raki...

~!He begins learning swordsman ship under Isley of the north to become strong enough to help Clare, and is shown travelling with a regressed, child-like Priscilla. Raki is shown wearing Claymore-like Armour and wielding a massive broadsword. He easily defeats a Yoma pointed out to him by Priscilla and displays remarkable reflexes and speed. It is unknown how powerful he is in relation to Claymores or Awakened Beings, though he is shown wielding a sword somewhat larger than the ones wielded by the Claymores one handed and easily deflected the youma's attack using his forearm armor.

Raki's dialogue reveals that he now knows Priscilla's true nature. Raki also mentions that Priscilla's small frame is probably due to the fact that she has not eaten any human flesh for a few years, although she is probably "at her limit". He says that, should she submit to her hunger, he will attempt to stop her but acknowledges that he will probably fail and be eaten.  Later on he is impaled through the shoulder by an iron rod contaminated with tissue from an awakened being. Though he is the only survivor out of the entire village where it occurred, an infection has started to spread through his body, threatening to change him into a yoma. From sheer willpower, he manages to keep a slight grip on his humanity and keep the infection from spreading. The Claymore organization later takes him back to their headquarters to analyze what is happening to him.!~

Deneve is a defensive type Claymore, and thus sports powerful regenerative abilities.

She has a rather calm and empathetic personality, and is quite different from her friend [Helen](https://anilist.co/character/2732/Helen). She was part of the awakened-hunting squad led by [Miria](https://anilist.co/character/2702/Miria), along with Helen and [Clare](https://anilist.co/character/2188/Clare). Deneve is number 15 of the 78th generation

Teresa is known for effortlessly slaying enemies with a faint smile on her face, is the strongest of her generation and considered to be the most powerful Claymore of all time. She is much faster, stronger, and more agile than those below her, but her real strength is considered to be her "unparalleled ability to sense Yoma aura." She can sense it to the point where she can accurately predict her opponent's moves in battle. Despite facing an awakened former number one, Rosemary, she has never used more than ten percent of her full power, which is only enough to change her eye color.

Before becoming a Claymore, she was referred to as a "problem child" by her handlers during her training. Teresa initially does her job without caring about who she is helping, and she takes pleasure in scaring humans. She eventually meets [Clare](https://anilist.co/character/2188/Clare), who decides to start following Teresa after being abandoned by her village. Teresa is initially irritated, but soon grows fond of her. 

~!After leaving Clare in a village in an attempt to give her a normal life, bandits raid the village. Teresa kills all of them, which causes her to be hunted by the Organization for breaking the rule of never killing humans. She doesn't kill any of the Claymores after her because of her time with Clare, but she is slain by [Priscilla](https://anilist.co/character/2624/Priscilla) off guard when Priscilla begs to be slain before awakening. Clare takes her severed head and convinces a member of the Organization to use it in place of a Yoma to turn her into a Claymore.!~

Claymore number three of the seventyeight generation, Galatea acts as the organization's eye because of her superb Youki sensing ability. Galatea can sense not only the size of the Youki of her targets, but also their emotions and actions, from a long distance. Her ability can also be used offensively, as she is able to control other Youki users by channeling the energy inside them to serve her own will.    After the seven year timeskip it is revealed she hid in Rabona and cut her own eyes to avoid being noticed as a former warrior for the organization working as a nun for the orphanage. Incidentally this enhanced her yoki sensing abilities beyond what they were before.

Claymore number three (before [Priscilla](https://anilist.co/character/2624/Priscilla) number two) of the 77th generation, she is known as "Quick Sword Irene", capable of lashing out innumerable lightning fast sword strikes by accumulating all her Youki energy in her sword arm.

~!Even thought she was considered dead by the Organization, she merely lost an arm from the encounter with the Awakaned Priscilla. She saves [Clare](https://anilist.co/character/2188/Clare) from [Ophelia](https://anilist.co/character/2939/Ophelia) and teaches her the Quick Sword technique. Irene gives Clare her right arm, so she can control her technique better. After Clare leaves her shelter, [Rafaela](https://anilist.co/character/3019/Rafaela) appears and kills Irene.!~

__First Appearance:__ Volume 8 (Manga), Episode 15 (Anime)
__Former Rank:__ #1
__Type:__ unknown

Riful is the Abyssal One of the western territory. She was the number one in the first generation of female Claymores and the youngest ever to awaken. She presents herself as cheerful and polite, though she will instantly discard anyone who gets in the way of her goals. She lives with her lover, [Dauf](https://anilist.co/character/3337/Dauf), and she constantly attempts to force strong Claymores to awaken, often through torture, in order to increase her companions. She later focuses her interest on matching [Isley](https://anilist.co/character/3339/Isley) and [Priscilla](https://anilist.co/character/2624/Priscilla)'s power in order to stop them from advancing into her territory, and she finds the merged form of [Rafaela](https://anilist.co/character/3019/Rafaela) and [Luciela](https://anilist.co/character/3340/Luciela). She wishes to awaken the new being, and captures [Renée](https://anilist.co/character/13789/Renee) for that reason.

Riful's awakened form retains a feminine humanoid form, but one composed of fleshy strips. Her lower body is an immense mass of such strips, which are incredibly resilient and capable of lashing out at high speeds to ensnare or impale her opponents. Her enemies often attempt to attack the humanoid portion, though it simply splits into the strips when attacked.

~!After Rafaela/Luciela's Awakening and the chaos that ensued, Riful was attacked by the Abyssal Feeders and [Alicia](https://anilist.co/character/3243/Alicia), and was rendered too weak to use her Awakened Form and left with one human leg remaining (forcing her to use some of her "tentacles" to help her stay upright). She burst into tears at the thought of dying like this and begged Dauf not to help her in fear of him dying. Before Alicia could kill her, [Beth](https://anilist.co/character/3244/Beth)'s Awakening and fight against Priscilla caused Alicia to abandon Riful and assist her sister, although she was killed in the process. This doesn't last for long, as Priscilla finds her Yoki and presumable kills Dauf and her. It turns out Duaf lived but deliberately according to Priscilla let himself be infected with the Destroyers Projectiles. After a surprise attack on Priscilla where he pounds her into the ground Duaf throws the top half of Riful's body on the ground. [Deneve](https://anilist.co/character/2731/Deneve) and [Helen](https://anilist.co/character/2732/Helen) presume its a human woman's corpse which shows she has died as she emits no yoki and doesn't move.!~

An offensive fighter holding the rank of number nine in the seventy eight generation. Her trademark ability is twisting her arm, then releasing the energy into one powerful thrust. Honorable and serious, she is well respected and said to be one of the most powerful Claymores.

~!When [Riful](https://anilist.co/character/2622/Riful) tortures Jean in order to make her join her army of awakened beings to fight [Isley of the North](https://anilist.co/character/3339/Isley), her body awakens but her mind remains human. She asks [Clare](https://anilist.co/character/2188/Clare), who was sent by [Galatea](https://anilist.co/character/2771/Galatea) to rescue her, to kill her so she can die as a human being. But Clare manages to save Jean's life and helps her to regain her human form.

Since then Jean considers her life Clare's to use and stays on her side, so when the organisation asked Clare to go fight in the north batlle, she followed her. Jean ended up killed during this battle after paying her debt to Clare, by using her last strenght to help Clare regain her human form after her body had completly awoken.!~

After losing her family to a Yoma attack, Priscilla decided to fight all she considered evil in the world. After joining the Organization, she quickly rose to rank no2, and even then she was said to still hold more powers, perhaps holding more potentional than any other Claymore before her. Like [Teresa](https://anilist.co/character/2398/Teresa), Priscilla had the ability to fight with great power even without using her Youki, thus making her a dangerous opponent for anyone relying on reading the flow of Youki.

Priscilla was one of the four Claymores sent to execute Teresa when she strayed from the organization, but the catastrophic outcome of the battle spawned one of the most fearsome beings to ever haunt the world.

Isley is a male Awakened being, ex Number 1 of the Organizations very first generation of warriors. When in his transformed state he resembles a sleek, black centaur whose right arm can act as a lance or axe and the left as a bow or shield. He fires homing arrows with great skill.

Isley initiated the Northern campaign in order to kill [Luciela](https://anilist.co/character/3340/Luciela) and take over the south and become an unrivaled power by destroying the possibility of an alliance between [Riful](https://anilist.co/character/2622/Riful) and Luciela against him and [Priscilla](https://anilist.co/character/2624/Priscilla). Isley sacrificed his awakened followers to distract the organization and Riful, while he went south to eliminate Luciela. The organization sent 24 claymores to slow down Isley's allies, while they prepared [Alicia](https://anilist.co/character/3243/Alicia) for controlled awakening.

During the North campaign, he finds [Raki](https://anilist.co/character/2208/Raki) and takes him in. Later when Raki compliments him on his skills with a sword, Isley agrees to become Raki's teacher and begins to instruct him in swordsmanship. Isley comments that Raki reminds him a lot of how he was in his own youth.

In the next seven years after he the sent the awakened beings to the west and east, it is discovered that Isley emerged victorious against Luciela in which both contestants nearly died. Isley remained quiet for the next 7 years and later, he is discovered being hunted by Abyss feeders. In the aftermath, Isley finally falls after been slowly eaten away.

Also within the time, what happened in the aftermath between Luciela and Isley was told by Riful as she personally visited Isley as a one time chance to slay him only to discover Priscilla. It is then she finds that Isley who supposedly defeated Priscilla was obliterated by her in a split second in which he submits being her general and covered up the story. Isley cunningly set his plans to motions as the only people who could defeat Priscilla was something stronger than Abyss ones and quickly destroyed the possible chance of being defeated by killing of Lucilla one of the 3 Abyss ones therefore unable for Riful and Luciela to become alliances thus nothing to oppose Isley.

The infamous number four of the seventyeight class, Ophelia harbours an incredible bloodlust, and particularly enjoys killing awakened ones. However, as she finds killing so unbearably fun, she has no qualms about killing humans as well, and takes great care to slaughter all witnesses, thus avoiding persecution by the organization.  Ophelia is an offensive type, and her trademark ability is "rippling" her sword by waving it back and forth with great speed, making it very hard to block or dodge.  Her hatred for awakened beings stems from an event in her past, where a certain Awakened killed her brother.     ~!Her death on 8th volume can be a reference to literary work Hamlet (William Shakespeare) . More especific, a reference to the paint "Ophelia" by John Everett Millais.  (source: glossary contained in the 8th volume of Claymore - in portuguese -, made by Panini Brasil LTDA.)  !~

Ranked number eight in the seventy eight generation, Flora Gained the nickname "Windcutter Flora" because of her lightning fast draw. The windcutter technique allows Flora to draw her sword and slash her opponent in the blink of a second, and cuts the air itself.

Ranked 47 in generation 79, Clarice is not a complete hybrid, and retains her original hair colour, and lacks some of the typical Claymore abilities, like tolerance to extreme weather. Clarice was chosen by the organization to be the handler of the mentally unstable rank 4 [Miata](https://anilist.co/character/2836/Miata).

Cassandra was Claymore No. 1 of her generation and is considered to be one of the eight most powerful Claymores of all time. During her lifetime, she was known as "Cassandra the Dust Eater".

She is one of the three Claymores revived by [Dae](https://anilist.co/character/73193/Dae) and the Organization in order to stop the uprising of the current warriors.

Cassandra seems to be self-conscious, modest, even shy, and is easily embarrassed, as seen when she blushed and averted her eyes when [Roxanne](https://anilist.co/character/45589/Roxanne) complimented her. She was also stubborn in refusing to allow other warriors to accompany her when hunting for Awakened Beings, most likely because of her technique, which often soiled her face and made her look as if she were eating dirt.

One of the Organization's mysterious servants, he is Clare's contact, giving her the new missions received from the organization and collecting the reward money after each mission. Ageless and mysterious like his peers, his true nature is unknown, and some of his actions makes it look like he has his own obscure agenda.   ~! It is later revealed that he is a spy planted in the Organization by the outside continent's draconic tribe, and his main goal is to have the Organization to collapse from within itself.!~  His name can be spelled like "Louvre" (as in the name of the French museum).

__Rank:__ 4 [Clarice time]
__Type:__ Offensive

Miata is the current generations #4. She is known as Blood Eye by her peers. Her powers lie in her keen senses and brute strength.

Miata is a young girl with long hair which covers most of her face. She wears the standard Claymore uniform.

Miata is completely focused in battle and doesn't seem to get along with people she doesn't know. However she has now formed a strong, daughter-like attachment to [Clarice](https://anilist.co/character/3336/Clarice), most likely because she is still just a child. Outside of battle she acts very much like a young child, even going as far as mimic breastfeeding from Clarice.

__First Appearance:__ Chapter 85
__Former Rank:__ #8  (Demoted current rank unknown)
__Type:__ Offensive

Dietrich is the current generation's #8. She is introduced leading an awakened being hunt, when her underpowered team is at a disadvantage because of poor tactics. She is then saved by the intervention of [Helen](https://anilist.co/character/2732/Helen) and [Deneve](https://anilist.co/character/2731/Deneve). She appears to have good deductive skills and a serious mind, because she immediately analyzes Helen and Deneve's goals and then prioritizes the safety of her teammates.

Out of a sense of debt to the duo, she decides to stick with Helen and Deneve and warns them of the abyss feeders and developments in the South and explains everything about the Abyss Feeders and how they target the Abyssal Ones.

She has since left the company of Helen and Deneve, and has left for Rabona upon Deneve's request to update [Miria](https://anilist.co/character/2702/Miria) and [Tabitha](https://anilist.co/character/3334/Tabitha) about the developments regarding Isley and the new absyss feeders. However, she declined further information to Miria upon further questioning, expressing loyalty to the Organization, and states that her delivery of the message to Miria is simply a means to repay her debt to Deneve and Helen.

Dietrich's skill surprises Helen and Deneve as she evades being knocked unconscious, saves Helen and demonstrates either a strong improvised attack or unnamed skill of using the enemies body as a spring board to jump higher than normal. Then, using that height and the power of gravity, she cuts the enemy in half with a downward slash.

She has been described as "persistent" and "following instructions to the letter" by [Galatea](https://anilist.co/character/2771/Galatea), who calls her "Tracker Dietrich", as she has been previously involved in tracking down of Galatea.

As of chapter 102 it's revealed she has been demoted for failing a mission (current rank unknown). Furthermore she saves [Yuma](https://anilist.co/character/3335/Yuma) by getting the Abyssal Feeders and Hellcats to fight.

Number two of the seventysixth generation, Rafaela and her older sister were the subjects of one of the organizations experiments. The experiment ended in a horrible failure, in which Rafaela lost her eye, and she left the organization as an inactive Claymore. After a certain event, her skills were needed once more, and she became number five of the seventyeight class, acting as an assassin for the organization.

Once ranked second in the first generation, Rigardo was [Isley](https://anilist.co/character/3339/Isley)'s rival, and challenged him after their awakening. Upon his defeat, Rigardo swore his loyalty to Isley.

Nicknamed the "Silver-Eyed Lion King", his awakened form is that of an enormous humanoid lion.
Claymore number 14 of generation 78. She is a defensive type.
The muscular and aggressive no. 11, Undine uses two swords and had used Youki energy to enhance her muscles.

Roxanne was Claymore No. 1 of her generation and is considered to be one of the eight most powerful Claymores of all time. During her lifetime, she was known as "Roxanne of Love and Hate" and was apparently troublesome to the Organization.

Noel was well-known for her agility and was known as Stormwind Noel in the organization. She constantly vied with [Sophia](https://anilist.co/character/10127/Sophia) for the rank #3 position. She was outspoken and tomboyish.

Noel was among the party of #2 - #5 Claymores sent to assassinate [Teresa](https://anilist.co/character/2398/Teresa) and was subsequently killed by the Awoken [Priscilla](https://anilist.co/character/2624/Priscilla).

The name ノエル (Noeru) can be spelt as both Noel or Noelle (both names are pronounced the same way). However Noel is originally a male name, while Noelle is the female variant.

No. 31 of the 141st generation.

Tabitha is a very quiet and serious person. She is very loyal to [Miria](https://anilist.co/character/2702/Miria). She also seems to be very intelligent, helping to strategize and organize her team during battle. Her great Yoki perception gained her the title "The Dark Silver Eye." She is a defensive-type Claymore, although she has not yet been shown utilizing her regenerative abilities.

The number one Claymore in the seventy eight generation, Alicia was specially designed by the Organization to work with her twin sister, [Beth](https://anilist.co/character/3244/Beth). In battle, Alicia's body awakens, while her sister Beth controls her, thus giving the Organization enough power to take on the most powerful awakened. Both Alicia and Beth have little personality, and know only to follow the orders of their superiors.

~!Alicia fought as the number one for two generations. As part of the Abyssal Hunt, Alicia fought against [Riful of the West](https://anilist.co/character/2622/Riful) during the Lautrec's disaster. Defending her twin sister from [Priscilla](https://anilist.co/character/2624/Priscilla), Alicia died at the hands of the Monster of One Horn.!~

Originally number one of generation 76, Luciela awoke after a failed experiment by the Organization. After nearly ruining the Organization, she settled in the lands to the south, as the Abyssal One of the South. her awakened form resembles a feline humanoid with multiple tails. She can also conjure forth mouths anywhere on her body, allowing these to devour incoming objects.

She is also the only known case of a awakened being eating yoma flesh rather than solely human guts

Yuma is the #40 Claymore of generation 78 and is a defensive type. She is extremely insecure, considering herself weak compared to her companions. Despite clearly being the weakest of the survivors of the Northern Campaign, after the seven year time skip her skill is enough to defeat three of the organizations warriors at once, one of which was the number 14 at the time, knocking them unconscious without injuring them, then stating that their swords were practically standing still compared to hers. Later on, through necessity, she learns to heal the wounds of other by synchronizing her youki with theirs, in the same way her companion [Cynthia](https://anilist.co/character/3333/Cynthia) does.

Because of her brute strength, Sophia was called Muscular Sophia in the organization. She had a very polite, lady-like way of speaking except when she was arguing with her rival and friend, [Noel](https://anilist.co/character/3960/Noel).

Sophia was among Claymores ranked #2 - #5 sent to kill [Teresa](https://anilist.co/character/2398/Teresa). The Awoken [Priscilla](https://anilist.co/character/2624/Priscilla) killed her after the battle with Teresa.

Hysteria was Claymore No. 1 of her generation and is considered to be one of the eight most powerful Claymores of all time. During her lifetime, she was known as "Hysteria the Elegant."

She is one of the three Claymores revived by [Dae](https://anilist.co/character/73193/Dae) and the Organization in order to stop the uprising of the current warriors.  

After injuring or possibly killing most of the warriors, she engaged in combat with [Miria](https://anilist.co/character/2702/Miria). It was revealed during the fight that she had a patchy memory and could not remember her name, knowing only that she was supposed to kill all the other warriors and that she was slain in Rockwell Hill. Noting the look of recognition on Miria's face, she asked for her name, only to be ignored due to the younger warrior's mullings. Angered, Hysteria attacked Miria once more. She expressed astonishment when Miria managed to survive her attack. Miria, then, analyzed Hysteria's technique, noting its similarity to her own ability, and released her yoki. Hysteria, though surprised by the move, seemed unimpressed.

She was among the group of awakened former single-digit warriors who gathered outside Rabona to witness the being whose power surpasses the Abyssal Ones.

__Former Rank:__ #3

Dauf was originally his generation's Claymore #3, surpassed only by Rigaldo and [Isley](https://anilist.co/character/3339/Isley). He is currently [Riful](https://anilist.co/character/2622/Riful)'s follower and lover, helping her torture captured Claymores and forcing them to Awaken.

Dauf, in his Awakened form, is an immense humanoid with tremendous strength and exceptionally hard armour plating. He can form large rods from his armor (usually from his hands, back, and in his mouth), firing them as projectiles. Riful has stated that she made Dauf her lover because he is the only Yoma who could "accept her without breaking". However, for all his physical power, Dauf is rather unintelligent and notably poor at tactics. His regeneration and healing abilities are also very slow. In his first appearance, he managed to fight [Clare](https://anilist.co/character/2188/Clare) and [Galatea](https://anilist.co/character/2771/Galatea) to a standstill, as neither could breach his armor. He was defeated when Jeane managed to cut a gaping hole into his chest, nearly killing him. Accordingly, Riful had to intervene to save his life. He is extremely devoted to her and is terrified that she will one day leave him.

~!He assisted Riful in her fight against [Alica](https://anilist.co/character/3243/Alicia), [Beth](https://anilist.co/character/3244/Beth) & the Abyss feeders, resulting in the loss of his right hand and legs. He has been infected by projectiles. [Priscilla](https://anilist.co/character/2624/Priscilla) hints that he may of deliberately let himself get hit by Projectiles but despite that forgot the original goal of what he wanted to protect as he throws Riful's body on the ground like a piece of trash when encountering Priscilla.!~

The number two Claymore in the seventy eight generation, Beth was specially designed by the organization to work with her twin sister. In battle, Beth utilize a "Soul Link" to control her sister [Alicia](https://anilist.co/character/3243/Alicia), who fully awakens. Both Alicia and Beth have little personality, and know only to follow the orders of their superiors.

Veronica is a defensive fighter and seems calm and professional. She was one of the division captains in the Northern campaign, who led [Cynthia](https://anilist.co/character/3333/Cynthia) (#14), [Helen](https://anilist.co/character/2732/Helen) (#22), Pamela (#35), and Matilda (#41).

Veronica was the first warrior killed by [Rigardo](https://anilist.co/character/3338/Rigardo).
Agatha was Claymore #2 in an unknown generation and at an unknown point earned the nickname Fresh Blood Agatha. After Awakening she hid in the holy city of Rabona.
Audrey is Claymore #3 in the current manga arc and a defensive type Claymore. She is good friends with #5 Claymore [Rachel](https://anilist.co/character/26885/Rachel).

A first year high school student who has never experienced romantic feelings. She joins the student council, where she meets [Touko Nanami](https://anilist.co/character/123529). She lives above the family bookstore, where she occasionally works.
