He is a teacher for class 3-E of Kunugigaoka Junior High School and the main antihero of Ansatsu Kyoushitsu. He claims responsibility for blowing up the moon into a permanent crescent shape and plans to destroy the Earth in a year after teaching the students of class 3-E the art of assassination. His name comes from korosenai (殺せない), meaning "cannot be killed", and sensei (先生), meaning teacher. In this way, he is literally called the unkillable teacher.

~!Later in the story he is revealed to have been original reaper named Ryushi Korogane.!~

__Height:__ 159 cm (5'2.5")
__Class:__ Class 3-E 

He is one of the students in Class 3-E. 

Nagisa is seen as one of the weakest students in the class due to his small stature and mediocre physical abilities that are comparable to a girl. However, he is actually the most talented to become an assassin out of all the students, something acknowledged by [Korosensei](https://anilist.co/character/65643) and [Karasuma](https://anilist.co/character/73881). He is able to draw closer while hiding his bloodlust to make a surprise attack and able to make his opponents falter through his bloodlust alone.  

Nagisa usually writes down Korosensei's weaknesses that at first seen minor (since it doesn't look like major weaknesses), but eventually revealed to be useful since once they're able to almost kill Korosensei because of one of his weaknesses that is the same as the one that Nagisa has written down in his note.  

Outwardly friendly and polite to his friends and everyone, he hides a somewhat darker side of him as an assassin that won't be able to be found out during daily classes and will only be shown during training and assassination time. According to Karasuma, whenever Nagisa unleashes his killing intent, he isn't training and truly goes for a kill.

~!In the end, he kills [Koro-Sensei](https://anilist.co/character/65643/Korosensei).!~

~!In the epilogue, 7 years later, Nagisa becomes a teacher of Paradise High School's Class 3-5, Deciding to follow in Koro-sensei's steps.!~

**Height:** 175 cm

A student in [Koro-sensei](https://anilist.co/character/65643)'s class 3-E of Kunugigaoka Junior High School who had been suspended from school due to his violent behavior.  He excels at using weaponry and foul play and is the only student thus far to have successfully injured Korosensei. Despite this, he is actually rather smart and manages a perfect score on one of Korosensei's tests. He and [Nagisa](https://anilist.co/character/65645) were in the same class during their 1st and 2nd years at Kunugigaoka.

He is a government worker associated with the Ministry of Defense. He first appeared announcing Korosensei's deal with the government and their mission to assassinate him before the end of the year. He later became the assistant teacher and P.E. instructor of class 3-E, using his lessons to train the students in assassination techniques. He is well known among militaries for his outstanding reputation and is a powerful individual, which he has proven when he easily overpowered Irina's master, who is a retired professional hitman, and even Korosensei himself is afraid upon seeing his capability for the first time. He is strict, but kind man, though he keeps a distance between himself and the students due to his status as an agent and his own professionalism. He is one of a few who is very perceptive enough to see Nagisa's talent as an assassin. He seems to know Korosensei's past, though he has no intention to indulge into it further.

personnages.nom_natif: イリーナ・イェラビッチ
personnages.description:
__Occupation:__ Professional Hitman, Part-time Foreign Language Teacher 

She is a professional hitwoman who is hired to kill [Korosensei](https://anilist.co/character/65643/Koro-sensei) by becoming a part-time foreign language teacher in class 3-E. She uses her charms to seduce Korosensei, making him at first obeys to whatever she asks. However, her first assassination attempt was foiled when Korosensei able to suppressed her 3-men's attacks, ending in her humiliation and swore revenge. She teaches the students how to seduce people from other countries, so that with this method, they can learn foreign languages, and usually would punish male students who failed answering her questions during her lesson by kissing them.    

Irina is a deceitful, wily and beguiling individual; she frequently uses her charm to influence and manipulate her targets. She can easily befriend people, if she so chooses, and entice them to let down their defenses and become vulnerable to her. Seduction is primarily the technique she employs, and it is her area of expertise. Irina is a professional assassin who excels at handling infiltration and approaching targets. She possesses strong conversational skills in ten languages, and a proven track record of eleven jobs in countries all over the world.

She is one of [Nagisa](https://anilist.co/character/65645/Shiota-Nagisa)'s classmates and close friends, being the one who is mostly seen with him. She hasn't shown any capabilities during her training to become an assassin, and so far has only been shown to discuss [Koro-sensei](https://anilist.co/character/65643/Korosensei)'s weaknesses along with Nagisa. She experiences a slight inferiority complex when it comes to sex appeal, resulting her to get angry whenever there's a woman with big breasts and readily protest.

~!it's revealed later in the story that she's [Aguri Yukimura's](https://anilist.co/character/207936/Aguri-Yukimura) younger sister, Akari Yukimura and her real birthday is on November 9.!~

She is a student in Korosensei's Class 3-E of Kunugigaoka Junior High School. She was a former elementary school genius but felt lonely and longed to be normal. When she got to middle school, she began shirking off her studies which landed her in Class 3-E.
She loves teasing the other students in her class (sometimes together with Karma Akabane)

Transfer student who aims to kill [Koro-sensei](https://anilist.co/character/65643). He is the second assassin transfer student to arrive at Class 3-E, following the previous assassin, [Ritsu](https://anilist.co/character/74832). He initially served as the secondary antagonist, before ultimately joining Class E for good. After being abandoned by [Shiro](https://anilist.co/character/176246) and befriending [Terasaka](https://anilist.co/character/85809) and his gang, Itona has since become more mellow and humble, and is now able to admit people are stronger than him, while still retaining his brutal honesty. He has also shown to be a very observant and creative individual.

An artificial intelligence developed in Norway and sent to Class 3-E as a transfer student to dispose of [Korosensei](https://anilist.co/character/65643/Korosensei), able to learn his movement patterns and perfect her shooting skills in order to eventually kill him. After receiving a few modifications from Korosensei, she develops a conscience and becomes friends with the rest of class 3-E, who give her her shortened nickname. Thanks to her processing power, she frequently helps with Intel gathering and communications and usually interacts with others via a smartphone application developed by her classmates.

She is portrayed by Kanna Hashimoto in the live action movie.
He is a student and class rep in class 3-E of Kunugigaoka Junior High School, taught by Korosensei.

A student in class 3-A in Kunugigaoka Junior High School. He is the student council president and the son of the Board Chairman, Gakuhou Asano. He is a genius student who, like many main building students, look down upon class 3-E.

He is a student in Korosensei's Class 3-E. Maehara is a nice guy and in every sense of the word, a playboy. He has a "live the moment" attitude about life in general. He is one of the few that is popular in the whole school despite being in the E Class. Despite that attitude, he is a caring person and isn't the type to pick on someone weaker than him. He also falls into the type of being honest, and often reacts strongly to things.

She is a student of Kunugigaoka Junior High School. She is assigned to Class 3-E, where she trains to become a professional assassin, with her teacher as the target.   Yukiko is diligent, ladylike, and cordial; although she does not particularly stand out, she is popular with her classmates. A very considerate individual, she had, on one occasion, volunteered to buy drinks for everyone in her class. Yukiko is deliberative and an excellent organizer. She was responsible for structuring the schedule for Class 3-E's trip to Kyoto, and her work had impressed Korosensei. Furthermore, she is adept in considering all factors before making a decision, which is why she had chosen the virtually unoccupied Gion District as the ideal setting for the assassination to take place.

He is one of the students and Nagisa's close friends. He used to be a basketball player in their school's basketball club until he was assigned into class 3-E, making him kicked out from the club. He dreams to become a professional baseball player like his idol, Arita, and emulates his techniques to improve his own performance in baseball and is shown to very dedicated to it. He also sometimes used his baseball techniques in his attempts to kill Korosensei. He has a crush on Yukiko.

__Height::__ 172 cm (5’8”)
__School:__ Kunugigaoka Junior High School
__Class:__ 3-E
__Seat Number:__ 15

He is a student in Korosensei's Class 3-E of Kunugigaoka Junior High School. Chiba is a serious and stoic boy. He's very calm and doesn't talk a lot. He is the best marksman among all of Class 3-E. He excels in spatial calculation and, as such, is unmatched in long distance shooting. His abilities have even earned him the praises of [Lovro](https://anilist.co/character/265570/Brovski-Lovro), a hitman dealer and a retired assassin.

She is a student in class 3-E of Kunugigaoka Junior High School, taught by Korosensei.   Okuda is shy and rather introverted. She admits that she isn't really good with surprise attacks and expressing things in language. She excels in chemistry and capable of making poisons for assassinations.

She is a student in Korosensei's Class 3-E. 

Rinka is a very stoic, businesslike and professional girl who has been compared to a working adult along with Chiba. As a result of her serious demeanor, she can be quite straightforward and direct.

He is a student of Kunugigaoka Junior High School. He is assigned to Class 3-E, where he trains to become a professional assassin, with his teacher as the target. His partners are [Takuya Muramatsu](https://anilist.co/character/85805/Muramatsu-Takuya) and [Taisei Yoshida](https://anilist.co/character/85811/Yoshida-Taisei).   

Terasaka is a rash, selfish and impatient individual. Desperate to escape from the miserable circumstances of being part of the dropout class, he is willing to resort to any means, even if the methods may be immoral. He holds no regards for the injuries of his comrades who provide assistance.  

However, Terasaka possesses relative leadership skills, as he is usually accompanied by his peers, Takuya and Taisei. He persuades others to do his bidding by being direct and intrusively forward, as indicated when he pressures [Nagisa Shiota](https://anilist.co/character/65645/Shiota-Nagisa) to carry out an assassination of [Koro-sensei](https://anilist.co/character/65643/Koro-sensei) by reminding him of the harsh conditions they live in.

He is the board chairman and administrative head of Kunugigaoka Junior High School. He has made the academy into the foremost in Japan in the ten years since its founding.  Gakuhō is a reasonable, prudent, and shrewd individual; he is primarily known for his cool-headed rationalism. He is a proponent of logic and efficiency, and handles matters accordingly. An able and competent administrator, he is resolved in removing factors that may upset the intended balance.

She is a student in Korosensei's Class 3-E. Hinano's personality is an energetic and positive girl and is always seen with a smile on her face regardless of whether she's trying to assassinate Korosensei, or whatever else. Hinano is also a passionate animal and nature lover.

She is a student in Korosensei's Class 3-E. Hazama is a quiet girl who loves reading, preferring to sit in the shade with a book rather than swim during summer gym classes and wants to become a librarian. She even recommended to Itona the novel, The Count of Monte Cristo, though accidentally spoiled the ending. She prefers dark stories and horror novels, and because of this also has an interest in the occult which she displayed when she attempted to use a curse on Korosensei.

She is a student in Korosensei's Class 3-E. She is the big sister of Class 3-E and one of the most enthusiastic students about learning the art of infiltration from [Irina](https://anilist.co/character/73883/Jelavic-Irina). She's been described as being adult-like and cool to the point that [Kayano](https://anilist.co/character/85291/Kayano-Kaede) admits that she's attracted to her despite her large bust.

Yada does not like violence, which is why she commits herself to negotiation in order avoid fighting.

She is a student of Kunugigaoka Junior High School. She is assigned to Class 3-E, where she trains to become a professional assassin, with her teacher as the target. She is one of the two class representatives of Class 3-E, with the other being [Yūma Isogai](https://anilist.co/character/85801/Isogai-Yuma).

(Source: Ansatsu Kyoushitsu Wikia)
She is a student in class 3-E of Kunugigaoka Junior High School, taught by Korosensei.   Fuwa has an imaginative personality, as evidenced with her like of reading the Weekly Shōnen Jump magazine.

Takuya Muramatsu is a student of Kunugigaoka Junior High School. He is assigned to Class 3-E, where he trains to become a professional assassin, with his teacher as the target. His partners are [Ryouma Terasaka](https://anilist.co/character/85809/Terasaka-Ryouma) and [Taisei Yoshida](https://anilist.co/character/85811/Yoshida-Taisei).

Muramatsu is an inconsiderate individual, unmindful to the consequences of his actions. He is willing to resort to any means in order to escape contemptible circumstances. He collaborates with Ryouma and Taisei, and together they pressure others to act according to their bidding.

He is a student of Kunugigaoka Junior High School. He is assigned to Class 3-E, where he trains to become a professional assassin, with his teacher as the target.  Sousuke is exceptionally skilled at drawing and sculpting. His proficiency ranges from posters to disguise masks; he can make them with relative ease. He is also strongly individualistic, and launches attacks against Korosensei in a capricious, unpredictable manner; for instance, he offers to draw a Henna tattoo on Korosensei, but secretly had the Anti-Sensei bullets grounded into a fine powder and then mixed with the Henna paint.  (Source: Assassination Classroom wikia)
Aguri Yukimura is the former teacher of Class 3-E.

She is a student in Korosensei's Class 3-E. Hara is one of the most passive members of the class where she frequently acts as support in assassination attempts with her ability to assess the situation and herself. She is usually regarded as a motherly figure, due to her ability to cook and care for the class.

He is a student in Korosensei's class 3-E of Kunugigaoka Junior High School.   Okajima is the class pervert and is rather open about it. As with Rio Nakamura, Okajima is known to like peeping. He likes to read erotica magazines and even claimed to be a brother of Korosensei and Itona Horibe for doing so. At the start of July, he enjoys looking at the girls' more exposed skin.

He is a student in Korosensei's Class 3-E. Takebayashi is mostly a quiet person. However, he seems somewhat eccentric in his behavior and stands out as the oddball in the class. He also seems to be clumsy at physical activity, having ping pong balls hit his glasses while playing with others and nearly losing balance in one of Tadaomi Karasuma's lessons. He is also obsessed with anime, at one point stating "A girl isn't a true girl until she loses the third D" implying he likes anime girls more than real women. He also enjoys going to maid cafes.

She is a student in Korosensei's Class 3-E. In her initial appearances, Okano was often shown to be serious with a relatively neutral expression. As the series goes on, she's later shown to also be playful in addition to being serious. She is also described as someone who acts before she thinks.

He is a student of Kunugigaoka Junior High School. He is assigned to Class 3-E, where he trains to become a professional assassin, with his teacher as the target. His partners are [Ryouma Terasaka](https://anilist.co/character/85809/Terasaka-Ryouma) and [Takuya Muramatsu](https://anilist.co/character/85805/Muramatsu-Takuya).

Yoshida is an inconsiderate individual, unmindful to the consequences of his actions. He is willing to resort to any means in order to escape contemptible circumstances. He collaborates with Ryouma and Takuya, and together they pressure others to act according to their bidding.

Before becoming the Reaper, he was born in an extremely wealthy family. One night, his father was killed by the original Reaper. As he witnessed his father's assassination from a window, he fell head over heels over the act, calling it "a beautiful skill"; in turn, this motivated him to become an assassin under the current Reaper's tutelage.
He is a student in Korosensei's Class 3-E. Kimura is one of the relatively proactive students when it comes to assassination and aims to claim the 10 billion yen reward.
One of three assassins in Okinawa, along with Smog and Grip. He loves the taste of a gun so much that he uses it as a utensil.
Sakura is a young girl that Nagisa meets when Class 3-E helps out at Wakaba Park's nursery.
He is a student in Korosensei's Class 3-E.

A mysterious man in white clothes who hides secrets about Koro-sensei's past.

~!His real name is Kotarou Yanagisawa!~
Sniper hired to kill Koro-sensei during the Kyoto trip.
A rich teenage boy. Although he is initially lazy and rides on his father's coattails, with encouragement from Nagisa he decides to change himself for the better.

Meiko graduated from university two years ago and lives in an apartment in Tokyo with her boyfriend [Taneda](https://anilist.co/character/18351/Taneda-Naruo). She has no real goals or direction in life and stepped into society as a rather clueless person. She worked as an office lady, but soon grew unhappy and decided to quit her job. Having broken her routine, Meiko enjoys a sense of freedom, but her uncertainty soon returns and she, along with her boyfriend, must learn to embrace their unpredictable future.

Taneda is Meiko's boyfriend and lives in an apartment with her in Tokyo. They support themselves through their jobs (Taneda is an illustrator in a press company), but both up and quit when they realise they just aren't happy. Taneda has a great passion for music and is a guitarist and vocalist in a band with his friends. After quitting his job he decides to try and make it in the music industry by going pro.
Yamada is the drummer of Taneda's band. He works as a clerk in a drugstore.
Katou is Ai's boyfriend. He is still a college student because he had to repeat a year. He is the bassist of Taneda's band.
Kotani is Katou's girlfriend. She works as a sales clerk in a clothing store.

**Height:** 188 cm

He is the former chief and general of the Wind Tribe. He is famously known as Thunder Beast for his fighting skills that were said to be unrivalled by anyone, earning him the title of "strongest soldier in the kingdom".

~!He is in love with [Yona](https://anilist.co/character/43814/Yona). Even when Yona was unaware of his feelings, every now and then, Hak couldn't help but display his affection towards her.!~

__Height:__ 157 cm
__Race:__ Human

The spoiled princess of the Kouka kingdom, who has a crush on her cousin and childhood friend [Soo-won](https://anilist.co/character/88670). Soo-won comforted her when she lost her mother in young age. She hates her crimson red hair. Her bodyguard is the other childhood friend, the general [Son Hak](https://anilist.co/character/43815) who she finds really annoying.

As the princess and the only heir of the Kouka Kingdom, Yona was raised with extreme care and gets whatever she wants, for example, beautiful accessories and clothing. This lead her to being a spoilt princess. After some life-changing events, Yona developed into a strong young lady who lives for the people of Kouka Kingdom, while also paying back the friends who helped her survive.

~!After Soo-won kills her father in front of her eyes in order to become the new king, she has to run from the castle with Son Hak. !~

~!She is the reincarnation of the red dragon.!~

~!She later confesses her love to Son Hak.!~

__Height:__ 180 cm
__Race:__ Dragon

He is the blue dragon and has dragon eyes that allows him to see great distances. Shin-Ah's dragon eyes are also capable of disrupting the nerves of anyone he glares at until it kills them.

~!Later in the story, his power was explained in more detail. His victims are subject to fatal hallucinations. In extreme cases he can cause their entire bodies to stop functioning, including their hearts. However, he does not have full control over this power and will lose himself to the blue dragon's murderous willpower. When he finishes using that ability, he himself becomes paralyzed as a result, making the power a double-edged sword.!~

~!He almost lost complete control when [Yona](https://anilist.co/character/43814/Yona) was captured by some bandits (they were in the fire tribe and Shinah was assigned to protect Yona), causing them to have hallucinations after his mask was knocked off by a bandit. However, she wasn’t afraid of his power and saved him from losing to his power (though it wasn’t easy because he lost himself and didn’t recognize her). He was scared that he wouldn’t be able to stay by Yona’s side anymore and she would hate him because of this. But she reassured his importance to her and to continue to stay with the group.!~

He is also voiced by Sanae Kobayashi.

__Height:__ 188 cm
__Race:__ Dragon

He is the descendant of the Green Dragon and possesses the power of a dragon in his right leg. His power allows him to jump high and long distances that almost make it look like he can fly. It also makes his leg incredibly strong and lethal when used to kick. He's a big flirt, he doesn't care whether it's a man or a girl.

~!Twenty-five years ago, Jae-ha was born in the Village of Ryokuryuu and Garou, the previous Ryokuryuu, took care of him. During his childhood, he was confined in chains within his room to prevent him from escaping the village and also from repeating the tragedy that happened eighty-five years ago. On his every attempt to flee, he was always stopped by Garou and he was beat up as punishment.!~

__Height:__ 166 cm
__Race:__ Dragon

He is the yellow dragon and has a really strong body.

~!He joins the group immediately after the Awa arc. Later on it's revealed that he was watching Yona ever since she was chased out of Hiryuu castle to see if she was fit to use the power of the four dragons. After the events in Awa he decided that he wanted to follow her, so he showed up at the campfire.!~

~!In chapter 100, it is revealed that he is immortal, and that he is the original dragon warrior who received the blood of the Yellow Dragon. His power worked by having certain areas of his body being seriously injured before having that part regenerating back quickly. This was why when he appeared to be a normal human when Hak tried to test whether his body was indestructible (he was not seriously injured). While his body is regenerating, scales appear on the places where his wounds were, making his body as hard as steel. According to Zeno himself, during regeneration his physical power is no less than Kija's dragon arm or Jae-Ha's dragon leg.!~

~!He was married in the past to a sickly girl named Kaya.!~

__Height:__ 175 cm
__Race:__ Dragon

He is the white dragon of the group. He has dragon claws on his right hand, which is said to have ten times the strength of a normal human's.

~!In a side chapter focused on Kija, he (when he was a child) had secretly went to see his father (who was on deathbed). However his father was too weak to realise who it was and thought it was the granny. He had asked if it was okay for him to touch that child (Kija) now that his right hand was back to being a normal human hand. Kija, upon hearing this leapt onto the bed and hugged his father. His father died shortly after saying "Kija" when he realised it was him.!~

__Height:__ 162 cm Race: Human In Princess Yona's group, he is the healer and genius. He is an outstanding curious intellectual. He can say mean things, but he's a caring pretty boy. He was born in a poor village of the Fire Tribe.

__Height:__ 185cm
Race: Human

He is the son of the deceased General Yu-Hon, the older cousin of Yona, as well as her and Hak Son's childhood friend, the three were best friends. He kills Yona's father and becomes the 11th King of Kouka and wants to unite the Kingdom to restore its original power after King Il's reign.

~!He later meets Yona once again in Awa after Kumji's death and hides Yona from General Ju-do and the others, and states that he still has something to do when Yona wanted to kill Su-won.!~

Nozomi Yamamoto voices him as a child.

Ao is Shin-Ah's squirrel companion and friend, who is named after the previous Seiryuu by Shin-Ah.

Ao is a goofy and mischievous yet adorable squirrel, often playing around and making poses that match the person she is riding on. She likes to eat a lot which makes her bite on random things, like Yona's earrings or Shin-Ah's finger. She tries to make people (specifically Shin-Ah or Yona) cheer up if they are feeling down or sad by rubbing their face or acting cute.

She is the daughter of the Water Tribe General An Jun-gi. Though she appears to be a confident and brave girl on the outside, she is actually a shy, caring person, who tries to hide her personality by acting and talking big to others. As a general’s daughter, Lili doesn't like to show her weaknesses to others, and once she does, she considers it as a disgraceful behaviour​.

Lee Geun-Tae is the general of the Earth Tribe and he is the husband of Yun-Ho. He serves under Soo-Won after acknowledging his strength during the Battle Game Festival held in Chi'Shin. Geun-Tae is a bearded, dark-skinned man who is almost never seen without a proud snarl on his face. He has brown almond eyes (yellow in the anime) and long untidy dark brown hair that he ties in a ponytail using a rope-like ornament with tassels on both ends. His fringes cover most of his forehead and some of its strands hang to the sides of his face. Whenever he goes to the castle, he wears an outfit chosen by his wife: a brown leather overcoat with animal-prints atop a white robe with yellow-patterned hemlines, a two-layered purple beaded necklace, and a pair of black boots. While at home, he dons a simple robe where his scars can be visibly seen. Like the people in the Wind Tribe, he likes to take everything easy. He never considers the hierarchy on his tribe and he lets his people talk to him as if he is just an ordinary citizen. He also likes picking fights, especially against Han Joo-Doh, who he never shares a stable relationship with. However, as a general who fought on Emperor Joo-Nam’s era, he believes that he belongs to the battlefield and has been eager to use his skills and fight on the frontlines again. Ever since the banning of war under Emperor Il’s reign, he grew rusty and has been looking for a capable king who he can lend his strength to. Because of this, he will threaten a king of rebellion if he sees him not fit for the position.
Son Hak's adoptive father. Form General of the Wind tribe.

Kan Tae-Jun is the second son of the Fire Tribe General Kan Soo-Jin. He is in love with Yona and has been determined to make her his wife so he could inherit the throne of the Kouka Kingdom.

Tae-Jun is a happy, cowardly, and arrogant man who is obsessed with Yona. He is a pampered person that gets anything he wants and will grow resentful and childish if someone stops him for claiming it. At times, he can also be sneaky and will go against even his father's orders if he thinks it'll be for the better. He has a high regard for himself and will boast his position to anyone, especially to those who offended him while he demand them to give him an apology. Despite his high position in the Fire Tribe, he has no idea of the real situation of the villages outside the capital and thinks that the people are merely slacking off. 

However, After experiencing all the citizen’s hardships, his eyes open to the bad state of his tribe and realizes that with how their current system, there won’t be any future for their tribe. Along with this, he grows to respect Yona and promises her that he will protect the Fire Tribe for her sake.
A servant inside the Hiryuu Castle who attends to the needs of Princess Yona and Emperor Il.
The first princess of the Xing Kingdom and the legitimate successor to the throne.
Algira is the servant of the Princess Tao and friend of Vold. He is a supporter of Tao's faction which opposes Princess Kouren's faction.
She is the chief mistress of Cha-Gol.
King Hiryuu is the first King of Kouka. He was the red dragon god who descended from the heavens and took on human form to rule a kingdom on Earth.
Gung-tae I's wife.
Vold is working with Algira to help Princess Tao fight against her sister's rule. He is revealed to be one of the Five Stars, which consists of the strongest fighters in Xing.
Abi is the first person to bear the Seiryuu's power. He is one of the four Dragon Warriors who was entrusted to protect King Hiryuu and to never betray him.
Ayura is one of Lili's servants and works together with Tetora.
Tetora is one of An Lili's servants along with Ayura.
Han Joo-Doh is the General of the Sky Tribe.
Tae-Woo was introduced into the story as one of the guards standing at the entrance of Fuuga.
The second princess of the Xing Kingdom and the leader of a faction fighting against the first princess, Lady Kouren.
Kye-Sook is Soo-Won’s adviser who also acts as his right-hand man.
Ao is the former blue dragon, and the deceased guardian of Shin-Ah.
Gu-En is the first person to bear the Hakuryuu's power. He is one of the four Dragon Warriors who was entrusted to protect King Hiryuu and to never betray him.
An Jun-gi is the water tribe leader who is known to avoid conflict and always remains silent about everything. He has a daughter named Lili who later becomes a good friend of Yona during her journey.
Heuk-Chi is Kan Tae-Jun's servant and is a soldier of the Fire Tribe.
King Il is the king of the Kouka Kingdom. He is the father of Yona
Shu-Ten is the first person to bear the Ryokuryuu's power. He is one of the four Dragon Warriors who was entrusted to protect King Hiryuu and to never betray him.
Su-won's father, and King II's older brother.
Yong-Hi is the mother of Soo-Won and the wife to former Sky General and Prince Yu-Hon.
Kashi is the mother of princess Yona.

He attempts to capture a powerful killer in Germany who is attacking both humans and robots with no apparent motives.

In the original manga, Gesicht's name was Gerhart, and in the 1980's anime his name was Zeron. In Pluto, he along with his wife and the other robots in the story are given a human appearance - contradictory to his prior robot appearances in both the manga and 1980 series.

Loosely based off of Osamu Tezuka's classic character, "Astro Boy," Atom of the "Pluto" series is a highly developed robot. He is constantly classified as one of the worlds top seven robotic technological advances in science, to the point that even Gesicht's sensors have trouble distinguishing him as a robot or human.  He works with Gesicht in order to help discover the truth behind the recent chain of murders. He has a sister, Uran.

Photon-powered advanced robot who dislikes fighting and cares for homeless children. Created for war along with the other advanced ones, but refused to go there because of his pacifistic beliefs.  Arguably the strongest out of the war series, Epsilon uses the Sun itself as his power source, capable of launching various heat and light based attacks, as well as creating photon-shields and manipulating photons. Epsilon is also capable of willingly detaching his own hands and controlling them remotely.

A Scottish robot with six mechanical armed arms, formerly one of the most powerful fighting robots during the 39th Central Asian War. He prefers not to fight, choosing instead to work as the butler of a blind renowned composer.
Brau-1589 is the first robot to ever kill a human, taking place 8 years before the events of Pluto.

Dr. Tenma (which means "Pegasus" or literally "Heaven-horse" in Japanese) was a renowned roboticist and the Japanese Minister of Science. When his nine-year-old son Tobio died in a car accident, he decided to recreate him as the invincible robot "Atom".

~!Pluto is actually Sahad, a peaceful, quaint, robot with a strong affinity towards nature and who wished to fill his desolated country of Persia full of flowers. He was created by the Persian Minister of Science, Dr. Abullah.

(Source: Astro Boy Wiki)!~

Astro's cybernetic sister in the manga and anime series Astro Boy, as well as its many adaptions. She is a superhuman android with a naive, tomboyish personality.

She is the third robot addition to Astro's family, the first two being his parents. Uran is an extremely mischievous little girl who constantly lands her older brother in trouble. While lacking Astro's weaponry and propulsion systems, she is extremely powerful.

Like Astro, she is fully capable of experiencing human emotions (although she is somewhat immature), by being naughty or disobedient, even annoying.   

__2003 Series:__

Uran reappears in the 2003 series with the name Zoran, with a slightly altered look, including a more appropiate dress in order to appeal to more western audiences. She still retains her tomboyish personality and cheekiness, however is shown to be more adventurous (which instead often puts her in trouble). She is given the ability to communicate with animals and befriends a bird which she names Houdini, however is often jealous of her brother's powers (such as the ability to fly, as well as his popularity).

A Bohemian composer who hired [North No. 2](https://anilist.co/character/141755/North-2gou). He was on the verge of death due to a childhood illness, but he was saved by a surgery performed by [a Japanese doctor](https://anilist.co/character/1344/Kuroo-Hazama). As a result, his vision deteriorated and he became blind. Due to believing that he was abandoned by his mother in the past, he has a stubborn personality and even refers to North No. 2 as a weapon.

Dr. Ochanomizu, a recurring character in many of Osamu Tezuka's manga, including Astro Boy, can be seen "lecturing" at Narita International Airport, outside of Tokyo, on HIV and safe sex.  Dr. Ochanomizu was most famously seen as the mentor to Astro Boy and the creator of Astro's sister and parents.
A.I created to aid the president of the United States of Thracia.
A simple man who lives with his family in Düsseldorf.~!A member of RK, an anti-robot extremist group.!~~!Vows to kill Gesicht after learning his involvement in his brothers death!~

Police Inspector Tawashi (a.k.a. Inspector Gumshoe) is a law enforcer and recurring character in the Tetsuwan Atom mythos. Known for his surly demeanor, Inspector Tawashi is a dedicated officer. And he hates robots.

He is similar to Inspector Geta in that both always appear as police investigators, and both are known for their dedication to their job. However, while Geta is known for his honesty and uprightness, Tawashi is most known for his suspicion of people. He is suspicious not only of Tezuka villains such as Ham Egg and Lamp, or of ambiguous characters such as Rock Holmes, but is even critical and untrusting of such figures as Astro Boy. The series which contains most of his appearances is Astro Boy, but he also has notable appearances in such series as The Amazing Three, Black Jack, Lion Books, Unico, and Rainbow Parakeet.

personnages.nom_natif: アレクサンダー大統領

personnages.description: Has a quiet and reserved personality, her classmates mistake her for an anime otaku. She can be a little airheaded in certain circumstances.
Part of the popular crowd, her grades aren't great but she has good communication skills and has a lot of friends. Popular with the guys at school but she takes no interest in them.

Mitsuki's uncle. He doesn't have children of his own, so he's all-in on loving his niece. The ultimate doting uncle. He's always pursued what he loves, so he wants Mitsuki to be true to herself as well. When he was young, he worked hard to make a living from music, but now he's the owner of a run-down CD shop.
[Joe](https://anilist.co/character/305502/Joe)'s ex-girlfriend. She works as a stylist in L.A. Mitsuki looks up to her because she focuses on the things she wants to do and pushes hard towards them.

In the same class as Aya and Mitsuki. An easygoing and refreshing stud (self- proclaimed) who is popular and admired by many. He's reasonably well-liked by the ladies, so when he encounters a girl he can't easily charm, he can't get her out of his head (currently, he can't get Mitsuki and Aya out of his head, but more in the sense that he's watching over them). If someone says something mean to him, he'll smile while actually getting depressed on the inside. However, he bounces back ridiculously fast. As far as his club activities go, he's in the soccer club (but he's probably the type who gets invited to all kinds of clubs).
Chizuru, along with Mao, used to be Aya's best friend. She doesn't like that Aya spends so much time with Mitsuki lately.
Mao is another girl from Aya's inner circle. She always follows Chizuru wherever she goes and is secretly interested in Narita.

A mysterious albino girl that [Ganta](https://anilist.co/character/8630/Igarashi-Ganta) encountered during his first days as an inmate. Clothed only in a skin-tight bodysuit and muffly gloves, which conceals her heavily scarred skin, Shiro stands out among the other prisoners due to her bizarre appearance and mannerisms. To Ganta, Shiro's manner of speaking and acting remind him of a small child, even though Shiro is the same age as him. However, Shiro possesses inhuman physical abilities and has an intimate knowledge of the prison, having apparently lived there most of her life.

From the beginning of the story it is made clear that, as children, Shiro and Ganta were close friends. Ganta, however, has no memories of his childhood, which greatly saddens and annoys Shiro.

~!Despite her seemingly harmless appearance, Shiro harbors a dark secret; she possesses two personalities and her second one is the 'Red Man' Ganta is searching for, who is also the 'Wretched Egg', the source of the Branch of Sin infection. Thanks to the Mother Goose mainframe, Deadman Wonderland's supercomputer, which constantly emits a lullaby audible only to Shiro and Tamaki's father, Shiro's true personality is repressed. When the lullaby is turned off, Shiro becomes a murderous, smirking maniac capable of massacring whole squads of armed men with little effort. It's at these times that she dons a crimson colored full body restraint, which gives her a taller, masculine appearance, hence Ganta's inability to recognize her (later it's revealed that this costume was made after the 'Aceman', a superhero character in a cartoon Shiro and Ganta used to watch together as kids). Shiro cares greatly for Ganta and constantly seeks his approval. She is willing to do anything that Ganta asks her as long as it will make him happy. Even when in her 'Red Man' state, she still seems to care for him, as it was implied that she butchered Ganta's classmates just so that he would be sent to Deadman Wonderland, where she was also living.!~

Senji was the first "Deadman" that Ganta encountered at the prison. After making their way to sector G, Crow destroyed the Necro Macro security robot which had been chasing Ganta, Shiro and Yoh. After a small skirmish, and an interruption by Shiro, Crow was subdued by the Deadman security. The next day, Ganta and Senji were slated to be the next two Deadmen to compete in the "Carnival Corpse." Despite Senji's experience and skill with his 'branch' ability, Ganta managed to win by fooling Senji. As a consequence for losing, Senji's right eye was removed for research. He returns a short time later during Ganta's next match, sporting an eyepatch and gives Ganta assistance with figuring out his opponent's techniques. He also helps Ganta understand his own capabilities. His change in personality toward Ganta is due to his respect for Ganta's strength. Senji comments that because Ganta beat him, he is not allowed to lose until they have a rematch.   He seems to thoroughly enjoy violence, and his favorite phrase is "Dead Center" (or in the dub of the anime, "Sssslice."). Despite his wild and battle-hungry attitude, he does have a sense of honor and respects strength and determination. In an ironic twist, Senji becomes flustered and embarrassed when a woman acts immodest. When he first notices Shiro's form fitting body tights, his face becomes red and he give her his coat telling her to quickly cover up.   His Branch of Sin is called "Crow Claw". It manifests as two large scythe-like blades, made of blood, extending from long cuts on his forearms. He makes these cuts using two bladed rings he wears on his thumbs. While the blades are typically two to three feet long, Senji has demonstrated the ability to greatly lengthen them allowing him to attack people at range. He is responsible for naming Ganta's 'Branch of Sin' (Ganta Gun).  He also has a supersonic attack called Invisible Black.   Senji used to be a policeman before his time in DW. It's hinted that he killed four friends.    ~!It's revealed in his fight with a Forgery that Senji did not kill them, but was indirectly responsible for their deaths. After the Tokyo massive earthquake, chaos ruled in Seiji's inspection area, and out of the corrupt police force, only Seiji and his friends were active against the local crimes. Their actions soon drew hostile attentions of many hoodlums, especially to Seiji since the branch of sin he possessed was a powerful asset. They challenged Seiji to a many-on-one battle, but his friends stopped him and took on the offer, and ended up savagely murdered in his place. As such, he partially believes Ganta in that he did not kill his friends, because he has experienced similar circumstances  !~

The main protagonist of the story. Ganta is a seemingly harmless, ordinary middle school boy who is framed for the slaughter of his entire middle school class, perpetrated by the mysterious Red Man. Sentenced to "death," he is sent to Deadman Wonderland, where he is initially confused and frightened by the brutality of the prison.

personnages.nom_natif: 蒔名フリューゲル季和子
personnages.description:
Senior leader of the prison's guard staff, Makina is a harsh and cold enforcer which does not hesitate in punishing, often brutally, the prison's population. Known for her demeanor and her large breasts (G cup), she is infamous for carrying a decorated sword with herself at all times, and also for using it to cut whoever breaks the prison's rules, acts that almost always result in bloodshed. 

Despite her brutality she is far less twisted than Tamaki, whom she is greatly suspicious of, especially after discovering that she knows and has authority over only a part of Deadman Wonderland. This fact, coupled with Tamaki's ever more sick machinations, led her to forfeit her position and hunt him down with the aid of some allies, among them the Deadmen themselves, Ganta in particular.

~!After the death of Tamaki, she came in possession of the data regarding the Wretched Egg, the Deadmen and the Forgeries.!~

A mysterious Deadman feared even by Senji, Toto is a mysterious boy dressed in a way reminiscent of Shiro, and appears not only to be one of the strongest Deadmen introduced so far, but also to know in great detail about the true nature and purpose of Deadman Wonderland.   His power, Love Labyrinth, allows him to copy the abilities of other Deadmen. However, he states that he recently was reset of his copied powers after his battle with the Red Man. However, even in his weakened state, he managed to take down two of the Forgeries with nothing but a copy of Crow's powers. Nicknamed Mockingbird, he freely comes and goes through the prison, and recently has become friends with Ganta. Toto is the only person to have fought the Red Man and have survived.   ~!He's later revealed to be the chief of Deadman Wonderland and true main antagonist, Hagire Rinichirou. By using the combined ability of his two bodyguard, "Hollow Swallow", Hagire was able to transfer his mind to Toto's body and took over it. What happened to Toto's personality is currently unknown. It's assumed that he is on the protagonists side, as he alerts Shiro about the data chip, and takes out Hibana with Invisible Black.!~

Minatsuki is the younger sister of Yoh Takami, and a Deadman known as "Hummingbird" in the complex. She initially appears as a very shy, reserved little girl who cannot stand violence and her horrible past. Minatsuki soon shows that it is a ruse to lure opponents into a false sense of security. She is actually very sadistic, deriving sexual pleasure from seeing the pained looks on her victim's faces. She especially likes the look of her brother blaming himself for their father's death, though he does know the real truth. After losing to Ganta, she reconciles somewhat with both Yoh and Ganta, but still lashes out at them frequently. Her Branch of Sin is called "Whip Wing", which uses blood from her ears to create whips that can quickly strike and restrain the target.   ~! Her sadistic character comes from her experience in the earthquake. When the earthquake first hit Japan, Minatsuki was with her mother. She tried holding on to her mother to help her escape but her mom let go of her and ran away for her own life. Leaving Minatsuki behind inside the house. That's when she became more sadistic and hating towards humanity. !~

A member of Scar Chain, a group of Deadmen that oppose the prison and plan to leak the truth to the rest of the world. Karako loves its leader, Nagi, deeply and fights to help him achieve his dream of freeing the Deadmen. She is able to use her Branch of Sin to wrap blood around her body to increase her physical strength while using the Wushu martial art style to defend herself. She can also close up wounds using this technique.  She used to be a nurse before her time in DW.

The leader of Scar Chain, a group of Deadmen that oppose the the prison and plan to leak the truth to the rest of the world. Nagi speaks with a mechanical voice created by a synthesizer because of his vocal chords being removed after a rigged fight with his lover, who was later killed by Genkaku of the Undertakers. He has a son, left in the care of a nursery outside, and fights for freedom to see his child. His branch of sin is called "Owl's Eyeball", which creates small floating explosive spheres that can be controlled and detonated remotely.     ~!  It's later revealed that Nagi's son actually died in his mother's womb when Nagi's wife was killed. This prompted Nagi to develop a second, horrifyingly savage and inhuman personality, which slaughtered numerous Undertakers in vengeance. Genkaku is especially fascinated by this and later drugs Nagi to bring to light this side of him, which causes Nagi to temporarily revert to his second personality and attacks his own comrades. Ganta manages to bring Nagi back to his senses, but then, Genkaku fatally wounds Nagi by blasting a hole in his stomach, as he claims that he loves Nagi's dark side and will kill Nagi to bring him salvation, if he chooses to stay the person he is. However, Nagi still manages to stop Genkaku from dodging Ganta's powerful attack, which permanently incapacitates Genkaku, and dies shortly afterwards.   !~

A kleptomaniac and an informant to Assistant Warden Tamaki, Yoh was hired to watch over Ganta in return of large amounts for Cast Points. Though apparently friendly and polite, in truth he is ruthless, scheming and somehow paranoid, given his position as a spy for the prison's staff. A rarity among the prison population, Yoh made himself captured and sent to Deadman Wonderland in hopes to find his sister Minatsuki and buy her freedom with the accumulated Cast Points he got from Tamaki. He cares deeply about her, so much so that he is often thought of suffering from a sister complex, much to Minatsuki's disgust. The two eventually manage to forge an estranged relationship.  (Wikipedia)

A squad leader of the Undertakers, Tamaki's special enforcement group which selects prisoners who could not be rehabilitated and survived a special 'correctional' program to be anti-Deadman soldiers, wielding weapons that allow them to nullify the Deadmen's Branches of Sin. He dresses like a monk (though he prefers to be called a "Hyper Monk") and wields a guitar that can split into two machine guns, fire shock waves, or just play music like a regular slide guitar.   ~!2 years ago he killed Nagi's wife after she conspired with her husband to rig their fight, and has taken an interest in Nagi since then, claiming Nagi possesses the insanity befitting of an Undertaker.  During the flashback in episode 12 Genkaku's past is revealed, describing the events that led up to his current insanity. As a young boy Genkaku was a monk at a monastery, where at first he was a quiet, gentle person. However after taking constant abuse at the hands of three other men present at the monastery (it can be assumed from the flashback that it was not only physical, but sexual abuse), coupled with the aftermath of the explosion in Tokyo, he snapped, killing all three of the men.!~

Chief of Intelligence for Scar Chain. His Branch of Sin takes the shape of a hexagonal shield with spikes on the side.   ~!He is the traitor that gives the Undertakers information about Scar Chain's breakout plan.!~ (Source: Deadman Wonderland Wikia)

A prisoner belonging to the human sector inside Deadman Wonderland. She befriended Ganta when he was admitted. After the Scar Chain incident, she was sent by Makina as a spy to the Deadmen sector and was transformed into a 'forgery', artifical Deadman with scarcely any wills of their own, controlled by a mask they cannot take off. Ganta recognized her due to the star-shaped band-aid she put on her hand, and tried to protect her at the cost of his friendship with fellow Deadmen. Later on she teamed up with Shiro to rescue Ganta.    As a child, Azami was neglected by her parents. She joined a motorcycle gang in high school and was put in jail when she took all the blame for her friends after an accident. She keeps a pet.       ~!She later gets beheaded and dies in chapter 40 after an encounter with "The Red Man".!~

An old Deadman who always wears a headphone and quotes an unknown person whom he refers to as his 'daughter'. His branch of sin is 'Condor Candle', which allows him to set his opponents aflame.     ~!  Before his service in Deadman Wonderland, Idaki used to be a teacher. He had a daughter named Yuki, whom he loved dearly. However,  she misunderstood him to hate her very much due to his wife's death at her birth and his pedagogic, aloof manners. After an accident which left Yuki bedridden and disfigured, she frequently took her anger out on him (once she gouged out one of his eyes), Idaki still silently took care of her. Eventually, at the bottom of despair, Yuki set herself and the hospital on fire, and Idaki blamed himself for her death.  !~

A small, very polite and well-mannered girl who was warped considerably by torture performed by her mother for simple things like wetting the bed. She is an expert in torture, and uses a large sectioned sword as large as her body.   ~!She is killed by Mockingbird, right after Genkaku's defeat.!~

Masaru is a trans woman who sees herself as a bright figure in Sector G and is also an announcer for most of the "Carnival Corpse" duels. She is often around Minatsuki, Itadaki "Masu" Kazuya, a fat man who tore his own mouth open from eating large objects, and Hitara, a mysterious old man that claims to be listening to his daughter through headphones. Masaru has entered Ganta's room on two occasions unannounced and called him silly for not locking his door. Her card is Peacock and her Branch of Sin, Peacock Peak, allows her to create what appear to be bramble-like constructs that can be used to trap and pierce opponents.

Before being imprisoned, she was an ordinary employee of some corporation who awoke her Deadman powers after finding her lover with a woman, whom she killed.
A classmate and old friend of Ganta.  ~!It becomes clear that Ganta had a crush on Mimi. She gets killed by the red man right at the beginning.!~

A major antagonist form the first half of the story, Tamaki is Assistant Warden and de facto tyrant of Deadman Wonderland. Under his calm, almost idiotic attitude, he is something of a sadist, caring nothing about the fact that he butchers dozens of prisoners every day for the sole purpose of gathering money or experimenting on them, or simply for his amusement. As son of the dying Chief Warden of Deadman Wonderland, he eagerly hopes for the death of his father to become truly the supreme ruler of the prison, and he devotes much of his time and resources in studying and experimenting on the powers of the Branch of Sin and their origin. He also is in contact with the upper echelons of the Japanese government, his ultimate goal being the synthesis of artificial Deadmen. In sharp contrast with his cruelty, he enjoys playing with children toys.  

(Source: Wikipedia)

The Chief of Deadman Wonderland.    ~!He's the true primary antagonist of the series and he's also bedridden and locked inside his room, guarded by two albino twins. Due to his state inside an old man's body, the managing duties of DW prison are left to Tamaki.  He's also a Deadman. He's killed by Shiro after challenging her Wretched Egg persona to a fight. It's later revealed that Hagire isn't actually dead, since he had transferred his memories to Sakigami Toto and is currently occupying Toto's body.   In the past, Hagire who was in his orginal body and was the head of the research facility Ganta's mother, Igarashi Sorae worked in. They led the research on the Nameless Worms and experimented on a little Shiro; while Sorae was plagued by guilt due to the inhuman experiments, Hagire was shown uninterested in Shiro's well-beings and often sadistically pushed the experiments forward. In the end, the pains from many experiments forced Shiro to create the Wretched Egg persona (which she termed "Ace Man", a hero who saved the weak on a TV shows she and Ganta watched together), and developed the ability to control blood. Hagire's interests in Shiro skyrocketed after the Wretched Egg appeared, and he started to aspire to be like her.  HIs branch of sin appears as tentacle-like whips, which he uses wildly and randomly, however, when he transfers to Toto's body, he gains Mockingbird's branch, Love Labyrinth !~

Chan were the servants of Hagire Rinichirō and his artificial children.   Chan and En both wear the same clothes and look exactly the same way (with the exception of their hair). They wear a black formal suit with a white shirt under it. They also have a red tie. En's hair reaches over her shoulders and Chan's is shoulder length. They are albino so they have red eyes and a somewhat grey skin.

Chan and En were the servants of Hagire Rinichirō and his artificial children.   Chan and En both wear the same clothes and look exactly the same way (with the exception of their hair). They wear a black formal suit with a white shirt under it. They also have a red tie. En's hair reaches over her shoulders and Chan's is shoulder length. They are albino so they have red eyes and a somewhat grey skin.
A sadistic doctor who works at Deadman Wonderland.

Mitsuzaki Yosuga is a Deadman previously captured at Deadman Wonderland. After it fell, she joined Makina's expedition and return to DW to permanently destroy it and the Wretched Egg.   ~! She tells that she's Sakigami Toto's big sister, and part of the reason she agrees to return to DW is to find out what happened to her brother. Later, a flashback shows that they aren't actual siblings. Yosuga is an orphan brought into DW by Tamaki, and Toto's family (including his older sister) had already died. It's implied that Toto claimed Yosuga as his older sister due to Yosuga's resemblance to her, although Yosuga is younger than Toto. As time went on, she started to think of Toto as her real brother. !~
Domon is a police officer in Tokyo. He is Senji's superior, mentor and friend.

Ganta's mother.      ~!  She's shown to be a scientist working at the research facility that would become Deadman Wonderland 10 years later in the future. She's also the inventor of the Mother Goose system, which is used to restrain the Wretched Egg.    Sorae and the DW's chief, Hagire Rinichirou, was the heads of the research on the Nameless Worms. Their brutal experiments on Shiro led to the creation of the Wretched Egg.!~

His father died in the Great Tokyo Earthquake. On top of that, he was severely bullied as a child. It was at that time that he decided that he should be unhappy to make others happy. It is unknown why he was sent to DW, since he didn't have a Branch of Sin to begin with.  Madoka thinks that happiness grows from another's unhappiness. He tried to make the people around him as happy as possible, by being unhappy himself. But he realized that he was happy being unhappy. This led him to the conclusion that when others are unhappy, they will feel happy as well.
A prisoner at DW, and a former MMA fighter.

personnages.nom_natif: 頂 和弥（いただき かずや）
personnages.description: Itadaki Kazuya is a large Deadman in Deadman Wonderland. He is known for eating a lot. His nickname, "Masu" (or "Mass"), is a pun when combined with his given name; the word いただきます (itadakimasu) is the traditional Japanese expression used when beginning a meal which is the equivalent to saying "let's eat" or "dig in." He has been shown to have a very large appetite, consuming masses of food over a short time.
Kosugi is a Deadman and a former member of Scar Chain. He died during the Deadman mass prison break.

Miya is a Deadman and a former member of Scar Chain. She died during the Deadman mass prison break. In the anime, she was named Harumi. Her branch of sin takes on the form of a ring, used as a projectile.
Koumoto is a Deadman and a former member of Scar Chain. He died during the Deadman mass prison break.
Miyako is a Deadman and a former member of Scar Chain. Her fate remains unknown after the Deadman mass prison break.
Wakabayashi is a Deadman and a former member of Scar Chain. In the anime, he was killed by Hagire Rinichirou in Toto Sakigami's body. In the manga, he was killed by Genkaku's gunfire.
Ueshima is a Deadman and a former member of Scar Chain. He died during the Deadman mass prison break.
Kazu is a Deadman and a former member of Scar Chain. He died during the Deadman mass prison break.
Fujiyoshi is a Deadman and a former member of Scar Chain. He died during the Deadman mass prison break. In the anime, he was named Matayoshi instead of Fujiyoshi.
Yamazaki is a Deadman and a former member of Scar Chain. He died during the Deadman mass prison break. His branch of sin takes on the form as an intricate web.
